**Example Output:** `Word frequency: {hello=2, world=1, java=1}`

**Explanation:** Files.lines streams lines; flatMap+split tokenizes words; Collectors.groupingBy counts frequency.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.stream.*;
public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        // Count words in a file using streams
        long wordCount = Files.lines(Path.of("text.txt"))
            .flatMap(line -> Arrays.stream(line.split("\s+")))
            .filter(word -> !word.isBlank())
            .count();
        System.out.println("Word count: " + wordCount);

        // Walk directory tree
        Files.walk(Path.of("."), 2)
            .filter(Files::isRegularFile)
            .filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".java"))
            .forEach(System.out::println);
    }
}
```

**Answer:**
```java
import java.nio.*;
import java.nio.channels.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        // NIO FileChannel - fast file copy
        Path src = Path.of("large.bin"), dst = Path.of("copy.bin");
        try (FileChannel in = FileChannel.open(src, StandardOpenOption.READ);
             FileChannel out = FileChannel.open(dst, StandardOpenOption.CREATE, StandardOpenOption.WRITE)) {
            in.transferTo(0, in.size(), out);
            System.out.println("Transferred " + in.size() + " bytes");
        }
    }
}
```

### 1310. Read CSV File
**ID:** `FILEIO-1310`

**Problem:** Read CSV File.

**Example Input:** employees.csv with header row

**Example Output:** parsed list of Employee objects

**Explanation:** BufferedReader reads line-by-line; split(",") parses fields; skip header; map to objects.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.*;
public class Solution {
    record Employee(int id,String name,double salary){}
    static List<Employee> readCsv(String path) throws IOException {
        try(BufferedReader br=Files.newBufferedReader(Path.of(path))){
            return br.lines()
                .skip(1) // header
                .map(line->line.split(","))
                .map(parts->new Employee(Integer.parseInt(parts[0].trim()),
                                         parts[1].trim(),
                                         Double.parseDouble(parts[2].trim())))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        // Create sample file
        Files.writeString(Path.of("emp.csv"),"id,name,salary\n1,Alice,75000\n2,Bob,80000");
        readCsv("emp.csv").forEach(System.out::println);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

```java
import java.io.*;

import java.util.*;
public class Solution {
    record Employee(int id,String name,double salary){}
    static void writeCsv(List<Employee> emps,String path) throws IOException {
        try(PrintWriter pw=new PrintWriter(Files.newBufferedWriter(Path.of(path)))){
            pw.println("id,name,salary");
            for(Employee e:emps) pw.printf("%d,%s,%.2f%n",e.id(),e.name(),e.salary());

        writeCsv(emps,"out.csv");

}
```

### 1314. Walk Directory Using Files.walk
**ID:** `FILEIO-1314`

**Problem:** Walk Directory Using Files.walk.

**Example Input:** directory path

**Example Output:** all .java files recursively listed

**Explanation:** Files.walk() returns Stream<Path>; filter by extension; sorted for deterministic output.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.stream.*;
public class Solution {
    public static void listJavaFiles(String dir) throws IOException {
        try(Stream<Path> walk=Files.walk(Path.of(dir))){
            walk.filter(p->p.toString().endsWith(".java"))
                .sorted()
                .forEach(System.out::println);
        }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        // Create temp structure for demo
        Path tmp=Files.createTempDirectory("demo");
        Files.createFile(tmp.resolve("Main.java"));
        Files.createFile(tmp.resolve("Util.java"));
        Files.createDirectories(tmp.resolve("sub"));
        Files.createFile(tmp.resolve("sub/Helper.java"));
        listJavaFiles(tmp.toString());
        // cleanup
        Files.walk(tmp).sorted(java.util.Comparator.reverseOrder()).forEach(p->{try{Files.delete(p);}catch(Exception e){}});
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(depth)

```java
import java.io.*;
```

### 1323. Create and Delete Directories

**Example Output:** `Directory created; exists=true; after delete: false`

**Explanation:** createDirectory: one level. createDirectories: all levels. delete: must be empty. deleteIfExists: no exception.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.nio.file.*;
public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] a) throws Exception {
        Path base=Files.createTempDirectory("base");
        Path nested=base.resolve("a/b/c");
        Files.createDirectories(nested);
        System.out.println("created: "+Files.isDirectory(nested));
        // Clean up nested (must delete inner-out)
        Files.delete(nested);
        Files.delete(nested.getParent());
        Files.delete(nested.getParent().getParent());
        Files.delete(base);
        System.out.println("base deleted: "+!Files.exists(base));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(depth) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1325. Files.walk — Recursive Directory Walk
**ID:** `FILE-1325`

**Problem:** Walk entire directory tree recursively; filter by extension.

**Example Input:** `dir with .txt files at various depths`

**Example Output:** `Prints all .txt file paths`

**Explanation:** Files.walk(start) returns Stream<Path> of all descendants. Use filter to select. Close the stream.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.nio.file.*;
public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] a) throws Exception {
        Path dir=Files.createTempDirectory("walk");
        Path sub=Files.createDirectory(dir.resolve("sub"));
        Files.createTempFile(dir,"r",".txt");
        Files.createTempFile(sub,"s",".txt");
        Files.createTempFile(sub,"s2",".log"); // not .txt
        try(java.util.stream.Stream<Path> s=Files.walk(dir)){
            s.filter(p->p.toString().endsWith(".txt")).sorted().forEach(System.out::println);
        }
        Files.walk(dir).sorted(java.util.Comparator.reverseOrder()).forEach(p->{try{Files.delete(p);}catch(Exception e){}});
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(depth) stack

```java
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
public class Solution {

        Files.writeString(csv,"name,age
Alice,30
Bob,25");

        String[] headers=lines.get(0).split(",");
        for(int i=1;i<lines.size();i++){
```

### 1328. Object Serialization (ObjectOutputStream)
**ID:** `FILE-1328`

**Problem:** Serialize a Java object to a file and deserialize it back.

**Example Input:** `Person(name=Alice, age=30) serialized to file`

**Example Output:** `Deserialized: Person{name=Alice, age=30}`

**Explanation:** Class must implement Serializable. serialVersionUID recommended. transient fields are skipped.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
public class Solution {
    static class Person implements Serializable {
        private static final long serialVersionUID=1L;
        String name; int age;
        Person(String n,int a){name=n;age=a;}
        public String toString(){return "Person{name="+name+", age="+age+"}";}
    }
    public static void main(String[] a) throws Exception {
        Path tmp=Files.createTempFile("serial",".bin");
        // Serialize
        try(ObjectOutputStream oos=new ObjectOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(tmp.toFile()))){oos.writeObject(new Person("Alice",30));}
        // Deserialize
        try(ObjectInputStream ois=new ObjectInputStream(new FileInputStream(tmp.toFile()))){System.out.println("Deserialized: "+ois.readObject());}
        Files.delete(tmp);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

### 1330. FileChannel and ByteBuffer (NIO)
**ID:** `FILE-1330`

**Problem:** Use NIO FileChannel with ByteBuffer for high-performance I/O.

**Example Input:** `Write bytes via channel; read back via channel`

**Example Output:** `Read: Hello NIO`

**Explanation:** ByteBuffer.allocate(n) then channel.write(buf)/read(buf). flip() switches write→read mode.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.*;
import java.nio.channels.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] a) throws Exception {
        Path tmp=Files.createTempFile("channel",".bin");
        // Write
        try(FileChannel wc=FileChannel.open(tmp,StandardOpenOption.WRITE)){
            ByteBuffer buf=ByteBuffer.allocate(64);
            buf.put("Hello NIO".getBytes()); buf.flip(); wc.write(buf);
        }
        // Read
        try(FileChannel rc=FileChannel.open(tmp,StandardOpenOption.READ)){
            ByteBuffer buf=ByteBuffer.allocate(64);
            rc.read(buf); buf.flip();
            byte[] bytes=new byte[buf.remaining()];
            buf.get(bytes); System.out.println("Read: "+new String(bytes));
        }
        Files.delete(tmp);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

### 1334. Properties File — Load and Store
**ID:** `FILE-1334`

**Problem:** Load configuration from .properties file; update and store back.

**Example Input:** `key=host=localhost, port=8080`

**Example Output:** `host=localhost, port=8080; after update port=9090`

**Explanation:** Properties extends Hashtable<Object,Object>. load(InputStream) / store(OutputStream, comment).

**Answer:**
```java
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] a) throws Exception {
        Path tmp=Files.createTempFile("config",".properties");
        Files.writeString(tmp,"host=localhost
port=8080
");
        Properties props=new Properties();
        try(InputStream is=new FileInputStream(tmp.toFile())){ props.load(is); }
        System.out.println("host="+props.getProperty("host"));
        System.out.println("port="+props.getProperty("port"));
        props.setProperty("port","9090");
        try(OutputStream os=new FileOutputStream(tmp.toFile())){ props.store(os,"Updated config"); }
        System.out.println("updated port="+new Properties(){{load(new FileInputStream(tmp.toFile()));}}.getProperty("port"));
        Files.delete(tmp);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

### 1335. Checked Exception Handling
**ID:** `EXCEPTION-1335`

**Problem:** Exception Handling Program: Checked Exception Handling.

**Example Input:** `filename = "missing.txt"`

**Example Output:** `IOException caught: missing.txt (No such file or directory)`

**Explanation:** Checked exceptions (IOException, SQLException) must be declared in throws or caught; compiler enforces this.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.io.*;

public class Solution {
    public static void readFile(String name) throws IOException {
        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(name))) {
            String line;
            while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) System.out.println(line);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            readFile("missing.txt");
        } catch (IOException e) {
            System.out.println("IOException caught: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1336. Unchecked Exception Handling
**ID:** `EXCEPTION-1336`

**Problem:** Exception Handling Program: Unchecked Exception Handling.

**Example Input:** `str = null`

**Example Output:** `NullPointerException caught: Cannot invoke method on null`

**Explanation:** Unchecked exceptions (RuntimeException subclasses) don't need declaration; catch them to provide clear messages.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    public static int getLength(String s) {
        return s.length();  // throws NPE if s is null
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            String s = null;
            System.out.println(getLength(s));
        } catch (NullPointerException e) {
            System.out.println("NullPointerException caught: Cannot invoke method on null");
        }

        // Safe approach: null-check first
        String s2 = null;
        System.out.println("Length (safe): " + (s2 != null ? s2.length() : 0));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1337. Custom Exception
**ID:** `EXCEPTION-1337`

**Problem:** Exception Handling Program: Custom Exception.

**Example Input:** `age = -5`

**Example Output:** `InvalidAgeException: Age cannot be negative: -5`

**Explanation:** Extend Exception (checked) or RuntimeException (unchecked). Pass a meaningful message to super().

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static class InvalidAgeException extends Exception {
        InvalidAgeException(String msg) { super(msg); }
    }

    static void setAge(int age) throws InvalidAgeException {
        if (age < 0) throw new InvalidAgeException("Age cannot be negative: " + age);
        System.out.println("Age set to: " + age);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try { setAge(-5); }
        catch (InvalidAgeException e) { System.out.println("Caught: " + e.getMessage()); }

        try { setAge(25); }
        catch (InvalidAgeException e) { System.out.println("Caught: " + e.getMessage()); }
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1338. Try With Resources
**ID:** `EXCEPTION-1338`

**Problem:** Exception Handling Program: Try With Resources.

**Example Input:** `open resource, use it, close automatically`

**Example Output:** `Resource opened
Resource used
Resource closed (auto)`

**Explanation:** Classes implementing AutoCloseable can be declared in try(); JVM calls close() at end of block even if exception.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static class MyResource implements AutoCloseable {
        MyResource() { System.out.println("Resource opened"); }
        void use()   { System.out.println("Resource used"); }

        @Override
        public void close() { System.out.println("Resource closed (auto)"); }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try (MyResource r = new MyResource()) {
            r.use();
        }
        // close() is called automatically here
        System.out.println("After try-with-resources block");
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1339. Exception Propagation
**ID:** `EXCEPTION-1339`

**Problem:** Exception Handling Program: Exception Propagation.

**Example Input:** `call chain: main → level2 → level1 → divide(10,0)`

**Example Output:** `ArithmeticException propagated up call stack and caught in main`

**Explanation:** Uncaught exceptions propagate up the call stack; the first matching catch block handles them.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static int divide(int a, int b) { return a / b; }          // throws ArithmeticException

    static int level1(int a, int b) { return divide(a, b); }  // propagates up

    static int level2(int a, int b) { return level1(a, b); }  // propagates up

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            int result = level2(10, 0);
            System.out.println("Result: " + result);
        } catch (ArithmeticException e) {
            System.out.println("Caught in main: " + e.getMessage());
            System.out.println("Exception propagated through: level2 → level1 → divide");
        }
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n) stack

### 1340. Multiple Catch Blocks
**ID:** `EXCEPTION-1340`

**Problem:** Exception Handling Program: Multiple Catch Blocks.

**Example Input:** `various operations that may throw different exceptions`

**Example Output:** `Each exception type caught by its specific handler`

**Explanation:** Order catch blocks from most-specific to most-general; unreachable catch blocks cause a compile error.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Object[] tests = {null, "abc", 1, new int[]{1,2,3}};

        for (Object obj : tests) {
            try {
                String s = (String) obj;          // may throw ClassCastException
                System.out.println(s.toUpperCase()); // may throw NullPointerException
                int[] arr = (int[]) obj;
                System.out.println(arr[10]);      // may throw ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
            } catch (NullPointerException e) {
                System.out.println("NPE: " + e.getMessage());
            } catch (ClassCastException e) {
                System.out.println("ClassCast: " + e.getMessage());
            } catch (ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException e) {
                System.out.println("ArrayOOB: " + e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1341. Finally Block Demo
**ID:** `EXCEPTION-1341`

**Problem:** Exception Handling Program: Finally Block Demo.

**Example Input:** `method that returns inside try and catch`

**Example Output:** `Finally runs even when return or exception short-circuits the block`

**Explanation:** finally block always executes regardless of whether an exception occurs or a return statement exits try/catch.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static String test(int x) {
        try {
            if (x == 0) throw new ArithmeticException("zero");
            return "try: " + x;
        } catch (ArithmeticException e) {
            return "catch: " + e.getMessage();
        } finally {
            System.out.println("finally block always runs (x=" + x + ")");
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.println(test(5));
        System.out.println(test(0));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1343. Throws Keyword

**Explanation:** throws in the method signature advertises that callers must handle or propagate the checked exception.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.io.*;

public class Solution {
    // Declares checked exception — caller must handle or re-declare
    static String readFirstLine(String path) throws IOException {
        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(path))) {
            return br.readLine();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            String line = readFirstLine("sample.txt");
            System.out.println("First line: " + line);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            System.out.println("IOException: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

### 1344. Global Error Handling Pattern
**ID:** `EXCEPTION-1344`

**Problem:** Exception Handling Program: Global Error Handling Pattern.

**Example Input:** `uncaught exception in thread`

**Example Output:** `Default uncaught handler logs and exits gracefully`

**Explanation:** Thread.setDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler() catches all unhandled exceptions system-wide for logging/alerting.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Set a global uncaught exception handler
        Thread.setDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler((thread, ex) -> {
            System.err.println("[GLOBAL HANDLER] Thread: " + thread.getName());
            System.err.println("[GLOBAL HANDLER] Exception: " + ex.getMessage());
            // In production: log to file / monitoring system
        });

        // Throw an unhandled exception in a new thread
        Thread t = new Thread(() -> {
            throw new RuntimeException("Something went wrong!");
        }, "worker-thread");
        t.start();

        // Main thread remains unaffected
        System.out.println("Main thread continues normally");
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

```java
public class Solution {

}
```

### 1346. Custom Exception Class
**ID:** `EXC-1346`

**Problem:** Define custom checked and unchecked exceptions for domain-specific errors.

**Example Input:** `deposit negative amount → InsufficientFundsException`

**Example Output:** `Custom exception message displayed`

**Explanation:** Checked: extends Exception (must declare/catch). Unchecked: extends RuntimeException (optional).

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static class InsufficientFundsException extends Exception {
        private final double amount;
        InsufficientFundsException(double amt){super("Insufficient funds: needed "+amt);this.amount=amt;}
        double getAmount(){return amount;}
    }
    static void withdraw(double balance,double amt) throws InsufficientFundsException {
        if(amt>balance) throw new InsufficientFundsException(amt);
        System.out.println("Withdrew "+amt+", balance="+(balance-amt));
    }
    public static void main(String[] a){
        try{ withdraw(100.0,150.0); }
        catch(InsufficientFundsException e){ System.out.println("Error: "+e.getMessage()); }
        try{ withdraw(100.0,50.0); }
        catch(InsufficientFundsException e){ System.out.println("Error: "+e.getMessage()); }
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

```java
public class Solution {

            }
        }

}
```

### 1348. Try-with-Resources (AutoCloseable)
**ID:** `EXC-1348`

**Problem:** Resources opened in try() are automatically closed even if exception thrown.

**Example Input:** `Open temp file reader; exception inside try block`

**Example Output:** `Reader closed before catch executes`

**Explanation:** AutoCloseable.close() called in reverse order. Suppressed exceptions preserved.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
public class Solution {
    static class MyResource implements AutoCloseable {
        String name;
        MyResource(String n){name=n;System.out.println("Opening "+n);}
        public void close(){System.out.println("Closing "+n);}
    }
    public static void main(String[] a){
        try(MyResource r1=new MyResource("R1");MyResource r2=new MyResource("R2")){
            System.out.println("Using R1 and R2");
            // closed in reverse: R2, then R1
        }
        System.out.println("After try-with-resources");
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1349. Chained Exceptions
**ID:** `EXC-1349`

**Problem:** Wrap low-level exception in higher-level domain exception (exception chaining).

**Example Input:** `IOException from DB → wrapped in ServiceException`

**Example Output:** `getMessage and getCause both accessible`

**Explanation:** new MyException("msg", cause) — cause is accessible via getCause(). Preserves root cause stack trace.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.io.*;
public class Solution {
    static class ServiceException extends RuntimeException {
        ServiceException(String msg,Throwable cause){super(msg,cause);}
    }
    static void callDB() throws IOException { throw new IOException("Connection refused"); }
    static void callService(){
        try{ callDB(); }
        catch(IOException e){ throw new ServiceException("DB call failed",e); }
    }
    public static void main(String[] a){
        try{ callService(); }
        catch(ServiceException e){
            System.out.println("ServiceException: "+e.getMessage());
            System.out.println("Cause: "+e.getCause().getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1350. Re-throw and Exception Translation
**ID:** `EXC-1350`

**Problem:** Catch exception, log/process it, then re-throw same or new exception.

**Example Input:** `Parse invalid JSON → wrap in ApplicationException`

**Example Output:** `Root cause preserved; higher-level message added`

**Explanation:** throw e (re-throw same); throw new Ex("msg", e) (translate). Don't swallow silently.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static class ApplicationException extends RuntimeException {
        ApplicationException(String msg,Throwable t){super(msg,t);}
    }
    static void parseConfig(String s){
        try{ Integer.parseInt(s); }
        catch(NumberFormatException e){ throw new ApplicationException("Invalid config value: "+s,e); }
    }
    public static void main(String[] a){
        try{ parseConfig("not-a-number"); }
        catch(ApplicationException e){
            System.out.println(e.getMessage());
            System.out.println("Root: "+e.getCause().getClass().getSimpleName());
        }
        // successful case
        try{ parseConfig("42"); System.out.println("Parsed: 42"); }
        catch(ApplicationException e){ System.out.println(e.getMessage()); }
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1351. finally vs return — Execution Order
**ID:** `EXC-1351`

**Problem:** Demonstrate that finally always runs, even when try/catch has a return statement.

**Example Input:** `method returns from try; finally still executes`

**Example Output:** `finally block runs before method returns`

**Explanation:** finally runs after return expression is evaluated but before control returns to caller.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static int method(){
        try{
            System.out.println("try");
            return 1;
        }catch(Exception e){
            System.out.println("catch");
            return 2;
        }finally{
            System.out.println("finally always runs"); // runs before return
            // returning from finally would override try's return — avoid this!
        }
    }
    public static void main(String[] a){
        int result=method();
        System.out.println("returned: "+result);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1352. Exception in Initializer and Static Block
**ID:** `EXC-1352`

**Problem:** Handle exceptions in static initializer blocks and instance initializers.

**Example Input:** `Static block throws; caught in main via ExceptionInInitializerError`

**Example Output:** `ExceptionInInitializerError wraps the original exception`

**Explanation:** Unchecked exceptions in static blocks become ExceptionInInitializerError. Subsequent loads get NoClassDefFoundError.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static int safeDiv(int a,int b){
        try{ return a/b; }
        catch(ArithmeticException e){ System.out.println("safeDiv: "+e.getMessage()); return -1; }
    }
    static class Config {
        static final int MAX;
        static { MAX=safeDiv(100,5); System.out.println("Static init: MAX="+MAX); }
    }
    public static void main(String[] a){
        System.out.println("Config.MAX="+Config.MAX);
        // Exception in instance initializer
        try{
            Object obj=new Object(){ { if(true) throw new RuntimeException("init failed"); } };
        }catch(RuntimeException e){ System.out.println("Instance init caught: "+e.getMessage()); }
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1353. StackOverflowError — Infinite Recursion
**ID:** `EXC-1353`

**Problem:** Demonstrate StackOverflowError; catch it (it is an Error, not Exception).

**Example Input:** `infinite recursive method`

**Example Output:** `StackOverflowError caught; depth shown`

**Explanation:** StackOverflowError extends VirtualMachineError extends Error. Catchable but usually not recoverable.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static int depth=0;
    static void recurse(){ depth++; recurse(); }
    public static void main(String[] a){
        try{ recurse(); }
        catch(StackOverflowError e){ System.out.println("StackOverflowError at depth~"+depth); }
        // Normal recursion after catching
        System.out.println("Continuing after SOE catch...");
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(stack) &nbsp; **Space:** O(stack)

### 1354. NullPointerException — Safe Navigation
**ID:** `EXC-1354`

**Problem:** Avoid NPE using null checks, Optional, and defensive programming.

**Example Input:** `null string; call .length() without check`

**Example Output:** `NPE caught; safe version returns 0`

**Explanation:** Java 14+ NPE messages name the null variable. Use Optional.ofNullable().map() for safe chaining.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
public class Solution {
    static int safeLength(String s){ return s==null?0:s.length(); }
    static int optionalLength(String s){ return Optional.ofNullable(s).map(String::length).orElse(0); }
    public static void main(String[] a){
        try{ String s=null; System.out.println(s.length()); }
        catch(NullPointerException e){ System.out.println("NPE: "+e.getClass().getSimpleName()); }
        System.out.println("safeLength(null)="+safeLength(null));
        System.out.println("safeLength(hello)="+safeLength("hello"));
        System.out.println("optional(null)="+optionalLength(null));
        System.out.println("optional(hi)="+optionalLength("hi"));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

## Design Pattern Coding Examples


### 1355. Singleton Pattern
**ID:** `DESIGN-1355`

**Problem:** Singleton Pattern.

**Example Input:** getInstance() called multiple times

**Example Output:** same instance returned each time

**Explanation:** Lazy initialization with double-checked locking; volatile + synchronized for thread safety.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static volatile Solution instance;
    private Solution(){System.out.println("Creating singleton");}
    public static Solution getInstance(){
        if(instance==null) synchronized(Solution.class){
            if(instance==null) instance=new Solution();
        }
        return instance;
    }
    public static void main(String[] args){
        Solution s1=Solution.getInstance();
        Solution s2=Solution.getInstance();
        System.out.println(s1==s2); // true — same instance
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1356. Factory Pattern
**ID:** `DESIGN-1356`

**Problem:** Factory Pattern.

**Example Input:** ShapeFactory.create("circle")

**Example Output:** Circle object drawn

**Explanation:** Factory method encapsulates object creation; client uses factory, not constructors directly.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    interface Shape{void draw();}
    static class Circle implements Shape{public void draw(){System.out.println("Drawing Circle");}}
    static class Rectangle implements Shape{public void draw(){System.out.println("Drawing Rectangle");}}
    static class ShapeFactory{
        static Shape create(String type){
            return switch(type.toLowerCase()){
                case "circle" -> new Circle();
                case "rectangle" -> new Rectangle();
                default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown: "+type);
            };
        }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args){
        Shape s=ShapeFactory.create("circle");
        s.draw(); // Drawing Circle
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1357. Abstract Factory Pattern
**ID:** `DESIGN-1357`

**Problem:** Abstract Factory Pattern.

**Example Input:** UIFactory for Windows/Mac creates Button+Checkbox

**Example Output:** platform-specific UI components

**Explanation:** AbstractFactory interface creates families of related objects; concrete factories for each platform.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    interface Button{void click();}
    interface Checkbox{void check();}
    interface UIFactory{Button createButton();Checkbox createCheckbox();}
    static class WinButton implements Button{public void click(){System.out.println("Windows Button clicked");}}
    static class WinCheckbox implements Checkbox{public void check(){System.out.println("Windows Checkbox checked");}}
    static class WinFactory implements UIFactory{
        public Button createButton(){return new WinButton();}
        public Checkbox createCheckbox(){return new WinCheckbox();}
    }
    static void renderUI(UIFactory f){
        f.createButton().click();
        f.createCheckbox().check();
    }
    public static void main(String[] args){
        renderUI(new WinFactory()); // Windows Button clicked / Windows Checkbox checked
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1358. Builder Pattern
**ID:** `DESIGN-1358`

**Problem:** Builder Pattern.

**Example Input:** PersonBuilder with name/age/email

**Example Output:** Person object with all fields set

**Explanation:** Builder separates construction from representation; chaining setters return builder; build() creates object.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static class Person{
        String name;int age;String email;
        private Person(Builder b){name=b.name;age=b.age;email=b.email;}
        public String toString(){return "Person{"+name+","+age+","+email+"}";}
        static class Builder{
            String name;int age;String email;
            Builder name(String n){name=n;return this;}
            Builder age(int a){age=a;return this;}
            Builder email(String e){email=e;return this;}
            Person build(){return new Person(this);}
        }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args){
        Person p=new Person.Builder().name("Alice").age(30).email("alice@example.com").build();
        System.out.println(p); // Person{Alice,30,alice@example.com}
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1359. Prototype Pattern
**ID:** `DESIGN-1359`

**Problem:** Prototype Pattern.

**Example Input:** clone Employee object

**Example Output:** deep copy with same field values

**Explanation:** Implement Cloneable; override clone(); call super.clone() for shallow copy; deep copy mutable fields.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static class Employee implements Cloneable{
        String name;int age;
        Employee(String n,int a){name=n;age=a;}
        @Override public Employee clone(){
            try{return (Employee)super.clone();}
            catch(CloneNotSupportedException e){throw new RuntimeException(e);}
        }
        public String toString(){return name+":"+age;}
    }
    public static void main(String[] args){
        Employee orig=new Employee("Alice",30);
        Employee clone=orig.clone();
        clone.name="Bob";
        System.out.println(orig);  // Alice:30  (unchanged)
        System.out.println(clone); // Bob:30
        System.out.println(orig==clone); // false
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1360. Adapter Pattern
**ID:** `DESIGN-1360`

**Problem:** Adapter Pattern.

**Example Input:** OldLogger uses print(); NewLogger uses log(); Adapter bridges them

**Example Output:** OldLogger works with new interface

**Explanation:** Adapter wraps incompatible class; implements target interface; delegates to adaptee.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    interface Logger{void log(String msg);}
    static class OldLogger{void print(String msg){System.out.println("[OLD] "+msg);}}
    static class LoggerAdapter implements Logger{
        OldLogger old;
        LoggerAdapter(OldLogger o){old=o;}
        public void log(String msg){old.print(msg);}
    }
    static void process(Logger logger){
        logger.log("Processing data");
    }
    public static void main(String[] args){
        Logger adapter=new LoggerAdapter(new OldLogger());
        process(adapter); // [OLD] Processing data
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1361. Decorator Pattern
**ID:** `DESIGN-1361`

**Problem:** Decorator Pattern.

**Example Input:** Coffee with Milk and Sugar decorators

**Example Output:** total price and description

**Explanation:** Decorators wrap component; each adds behaviour before/after delegating to wrapped component.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    interface Coffee{String desc();double cost();}
    static class SimpleCoffee implements Coffee{
        public String desc(){return "Coffee";}
        public double cost(){return 1.0;}
    }
    static abstract class CoffeeDecorator implements Coffee{
        Coffee coffee;
        CoffeeDecorator(Coffee c){coffee=c;}
    }
    static class Milk extends CoffeeDecorator{
        Milk(Coffee c){super(c);}
        public String desc(){return coffee.desc()+", Milk";}
        public double cost(){return coffee.cost()+0.25;}
    }
    static class Sugar extends CoffeeDecorator{
        Sugar(Coffee c){super(c);}
        public String desc(){return coffee.desc()+", Sugar";}
        public double cost(){return coffee.cost()+0.10;}
    }
    public static void main(String[] args){
        Coffee c=new Sugar(new Milk(new SimpleCoffee()));
        System.out.println(c.desc()+" $"+c.cost()); // Coffee, Milk, Sugar $1.35
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1362. Facade Pattern
**ID:** `DESIGN-1362`

**Problem:** Facade Pattern.

**Example Input:** HomeTheaterFacade hides TV/Sound/Streaming complexity

**Example Output:** one-line watchMovie() call

**Explanation:** Facade provides simple interface; internally coordinates multiple subsystem components.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static class TV{void on(){System.out.println("TV ON");}void off(){System.out.println("TV OFF");}}
    static class Sound{void on(){System.out.println("Sound ON");}void off(){System.out.println("Sound OFF");}}
    static class Streaming{void start(){System.out.println("Streaming started");}void stop(){System.out.println("Streaming stopped");}}
    static class HomeTheaterFacade{
        TV tv=new TV();Sound s=new Sound();Streaming st=new Streaming();
        void watchMovie(){tv.on();s.on();st.start();}
        void endMovie(){st.stop();s.off();tv.off();}
    }
    public static void main(String[] args){
        HomeTheaterFacade ht=new HomeTheaterFacade();
        ht.watchMovie();
        System.out.println("--- Watching ---");
        ht.endMovie();
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1363. Proxy Pattern
**ID:** `DESIGN-1363`

**Problem:** Proxy Pattern.

**Example Input:** ImageProxy delays loading real image until display()

**Example Output:** lazy loading with access control

**Explanation:** Proxy implements same interface; controls access to RealSubject; creates it only on demand.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    interface Image{void display();}
    static class RealImage implements Image{
        String file;
        RealImage(String f){file=f;System.out.println("Loading "+f);}
        public void display(){System.out.println("Displaying "+file);}
    }
    static class ImageProxy implements Image{
        String file;RealImage real;
        ImageProxy(String f){file=f;}
        public void display(){if(real==null)real=new RealImage(file);real.display();}
    }
    public static void main(String[] args){
        Image img=new ImageProxy("photo.jpg");
        System.out.println("Proxy created (not loaded yet)");
        img.display(); // Loading photo.jpg then Displaying
        img.display(); // Displaying (already loaded)
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1364. Strategy Pattern
**ID:** `DESIGN-1364`

**Problem:** Strategy Pattern.

**Example Input:** Sorter using BubbleSort or QuickSort strategy

**Example Output:** sorted array via chosen strategy

**Explanation:** Strategy interface defines algorithm; concrete strategies implement it; context delegates to strategy.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.Arrays;
public class Solution {
    interface SortStrategy{void sort(int[] arr);}
    static class BubbleSort implements SortStrategy{
        public void sort(int[] arr){
            for(int i=0;i<arr.length-1;i++) for(int j=0;j<arr.length-1-i;j++) if(arr[j]>arr[j+1]){int t=arr[j];arr[j]=arr[j+1];arr[j+1]=t;}
            System.out.println("BubbleSort: "+Arrays.toString(arr));
        }
    }
    static class Sorter{SortStrategy strategy;Sorter(SortStrategy s){strategy=s;}void sort(int[] arr){strategy.sort(arr);}}
    public static void main(String[] args){
        int[] data={5,3,1,4,2};
        new Sorter(new BubbleSort()).sort(data);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n^2) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1365. Observer Pattern
**ID:** `DESIGN-1365`

**Problem:** Observer Pattern.

**Example Input:** EventBus publishes event; multiple subscribers notified

**Example Output:** all registered listeners receive event

**Explanation:** Subject holds list of Observers; notifyAll() calls update() on each; loosely coupled.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
public class Solution {
    interface Observer{void update(String event);}
    static class EventBus{
        List<Observer> obs=new ArrayList<>();
        void subscribe(Observer o){obs.add(o);}
        void publish(String event){obs.forEach(o->o.update(event));}
    }
    public static void main(String[] args){
        EventBus bus=new EventBus();
        bus.subscribe(e->System.out.println("Logger: "+e));
        bus.subscribe(e->System.out.println("Alerter: "+e));
        bus.publish("UserLoggedIn");
        bus.publish("OrderPlaced");
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

### 1366. Template Method Pattern
**ID:** `DESIGN-1366`

**Problem:** Template Method Pattern.

**Example Input:** DataProcessor with doProcess() template; CSV and JSON subclasses

**Example Output:** process steps called in order

```java
public class Solution {

            readData();
            processData();
            writeResult();
        }

    }
```

### 1367. Command Pattern
**ID:** `DESIGN-1367`

**Problem:** Command Pattern.

**Example Input:** RemoteControl with on/off commands for Light

**Example Output:** encapsulated commands, supports undo

**Explanation:** Command interface with execute()/undo(); ConcreteCommand holds receiver; Invoker stores command history.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
public class Solution {
    interface Command{void execute();void undo();}
    static class Light{void on(){System.out.println("Light ON");}void off(){System.out.println("Light OFF");}}
    static class LightOn implements Command{
        Light light;LightOn(Light l){light=l;}
        public void execute(){light.on();}
        public void undo(){light.off();}
    }
    static class RemoteControl{
        Deque<Command> history=new ArrayDeque<>();
        void press(Command c){c.execute();history.push(c);}
        void pressUndo(){if(!history.isEmpty())history.pop().undo();}
    }
    public static void main(String[] args){
        Light l=new Light();RemoteControl r=new RemoteControl();
        r.press(new LightOn(l)); // Light ON
        r.pressUndo();           // Light OFF
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

### 1368. State Pattern
**ID:** `DESIGN-1368`

**Problem:** State Pattern.

**Example Input:** VendingMachine transitions Idle->HasCoin->Dispensing->Idle

**Example Output:** correct state transitions

**Explanation:** State interface; context delegates to current state; each state handles transitions and actions.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    interface State{void insertCoin();void dispense();}
    static class VendingMachine{
        State idle,hasCoin,current;
        VendingMachine(){
            idle=new State(){
                public void insertCoin(){System.out.println("Coin inserted");current=hasCoin;}
                public void dispense(){System.out.println("Insert coin first");}
            };
            hasCoin=new State(){
                public void insertCoin(){System.out.println("Coin already in");}
                public void dispense(){System.out.println("Item dispensed");current=idle;}
            };
            current=idle;
        }
        void insertCoin(){current.insertCoin();}
        void dispense(){current.dispense();}
    }
    public static void main(String[] args){
        VendingMachine vm=new VendingMachine();
        vm.dispense();    // Insert coin first
        vm.insertCoin();  // Coin inserted
        vm.insertCoin();  // Coin already in
        vm.dispense();    // Item dispensed
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1369. Visitor Pattern
**ID:** `DESIGN-1369`

**Problem:** Visitor Pattern.

**Example Input:** ShapeVisitor computes area for Circle and Rectangle

**Example Output:** area values without changing shape classes

**Explanation:** Visitor adds operations to element hierarchy; accept(visitor) double dispatches to correct visit() method.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    interface Shape{void accept(Visitor v);}
    interface Visitor{void visit(Circle c);void visit(Rectangle r);}
    static class Circle implements Shape{double radius;Circle(double r){radius=r;}public void accept(Visitor v){v.visit(this);}}
    static class Rectangle implements Shape{double w,h;Rectangle(double w,double h){this.w=w;this.h=h;}public void accept(Visitor v){v.visit(this);}}
    static class AreaVisitor implements Visitor{
        public void visit(Circle c){System.out.printf("Circle area: %.2f%n",Math.PI*c.radius*c.radius);}
        public void visit(Rectangle r){System.out.printf("Rectangle area: %.2f%n",r.w*r.h);}
    }
    public static void main(String[] args){
        Shape[] shapes={new Circle(5),new Rectangle(4,6)};
        AreaVisitor av=new AreaVisitor();
        for(Shape s:shapes) s.accept(av);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1371. Factory Method Pattern
**ID:** `PATTERNDESIGN-1371`

**Problem:** Define interface for creating objects; let subclasses decide which class to instantiate.

**Example Input:** `ShapeFactory.create('circle') and create('rectangle')`

**Example Output:** `Circle area; Rectangle area`

**Explanation:** Factory Method: creator declares abstract factory method; concrete creators override it.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    interface Shape { double area(); }
    static class Circle implements Shape { double r; Circle(double r){this.r=r;} public double area(){return Math.PI*r*r;} }
    static class Rectangle implements Shape { double w,h; Rectangle(double w,double h){this.w=w;this.h=h;} public double area(){return w*h;} }
    static Shape create(String type, double... dims){
        return switch(type){
            case "circle"->new Circle(dims[0]);
            case "rectangle"->new Rectangle(dims[0],dims[1]);
            default->throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown: "+type);
        };
    }
    public static void main(String[] a){
        System.out.printf("Circle area: %.2f%n",create("circle",5).area());
        System.out.printf("Rectangle area: %.2f%n",create("rectangle",4,6).area());
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1372. Builder Pattern
**ID:** `PATTERNDESIGN-1372`

**Problem:** Construct complex objects step by step using a fluent builder API.

**Example Input:** `new Person.Builder('Alice').age(30).email('a@b.com').build()`

**Example Output:** `Person{name=Alice, age=30, email=a@b.com}`

**Explanation:** Builder: avoids telescoping constructors. setX().setY().build(). Optional fields have defaults.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static class Person {
        private final String name,email; private final int age;
        private Person(Builder b){name=b.name;age=b.age;email=b.email;}
        public String toString(){return "Person{name="+name+", age="+age+", email="+email+"}";}
        static class Builder {
            private final String name; private int age=0; private String email="";
            Builder(String name){this.name=name;}
            Builder age(int a){age=a;return this;}
            Builder email(String e){email=e;return this;}
            Person build(){return new Person(this);}
        }
    }
    public static void main(String[] a){
        Person p=new Person.Builder("Alice").age(30).email("a@b.com").build();
        System.out.println(p);
        Person min=new Person.Builder("Bob").build(); // optional fields use defaults
        System.out.println(min);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1373. Abstract Factory Pattern

**Problem:** Create families of related objects without specifying concrete classes.

```java
public class Solution {

    interface Checkbox{void render();}
    interface UIFactory{Button createButton();Checkbox createCheckbox();}
    static class LightButton implements Button{public void render(){System.out.println("Light Button");}}
```

### 1374. Prototype Pattern
**ID:** `PATTERNDESIGN-1374`

**Problem:** Create new objects by cloning existing instances.

**Example Input:** `Clone a configured ReportTemplate`

**Example Output:** `Cloned object is independent of original`

**Explanation:** Implement Cloneable.clone() (shallow) or copy constructor (deep). Useful when creation is expensive.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static class ReportTemplate implements Cloneable {
        String title; int[] data;
        ReportTemplate(String t,int[] d){title=t;data=d.clone();}
        public ReportTemplate clone(){try{ReportTemplate c=(ReportTemplate)super.clone();c.data=data.clone();return c;}catch(CloneNotSupportedException e){throw new RuntimeException(e);}}
        public String toString(){return "Report{title="+title+",data="+java.util.Arrays.toString(data)+"}";}
    }
    public static void main(String[] a){
        ReportTemplate orig=new ReportTemplate("Q1 Report",new int[]{100,200,300});
        ReportTemplate clone=orig.clone();
        clone.title="Q2 Report"; clone.data[0]=150;
        System.out.println("original: "+orig); // unchanged
        System.out.println("clone: "+clone);
        System.out.println("same object: "+(orig==clone));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) deep &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

### 1375. Adapter Pattern
**ID:** `PATTERNDESIGN-1375`

**Problem:** Convert incompatible interface to compatible one without changing existing code.

**Example Input:** `OldPrinter.printOld(str) adapted to Printer.print(str)`

**Example Output:** `Adapter delegates to old interface transparently`

**Explanation:** Adapter: wraps incompatible class. Object adapter (composition) preferred over class adapter.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    interface Printer{void print(String msg);}
    // Legacy class with incompatible interface
    static class OldPrinter{void printOld(String msg){System.out.println("[OLD] "+msg);}}
    // Adapter makes OldPrinter compatible with Printer
    static class PrinterAdapter implements Printer {
        private final OldPrinter old;
        PrinterAdapter(OldPrinter o){old=o;}
        public void print(String msg){old.printOld(msg);}
    }
    static void clientCode(Printer p){p.print("Hello, World!");}
    public static void main(String[] a){
        Printer modern=msg->System.out.println("[NEW] "+msg);
        clientCode(modern);
        clientCode(new PrinterAdapter(new OldPrinter()));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1376. Decorator Pattern
**ID:** `PATTERNDESIGN-1376`

**Problem:** Add responsibilities to objects dynamically by wrapping them.

**Example Input:** `Coffee → + Milk → + Sugar → + Vanilla`

**Example Output:** `Cost and description accumulate through wrappers`

**Explanation:** Decorator implements same interface and wraps another. Stacking adds behavior without subclassing.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    interface Coffee{String desc();double cost();}
    static class SimpleCoffee implements Coffee{public String desc(){return "Coffee";}public double cost(){return 1.0;}}
    static abstract class CoffeeDecorator implements Coffee{protected Coffee c;CoffeeDecorator(Coffee c){this.c=c;}}
    static class Milk extends CoffeeDecorator{Milk(Coffee c){super(c);}public String desc(){return c.desc()+", Milk";}public double cost(){return c.cost()+0.25;}}
    static class Sugar extends CoffeeDecorator{Sugar(Coffee c){super(c);}public String desc(){return c.desc()+", Sugar";}public double cost(){return c.cost()+0.10;}}
    static class Vanilla extends CoffeeDecorator{Vanilla(Coffee c){super(c);}public String desc(){return c.desc()+", Vanilla";}public double cost(){return c.cost()+0.50;}}
    public static void main(String[] a){
        Coffee c=new Vanilla(new Sugar(new Milk(new SimpleCoffee())));
        System.out.println(c.desc());
        System.out.printf("Cost: $%.2f%n",c.cost());
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(k) layers &nbsp; **Space:** O(k)

### 1377. Facade Pattern
**ID:** `PATTERNDESIGN-1377`

**Problem:** Provide simplified interface to a complex subsystem.

```java
public class Solution {
    static class TV{void on(){System.out.println("TV on");}void off(){System.out.println("TV off");}}
    static class SoundSystem{void on(){System.out.println("Sound on");}void setVolume(int v){System.out.println("Volume: "+v);}void off(){System.out.println("Sound off");}}
    static class Lights{void dim(int pct){System.out.println("Lights dim to "+pct+"%");}void on(){System.out.println("Lights full");}}
    static class HomeTheater {
        TV tv=new TV(); SoundSystem s=new SoundSystem(); Lights l=new Lights();
        void watchMovie(){System.out.println("--- Starting movie ---");l.dim(20);tv.on();s.on();s.setVolume(30);}
        void endMovie(){System.out.println("--- Ending movie ---");s.off();tv.off();l.on();}
    }
    public static void main(String[] a){
        HomeTheater ht=new HomeTheater();
        ht.watchMovie(); System.out.println("...watching.."); ht.endMovie();
    }
}
```

### 1378. Proxy Pattern
**ID:** `PATTERNDESIGN-1378`

**Problem:** Provide surrogate for another object to control access (lazy init, logging, security).

**Example Input:** `ProxyImage delays real image loading until display() called`

**Example Output:** `Loading... only once; cached on 2nd call`

**Explanation:** Proxy: same interface as subject. Can add caching, security, logging, remote access.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    interface Image{void display();}
    static class RealImage implements Image{String f;RealImage(String f){this.f=f;System.out.println("Loading "+f);}public void display(){System.out.println("Displaying "+f);}}
    static class ProxyImage implements Image{
        String f; RealImage real;
        ProxyImage(String f){this.f=f;}
        public void display(){if(real==null) real=new RealImage(f);real.display();}
    }
    public static void main(String[] a){
        Image img=new ProxyImage("photo.jpg");
        img.display(); // loads then displays
        img.display(); // only displays (cached)
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1379. Observer Pattern
**ID:** `PATTERNDESIGN-1379`

**Problem:** Define one-to-many dependency; when Subject changes, all Observers are notified.

**Example Input:** `StockTicker subject; two observers notified on price change`

**Example Output:** `Both observers receive updated price`

**Explanation:** Observer/EventListener: Subject maintains list; notify() calls update() on each Observer.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
public class Solution {
    interface Observer{void update(double price);}
    static class StockTicker {
        private List<Observer> obs=new ArrayList<>(); private double price;
        void subscribe(Observer o){obs.add(o);}
        void setPrice(double p){price=p;obs.forEach(o->o.update(p));}
    }
    public static void main(String[] a){
        StockTicker ticker=new StockTicker();
        ticker.subscribe(p->System.out.printf("Investor A: price=%.2f%n",p));
        ticker.subscribe(p->System.out.printf("Investor B: price=%.2f%n",p));
        ticker.setPrice(100.0); ticker.setPrice(105.5);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

### 1380. Strategy Pattern
**ID:** `PATTERNDESIGN-1380`

**Problem:** Define family of algorithms; encapsulate each and make them interchangeable.

**Example Input:** `Sorter with bubble/merge/quick strategy`

**Example Output:** `Sorted output depends on chosen strategy`

**Explanation:** Strategy: pass algorithm as lambda or object. Eliminates if-else chains for algorithm selection.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
public class Solution {
    interface SortStrategy{void sort(int[] a);}
    static class Sorter{
        private SortStrategy s;
        Sorter(SortStrategy s){this.s=s;}
        void sort(int[] a){s.sort(a);}
    }
    public static void main(String[] a){
        int[] arr1={5,2,8,1,9}; int[] arr2=arr1.clone();
        // Strategy 1: Arrays.sort (Tim sort)
        Sorter s1=new Sorter(Arrays::sort);
        s1.sort(arr1); System.out.println("TimSort: "+Arrays.toString(arr1));
        // Strategy 2: reverse sort
        Sorter s2=new Sorter(x->{Arrays.sort(x);for(int i=0,j=x.length-1;i<j;i++,j--){int t=x[i];x[i]=x[j];x[j]=t;}});
        s2.sort(arr2); System.out.println("Reverse: "+Arrays.toString(arr2));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n log n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

### 1381. Template Method Pattern
**ID:** `PATTERNDESIGN-1381`

**Problem:** Define skeleton of algorithm in base class; subclasses fill in specific steps.

**Example Input:** `DataProcessor.process() calls read→parse→analyze→report`

```java
public class Solution {

        final void process(){read();parse();analyze();report();}
        void read(){System.out.println("Reading data...");}
        abstract void parse();
        abstract void analyze();
        void report(){System.out.println("Reporting results");}
    }
    static class CSVProcessor extends DataProcessor {

        void analyze(){System.out.println("Analyzing CSV columns");}
    }
    static class JSONProcessor extends DataProcessor {
        void parse(){System.out.println("Parsing JSON");}
        void analyze(){System.out.println("Analyzing JSON tree");}
        void report(){System.out.println("JSON Report generated");}
    }
    public static void main(String[] a){

}
```

### 1382. Command Pattern
**ID:** `PATTERNDESIGN-1382`

**Problem:** Encapsulate requests as objects; support undo, queuing, and logging.

**Example Input:** `Execute open/close door commands; undo last`

**Example Output:** `Commands execute; undo reverses last action`

**Explanation:** Command: encapsulates action+receiver. Invoker calls execute(). Stack enables undo.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
public class Solution {
    interface Command{void execute();void undo();}
    static class Door{boolean open=false;void open(){open=true;System.out.println("Door opened");}void close(){open=false;System.out.println("Door closed");}}
    public static void main(String[] a){
        Door door=new Door();
        Command openCmd=new Command(){public void execute(){door.open();}public void undo(){door.close();}};
        Command closeCmd=new Command(){public void execute(){door.close();}public void undo(){door.open();}};
        Deque<Command> history=new ArrayDeque<>();
        openCmd.execute(); history.push(openCmd);
        closeCmd.execute(); history.push(closeCmd);
        System.out.println("=Undo=");
        while(!history.isEmpty()) history.pop().undo();
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n) history

### 1383. State Pattern
**ID:** `PATTERNDESIGN-1383`

**Problem:** Allow object to alter behavior when internal state changes.

**Example Input:** `TrafficLight cycles: Red→Green→Yellow→Red`

**Example Output:** `Each state prints its action and transitions to next`

**Explanation:** State pattern: object delegates behavior to current State object. State changes via setState().

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    interface TrafficState{void handle(TrafficLight light);}
    static class TrafficLight{
        private TrafficState state;
        TrafficLight(){state=new RedState();}
        void setState(TrafficState s){state=s;}
        void change(){state.handle(this);}
    }
    static class RedState implements TrafficState{public void handle(TrafficLight l){System.out.println("RED: Stop");l.setState(new GreenState());}}
    static class GreenState implements TrafficState{public void handle(TrafficLight l){System.out.println("GREEN: Go");l.setState(new YellowState());}}
    static class YellowState implements TrafficState{public void handle(TrafficLight l){System.out.println("YELLOW: Slow");l.setState(new RedState());}}
    public static void main(String[] a){
        TrafficLight light=new TrafficLight();
        for(int i=0;i<6;i++) light.change();
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(states)

### 1384. Chain of Responsibility
**ID:** `PATTERNDESIGN-1384`

**Problem:** Pass request along a chain of handlers; each decides to handle or pass.

**Example Input:** `Support ticket: Level 1 → Level 2 → Level 3`

**Example Output:** `High-priority handled by L3; low by L1`

**Explanation:** Handler has successor reference. handleRequest(): if can handle, handle; else pass to next.

**Answer:**
```java
public class Solution {
    static abstract class SupportHandler {
        protected SupportHandler next;
        SupportHandler setNext(SupportHandler n){next=n;return n;}
        abstract void handle(int priority);
    }
    static class L1 extends SupportHandler{public void handle(int p){if(p<=1)System.out.println("L1 handles p="+p);else if(next!=null)next.handle(p);}}
    static class L2 extends SupportHandler{public void handle(int p){if(p<=2)System.out.println("L2 handles p="+p);else if(next!=null)next.handle(p);}}
    static class L3 extends SupportHandler{public void handle(int p){System.out.println("L3 handles p="+p);}}
    public static void main(String[] a){
        L1 l1=new L1(); L2 l2=new L2(); L3 l3=new L3();
        l1.setNext(l2).setNext(l3);
        for(int p:new int[]{1,2,3}) l1.handle(p);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(k) chain &nbsp; **Space:** O(k)

### 1385. LeetCode SQL 176 - Second Highest Salary

```sql
SELECT MAX(salary) AS SecondHighestSalary
FROM Employee
WHERE salary < (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM Employee);
```

### 1386. LeetCode SQL 177 - Nth Highest Salary
**ID:** `SQL-1386`

**Problem:** Write SQL query to solve: Nth Highest Salary.

**Example Input:** `Use the table rows given in the LeetCode problem statement.`

**Example Output:** `Return the rows/columns expected by the problem.`

**Explanation:** Identify key tables, joins, filters, grouping/window logic, then write the final query.

**Answer:**
```sql
CREATE FUNCTION getNthHighestSalary(N INT) RETURNS INT
BEGIN
  SET N = N - 1;
  RETURN (
    SELECT DISTINCT salary FROM Employee
    ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT N, 1
  );
END;
```

> **Time:** Depends on query plan &nbsp; **Space:** Depends on DB engine

### 1387. LeetCode SQL 178 - Rank Scores
**ID:** `SQL-1387`

**Problem:** Write SQL query to solve: Rank Scores.

**Example Input:** `Use the table rows given in the LeetCode problem statement.`

**Example Output:** `Return the rows/columns expected by the problem.`

**Explanation:** Identify key tables, joins, filters, grouping/window logic, then write the final query.

**Answer:**
```sql
SELECT score,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS `rank`
FROM Scores
```

### 1428. LeetCode SQL 1251 - Average Selling Price

**Example Input:** `Use the table rows given in the LeetCode problem statement.`

**Example Output:** `Return the rows/columns expected by the problem.`

**Explanation:** Identify key tables, joins, filters, grouping/window logic, then write the final query.

**Answer:**
```sql
SELECT p.product_id,
    COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(u.units*p.price)/SUM(u.units),2),0) AS average_price
FROM Prices p
LEFT JOIN UnitsSold u ON p.product_id=u.product_id
    AND u.purchase_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date
GROUP BY p.product_id;
```

### 1429. LeetCode SQL 1280 - Students and Examinations

**Example Output:** `Return the rows/columns expected by the problem.`

**Explanation:** Identify key tables, joins, filters, grouping/window logic, then write the final query.

**Answer:**
```sql
SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, sub.subject_name,
    COUNT(e.subject_name) AS attended_exams
FROM Students s
CROSS JOIN Subjects sub
LEFT JOIN Examinations e
    ON s.student_id=e.student_id AND sub.subject_name=e.subject_name
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.student_name, sub.subject_name
ORDER BY s.student_id, sub.subject_name;
```

### 1430. LeetCode SQL 1321 - Restaurant Growth

**Example Output:** `Return the rows/columns expected by the problem.`

**Answer:**
```sql
SELECT visited_on,
    SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount,
    ROUND(AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),2) AS average_amount
FROM (SELECT visited_on, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM Customer GROUP BY visited_on) t
ORDER BY visited_on
LIMIT 999999 OFFSET 6;
```

```sql
  SET N = N - 1;
  RETURN (
    SELECT DISTINCT salary FROM Employee
    ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT N, 1
  );
END;
```

**Example Output:** `Return the rows/columns expected by the problem.`

**Explanation:** Identify key tables, joins, filters, grouping/window logic, then write the final query.

**Answer:**
```sql
WITH first_orders AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) AS first_date
    FROM Delivery GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.order_date=d.customer_pref_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / COUNT(*), 2
) AS immediate_percentage
FROM Delivery d
JOIN first_orders f ON d.customer_id=f.customer_id AND d.order_date=f.first_date;
```

```java
// Complete Spring Boot REST application with CRUD

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import java.util.*;

@SpringBootApplication
public class Application {
    public static void main(String[] args) { SpringApplication.run(Application.class, args); }
}

@Entity class Product {
    @Id @GeneratedValue Long id;
    String name; Double price;
}

interface ProductRepository extends JpaRepository<Product, Long> {}

@Service class ProductService {
    private final ProductRepository repo;
    ProductService(ProductRepository r) { repo = r; }
    public List<Product> getAll() { return repo.findAll(); }
    public Product save(Product p) { return repo.save(p); }
    public void delete(Long id) { repo.deleteById(id); }
}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/products")
class ProductController {
    private final ProductService service;
    ProductController(ProductService s) { service = s; }

    @GetMapping public List<Product> list() { return service.getAll(); }
    @PostMapping public Product create(@RequestBody Product p) { return service.save(p); }
    @DeleteMapping("/{id}") public void delete(@PathVariable Long id) { service.delete(id); }
}
```

```java
import org.springframework.scheduling.concurrent.ThreadPoolTaskExecutor;

@Configuration @EnableAsync
public class AsyncConfig {
    @Bean(name = "taskExecutor")

        ex.setCorePoolSize(5);

        ex.setQueueCapacity(100);
```

**Example Output:** `HTTP 200 response with expected JSON/result`

**Explanation:** Create controller/service/repository layers, validate input, apply business logic, and return proper response.

```java
// Spring AOP - Logging aspect
import org.aspectj.lang.ProceedingJoinPoint;
import org.aspectj.lang.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import java.time.Instant;

@Aspect @Component
public class LoggingAspect {
    @Around("execution(* com.myapp.service.*.*(..))")
    public Object logExecutionTime(ProceedingJoinPoint jp) throws Throwable {
        long start = Instant.now().toEpochMilli();
        Object result = jp.proceed();
        long elapsed = Instant.now().toEpochMilli() - start;
        System.out.printf("[AOP] %s.%s() took %d ms%n",
            jp.getTarget().getClass().getSimpleName(),
            jp.getSignature().getName(), elapsed);
        return result;
    }

    @AfterThrowing(pointcut = "execution(* com.myapp.service.*.*(..))", throwing = "ex")
    public void logException(Exception ex) {
        System.err.println("[AOP] Exception: " + ex.getMessage());
    }
}
```

### 1510. File Upload API
**ID:** `SPRING-1510`

**Problem:** File Upload API.

**Example Input:** POST /api/upload with multipart file

**Example Output:** filename saved, URL returned

**Explanation:** MultipartFile from @RequestParam; store via Files.copy to upload dir; return saved filename.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;
import java.io.IOException; import java.nio.file.*;

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api")
public class FileUploadController {
    private static final Path UPLOAD_DIR = Path.of("uploads");

    @PostMapping("/upload")
    public String upload(@RequestParam("file") MultipartFile file) throws IOException {
        Files.createDirectories(UPLOAD_DIR);
        Path dest = UPLOAD_DIR.resolve(file.getOriginalFilename());
        Files.copy(file.getInputStream(), dest, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
        return "Uploaded: " + dest.toAbsolutePath();
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) file size &nbsp; **Space:** O(n) disk

### 1511. Download File API
**ID:** `SPRING-1511`

**Problem:** Download File API.

**Example Input:** GET /api/download?name=report.pdf

**Example Output:** binary file stream as response

**Explanation:** Load file as Resource; set Content-Disposition header; return ResponseEntity<Resource>.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.core.io.*;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.nio.file.*;

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api")
public class FileDownloadController {
    private static final Path UPLOAD_DIR = Path.of("uploads");

    @GetMapping("/download")
    public ResponseEntity<Resource> download(@RequestParam String name) throws Exception {
        Path file = UPLOAD_DIR.resolve(name).normalize();
        Resource resource = new UrlResource(file.toUri());
        if (!resource.exists()) return ResponseEntity.notFound().build();
        return ResponseEntity.ok()
            .header(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION,
                    "attachment; filename="" + resource.getFilename() + """)
            .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM)
            .body(resource);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) file size &nbsp; **Space:** O(1) streaming

```java
import jakarta.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class ConnectionPool {
    private boolean connected = false;

    @PostConstruct
    public void init() {
        connected = true;
        System.out.println("ConnectionPool initialised — acquiring connections");
    }

    public boolean isConnected() { return connected; }

    @PreDestroy
    public void cleanup() {
        connected = false;
        System.out.println("ConnectionPool destroyed — releasing connections");
    }
}
```

```java
import org.springframework.boot.actuate.health.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class DatabaseHealthIndicator implements HealthIndicator {

    @Override
    public Health health() {
        boolean dbUp = checkDatabase();
        if (dbUp) {
            return Health.up()
                .withDetail("database", "PostgreSQL")
                .withDetail("status", "reachable")
                .build();
        }
        return Health.down()
            .withDetail("database", "PostgreSQL")
            .withDetail("error", "connection refused")
            .build();
    }

    private boolean checkDatabase() {
        // try { dataSource.getConnection(); return true; } catch (Exception e) { return false; }
        return true; // simplified
    }
}
```

### 1520. Email Service
**ID:** `SPRING-1520`

**Problem:** Email Service.

**Example Input:** sendMail(to, subject, body) called

**Example Output:** email sent via SMTP JavaMailSender

**Explanation:** Inject JavaMailSender; build MimeMessage via MimeMessageHelper; set to/subject/body/HTML flag.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.mail.*;
import org.springframework.mail.javamail.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import jakarta.mail.internet.MimeMessage;

@Service
public class MailService {
    private final JavaMailSender mailSender;

    public MailService(JavaMailSender mailSender) {
        this.mailSender = mailSender;
    }

    public void sendMail(String to, String subject, String body) throws Exception {
        MimeMessage msg = mailSender.createMimeMessage();
        MimeMessageHelper helper = new MimeMessageHelper(msg, true);
        helper.setTo(to);
        helper.setSubject(subject);
        helper.setText(body, true); // true = HTML
        mailSender.send(msg);
        System.out.println("Mail sent to: " + to);
    }
}
// application.properties:
// spring.mail.host=smtp.gmail.com
// spring.mail.port=587
// spring.mail.username=user@gmail.com
// spring.mail.password=apppassword
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1521. Cacheable Method
**ID:** `SPRING-1521`

**Problem:** Cacheable Method.

**Example Input:** getUserById(1) called twice

**Example Output:** DB hit only once; second call from cache

**Explanation:** @EnableCaching on config; @Cacheable(name,key) caches result; @CacheEvict clears on update/delete.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.cache.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

// On @SpringBootApplication: @EnableCaching
@Service
public class UserService {

    @Cacheable(value = "users", key = "#id")
    public String getUserById(Long id) {
        System.out.println("DB hit for id=" + id); // only prints once per id
        return "User-" + id;
    }

    @CachePut(value = "users", key = "#id")
    public String updateUser(Long id, String name) {
        System.out.println("Updated user " + id);
        return name;
    }

    @CacheEvict(value = "users", key = "#id")
    public void deleteUser(Long id) {
        System.out.println("Cache evicted for id=" + id);
    }
}
// application.properties (Caffeine cache):
// spring.cache.type=caffeine
// spring.cache.caffeine.spec=maximumSize=500,expireAfterWrite=10m
```

> **Time:** O(1) cached &nbsp; **Space:** O(n) cache size

### 1522. Request Response Logging
**ID:** `SPRING-1522`

**Problem:** Request Response Logging.

**Example Input:** any HTTP request

**Example Output:** request method/URI and response status logged

**Explanation:** Implement HandlerInterceptor; override preHandle/afterCompletion; register via WebMvcConfigurer.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.*;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.*;
import jakarta.servlet.http.*;

@Component
public class LoggingInterceptor implements HandlerInterceptor {

    @Override
    public boolean preHandle(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res, Object h) {
        System.out.printf("[REQ] %s %s%n", req.getMethod(), req.getRequestURI());
        req.setAttribute("startTime", System.currentTimeMillis());
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void afterCompletion(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res, Object h, Exception ex) {
        long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - (Long) req.getAttribute("startTime");
        System.out.printf("[RES] %d for %s in %d ms%n",
            res.getStatus(), req.getRequestURI(), elapsed);
    }
}

@Component
class WebConfig implements WebMvcConfigurer {
    private final LoggingInterceptor li;
    WebConfig(LoggingInterceptor li) { this.li = li; }
    @Override
    public void addInterceptors(InterceptorRegistry registry) {
        registry.addInterceptor(li).addPathPatterns("/**");
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1523. API Versioning
**ID:** `SPRING-1523`

**Problem:** API Versioning.

**Example Input:** GET /api/v1/users and GET /api/v2/users

**Example Output:** v1 returns basic fields; v2 includes extra fields

**Explanation:** URL versioning uses @RequestMapping("/api/v1"); header versioning uses RequestMapping headers param.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.util.Map;

@RestController
public class UserController {

    // Strategy 1: URL versioning
    @GetMapping("/api/v1/users")
    public Map<String, Object> getUsersV1() {
        return Map.of("id", 1, "name", "Alice");
    }

    @GetMapping("/api/v2/users")
    public Map<String, Object> getUsersV2() {
        return Map.of("id", 1, "name", "Alice", "email", "alice@example.com", "role", "ADMIN");
    }

    // Strategy 2: Header versioning
    @GetMapping(value = "/api/users", headers = "X-API-Version=1")
    public Map<String, Object> getUsersHeaderV1() {
        return Map.of("version", "1", "name", "Alice");
    }

    // Strategy 3: Accept header (media type versioning)
    @GetMapping(value = "/api/users",
                produces = "application/vnd.app.v2+json")
    public Map<String, Object> getUsersMediaV2() {
        return Map.of("version", "2", "name", "Alice", "email", "alice@example.com");
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1524. Custom Annotation Validation
**ID:** `SPRING-1524`

**Problem:** Custom Annotation Validation.

**Example Input:** @PhoneNumber on DTO field with invalid value

**Example Output:** MethodArgumentNotValidException with message

**Explanation:** Create @interface with @Constraint; implement ConstraintValidator<A,T>; apply to DTO fields.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.validation.*;
import java.lang.annotation.*;

@Documented
@Constraint(validatedBy = PhoneNumberValidator.class)
@Target({ElementType.FIELD})
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@interface PhoneNumber {
    String message() default "Invalid phone number format";
    Class<?>[] groups() default {};
    Class<? extends Payload>[] payload() default {};
}

class PhoneNumberValidator implements ConstraintValidator<PhoneNumber, String> {
    @Override
    public boolean isValid(String value, ConstraintValidatorContext ctx) {
        if (value == null) return true; // let @NotNull handle null
        return value.matches("^\+?[0-9]{10,15}$");
    }
}

// DTO usage:
class UserDto {
    @PhoneNumber
    private String phone; // "+919876543210" valid, "abc" invalid
    public String getPhone() { return phone; }
    public void setPhone(String p) { phone = p; }
}
// Controller: @Valid @RequestBody UserDto dto
// Spring auto-calls PhoneNumberValidator.isValid()
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1525. Global Exception Handler
**ID:** `SPRING-1525`

**Problem:** Global Exception Handler.

**Example Input:** service throws ResourceNotFoundException

**Example Output:** 404 JSON error body

**Explanation:** @ControllerAdvice + @ExceptionHandler catches exceptions globally; return ProblemDetail.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

@ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND)
class ResourceNotFoundException extends RuntimeException {
    public ResourceNotFoundException(String msg) { super(msg); }
}

@RestControllerAdvice
public class GlobalExceptionHandler {
    @ExceptionHandler(ResourceNotFoundException.class)
    public ProblemDetail handleNotFound(ResourceNotFoundException ex) {
        ProblemDetail pd = ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, ex.getMessage());
        pd.setTitle("Resource Not Found");
        return pd;
    }
    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
    public ProblemDetail handleGeneral(Exception ex) {
        ProblemDetail pd = ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail(
            HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Unexpected error");
        pd.setTitle("Internal Server Error");
        return pd;
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
