### 1526. Custom Security Filter
**ID:** `SPRING-1526`

**Problem:** Custom Security Filter.

**Example Input:** request with/without X-API-Key

**Example Output:** 401 if missing; proceeds if valid

**Explanation:** Extend OncePerRequestFilter; check header value; call chain.doFilter or send 401.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.servlet.*;
import jakarta.servlet.http.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
import java.io.IOException;

@Component
public class ApiKeyFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {
    private static final String API_KEY = "secret-key-123";
    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res,
                                    FilterChain chain) throws ServletException, IOException {
        String key = req.getHeader("X-API-Key");
        if (API_KEY.equals(key)) { chain.doFilter(req, res); }
        else {
            res.setStatus(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED);
            res.getWriter().write("{"error":"Invalid or missing API Key"}");
        }
    }
    @Override
    protected boolean shouldNotFilter(HttpServletRequest req) {
        return req.getServletPath().startsWith("/public/");
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1527. Jackson ObjectMapper Config
**ID:** `SPRING-1527`

**Problem:** Jackson ObjectMapper Config.

**Example Input:** LocalDate serialized to JSON

**Example Output:** ISO date string not array

**Explanation:** Register JavaTimeModule; disable WRITE_DATES_AS_TIMESTAMPS; NON_NULL omits null fields.

**Answer:**
```java
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.*;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.datatype.jsr310.JavaTimeModule;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.*;

@Configuration
public class JacksonConfig {
    @Bean
    public ObjectMapper objectMapper() {
        ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper();
        mapper.registerModule(new JavaTimeModule());
        mapper.disable(SerializationFeature.WRITE_DATES_AS_TIMESTAMPS);
        mapper.configure(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES, false);
        mapper.setSerializationInclusion(
            com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL);
        return mapper;
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1528. Request Validation BindingResult
**ID:** `SPRING-1528`

**Problem:** Request Validation BindingResult.

**Example Input:** POST /users with missing name

**Example Output:** field error message in response

**Explanation:** @Valid triggers validation; BindingResult holds errors; check hasErrors() before processing.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.*;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.validation.BindingResult;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.util.*;

class UserRequest {
    @NotBlank(message = "Name is required") public String name;
    @Email(message = "Valid email required") public String email;
}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/users")
public class UserController {
    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<?> create(@Valid @RequestBody UserRequest req, BindingResult br) {
        if (br.hasErrors()) {
            Map<String, String> errors = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            br.getFieldErrors().forEach(e -> errors.put(e.getField(), e.getDefaultMessage()));
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(errors);
        }
        return ResponseEntity.ok("User created: " + req.name);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1529. HATEOAS Links
**ID:** `SPRING-1529`

**Problem:** HATEOAS Links.

**Example Input:** GET /users/1

**Example Output:** response with self and collection links

**Explanation:** EntityModel wraps DTO; WebMvcLinkBuilder.linkTo adds hypermedia links; clients discover endpoints.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.hateoas.*;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.*;

record UserDto(Long id, String name) {}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/users")
public class UserHateoasController {
    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public EntityModel<UserDto> getUser(@PathVariable Long id) {
        UserDto user = new UserDto(id, "Alice");
        return EntityModel.of(user,
            linkTo(methodOn(UserHateoasController.class).getUser(id)).withSelfRel(),
            linkTo(methodOn(UserHateoasController.class).getAll()).withRel("users"));
    }
    @GetMapping
    public CollectionModel<EntityModel<UserDto>> getAll() {
        var list = java.util.List.of(new UserDto(1L,"Alice"), new UserDto(2L,"Bob"));
        var models = list.stream().map(u ->
            EntityModel.of(u, linkTo(methodOn(UserHateoasController.class).getUser(u.id())).withSelfRel())).toList();
        return CollectionModel.of(models,
            linkTo(methodOn(UserHateoasController.class).getAll()).withSelfRel());
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

### 1533. Transaction Propagation Demo
**ID:** `SPRING-1533`

**Problem:** Transaction Propagation Demo.

**Example Input:** outer TX calls inner REQUIRES_NEW

**Example Output:** inner commits even if outer rolls back

**Explanation:** REQUIRED joins existing TX; REQUIRES_NEW suspends and starts fresh; inner always commits.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.*;

@Service
public class OrderService {
    private final AuditService audit;
    public OrderService(AuditService a) { audit = a; }
    @Transactional
    public void placeOrder(String item) {
        System.out.println("Placing order: " + item);
        audit.logAction("ORDER:" + item); // commits separately
        if ("FAIL".equals(item)) throw new RuntimeException("Rollback outer");
    }
}

@Service
class AuditService {
    @Transactional(propagation = Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW)
    public void logAction(String action) {
        System.out.println("Audit: " + action); // always commits
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1534. CircuitBreaker Resilience4j
**ID:** `SPRING-1534`

**Problem:** CircuitBreaker Resilience4j.

**Example Input:** remote service fails 3 times

**Example Output:** circuit opens; fallback returned

**Explanation:** @CircuitBreaker(name,fallbackMethod); opens after threshold; fallback method with same signature.

**Answer:**
```java
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.annotation.CircuitBreaker;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class PaymentService {
    private int calls = 0;
    @CircuitBreaker(name = "payment", fallbackMethod = "fallback")
    public String process(double amount) {
        if (++calls <= 3) throw new RuntimeException("Gateway down");
        return "Payment OK: $" + amount;
    }
    public String fallback(double amount, Throwable t) {
        return "Payment queued: $" + amount;
    }
}
// application.yml:
// resilience4j.circuitbreaker.instances.payment:
//   slidingWindowSize: 5
//   failureRateThreshold: 50
//   waitDurationInOpenState: 10s
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1535. Retry Annotation Resilience4j

**Example Output:** result on 3rd attempt

```java
import io.github.resilience4j.retry.annotation.Retry;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class ExternalApiService {
    private int attempts = 0;
    @Retry(name = "externalApi", fallbackMethod = "fallback")
    public String fetchData(String ep) {
        if (++attempts < 3) throw new RuntimeException("Temporary failure");
        return "Data from " + ep;
    }
    public String fallback(String ep, Exception e) { return "Cached data for " + ep; }
}
// application.yml:
// resilience4j.retry.instances.externalApi:
//   maxAttempts: 3
//   waitDuration: 500ms
```

```java
import org.springframework.boot.actuate.health.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import java.io.File;

@Component("diskSpace")
public class DiskHealthIndicator implements HealthIndicator {
    private static final long THRESHOLD = 100L * 1024 * 1024; // 100MB
    @Override
    public Health health() {
        long free = new File(".").getFreeSpace();
        if (free > THRESHOLD)
            return Health.up().withDetail("freeSpaceMB", free/(1024*1024)).build();
        return Health.down().withDetail("error","Low disk space").build();
    }
}
```

### 1542. Logback Structured Logging
**ID:** `SPRING-1542`

**Problem:** Logback Structured Logging.

**Example Input:** request processed with userId

**Example Output:** userId in every log line via MDC

**Explanation:** MDC.put(key,value) adds to thread-local log context; MDC.clear() in finally block.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.slf4j.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class RequestProcessingService {
    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RequestProcessingService.class);
    public void process(String userId, String action) {
        MDC.put("userId", userId);
        MDC.put("requestId", java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString());
        try {
            log.info("Starting: {}", action);
            log.debug("Executing action");
            log.info("Completed");
        } finally {
            MDC.clear(); // prevent leaks
        }
    }
}
// logback pattern: %d [%X{requestId}] [%X{userId}] %-5level %msg%n
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1544. Multipart File Validation
**ID:** `SPRING-1544`

**Problem:** Multipart File Validation.

**Example Input:** upload non-JPEG or >5MB file

**Example Output:** validation error with reason

**Explanation:** Check content type and file size before processing; return error list if invalid.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;
import java.util.*;

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/images")
public class ImageUploadController {
    private static final long MAX = 5L * 1024 * 1024;
    private static final Set<String> OK = Set.of("image/jpeg","image/png","image/gif");
    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<?> upload(@RequestParam MultipartFile file) {
        List<String> errors = new ArrayList<>();
        if (file.isEmpty()) errors.add("File empty");
        if (!OK.contains(file.getContentType())) errors.add("Invalid type: " + file.getContentType());
        if (file.getSize() > MAX) errors.add("Too large: " + file.getSize()/1024 + "KB");
        if (!errors.isEmpty()) return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("errors",errors));
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("filename",file.getOriginalFilename(),"size",file.getSize()));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)
---

### 1547. JPA Specification Builder
**ID:** `SPRING-1547`

**Problem:** JPA Specification Builder.

**Example Input:** filter products by category and price range

**Example Output:** dynamic WHERE clause

**Explanation:** Specification<T> composable Predicate; combine with .and()/.or(); passed to JpaSpecificationExecutor.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.domain.Specification;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.*;

@Entity class Product { @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String name; String category; double price; }

interface ProductRepository extends JpaRepository<Product,Long>, JpaSpecificationExecutor<Product> {}

class ProductSpec {
    static Specification<Product> hasCategory(String cat) {
        return (r,q,cb) -> cat==null ? cb.conjunction() : cb.equal(r.get("category"),cat);
    }
    static Specification<Product> priceBetween(Double min, Double max) {
        return (r,q,cb) -> {
            if (min==null && max==null) return cb.conjunction();
            if (max==null) return cb.ge(r.get("price"),min);
            if (min==null) return cb.le(r.get("price"),max);
            return cb.between(r.get("price"),min,max);
        };
    }
}
// repo.findAll(ProductSpec.hasCategory("Electronics").and(ProductSpec.priceBetween(100.0,500.0)))
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)
---

### 1548. Criteria API JPA
**ID:** `SPRING-1548`

**Problem:** Criteria API JPA.

**Example Input:** find employees with salary > threshold in dept

**Example Output:** typed query result

**Explanation:** CriteriaBuilder creates CriteriaQuery; Root defines entity; Predicate composes WHERE conditions.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import jakarta.persistence.criteria.*;
import java.util.List;

@Entity class Employee { @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String name; String department; double salary; }

public class EmpCriteriaService {
    @PersistenceContext EntityManager em;
    public List<Employee> findHighEarners(String dept, double min) {
        CriteriaBuilder cb = em.getCriteriaBuilder();
        CriteriaQuery<Employee> cq = cb.createQuery(Employee.class);
        Root<Employee> root = cq.from(Employee.class);
        cq.select(root)
          .where(cb.and(cb.equal(root.get("department"),dept), cb.gt(root.get("salary"),min)))
          .orderBy(cb.desc(root.get("salary")));
        return em.createQuery(cq).setMaxResults(10).getResultList();
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)
---

```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Entity
public class Article {
    @Id @GeneratedValue Long id;
    String title;
    @Column(updatable=false) LocalDateTime createdAt;
    LocalDateTime updatedAt;
    @PrePersist
    protected void onCreate() { createdAt = updatedAt = LocalDateTime.now(); }
    @PreUpdate
    protected void onUpdate() { updatedAt = LocalDateTime.now(); }
    @PostLoad
    protected void onLoad() { System.out.println("Loaded: " + title); }
}
```

### 1550. Embedded Composite Key
**ID:** `SPRING-1550`

**Problem:** Embedded Composite Key.

**Example Input:** OrderItem with (orderId,productId) PK

**Example Output:** entity found by composite key

**Explanation:** @Embeddable on key class; @EmbeddedId on entity field; equals+hashCode required.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import java.io.Serializable; import java.util.Objects;

@Embeddable
class OrderItemId implements Serializable {
    Long orderId; Long productId;
    public OrderItemId() {}
    public OrderItemId(Long o, Long p) { orderId=o; productId=p; }
    @Override public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (!(o instanceof OrderItemId id)) return false;
        return Objects.equals(orderId,id.orderId) && Objects.equals(productId,id.productId);
    }
    @Override public int hashCode() { return Objects.hash(orderId,productId); }
}

@Entity
public class OrderItem {
    @EmbeddedId private OrderItemId id;
    private int quantity; private double unitPrice;
    public OrderItem() {}
    public OrderItem(Long o, Long p, int q, double price) {
        id=new OrderItemId(o,p); quantity=q; unitPrice=price;
    }
}
```

### 1551. Cache Eviction Strategy
**ID:** `SPRING-1551`

**Problem:** Cache Eviction Strategy.

**Example Input:** update/delete triggers cache evict

**Example Output:** stale data never served

**Explanation:** @CachePut updates cache after write; @CacheEvict removes entry; combine with @Caching.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.cache.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import java.util.*;

@Service @CacheConfig(cacheNames="products")
public class ProductService {
    private final Map<Long,String> db = new HashMap<>(Map.of(1L,"Laptop",2L,"Phone"));
    @Cacheable(key="#id") public String get(Long id) { System.out.println("DB hit: "+id); return db.getOrDefault(id,"?"); }
    @CachePut(key="#id") public String update(Long id, String name) { db.put(id,name); return name; }
    @CacheEvict(key="#id") public void delete(Long id) { db.remove(id); }
    @CacheEvict(allEntries=true) public void clearAll() { db.clear(); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) cached &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

### 1553. Kafka Producer Template
**ID:** `SPRING-1553`

**Problem:** Kafka Producer Template.

**Example Input:** placeOrder() called

**Example Output:** message published to orders topic

**Explanation:** KafkaTemplate.send(topic,key,value); CompletableFuture for async result handling.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.kafka.core.KafkaTemplate;
import org.springframework.kafka.support.SendResult;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;

@Service
public class OrderProducer {
    private final KafkaTemplate<String,String> kafka;
    public OrderProducer(KafkaTemplate<String,String> k) { kafka=k; }
    public void send(String orderId, String json) {
        CompletableFuture<SendResult<String,String>> f = kafka.send("orders",orderId,json);
        f.whenComplete((r,ex) -> {
            if (ex==null) System.out.println("Sent to partition "+r.getRecordMetadata().partition());
            else System.err.println("Failed: "+ex.getMessage());
        });
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1554. Kafka Consumer Config
**ID:** `SPRING-1554`

**Example Output:** consumer prints and processes message

```java
import org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.ConsumerRecord;
import org.springframework.kafka.annotation.KafkaListener;
import org.springframework.kafka.support.Acknowledgment;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class OrderConsumer {
    @KafkaListener(topics="orders", groupId="order-service")
    public void consume(ConsumerRecord<String,String> record) {
        System.out.printf("topic=%s partition=%d offset=%d key=%s val=%s%n",
            record.topic(), record.partition(), record.offset(), record.key(), record.value());
    }
    @KafkaListener(topics="payments", groupId="pay-service", containerFactory="manualAckFactory")
    public void consumeManual(String msg, Acknowledgment ack) {
        System.out.println("Payment: "+msg);
        ack.acknowledge();
    }
}
```

### 1556. Spring Batch Step
**ID:** `SPRING-1556`

**Problem:** Spring Batch Step.

**Example Output:** processed and written with chunk=100

```java
import org.springframework.batch.core.*;
import org.springframework.batch.core.configuration.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.batch.item.*;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.*;

@Configuration @EnableBatchProcessing
public class BatchConfig {
    @Bean Job importJob(JobRepository jr, Step step) {
        return new JobBuilder("importJob",jr).start(step).build();
    }
    @Bean Step importStep(JobRepository jr, PlatformTransactionManager tm, ItemWriter<String> w) {
        return new StepBuilder("importStep",jr)
            .<String,String>chunk(100,tm)
            .reader(() -> { /* FlatFileItemReader */ return null; })
            .processor(item -> item.toUpperCase())
            .writer(w).build();
    }
    @Bean ItemWriter<String> writer() {
        return items -> items.forEach(i -> System.out.println("Write: "+i));
    }
}
```

### 1558. WebSocket Handler
**ID:** `SPRING-1558`

**Problem:** WebSocket Handler.

**Example Input:** client connects and sends text message

**Example Output:** server echoes message back

**Explanation:** TextWebSocketHandler.handleTextMessage() receives; session.sendMessage() replies.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.context.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.socket.*;
import org.springframework.web.socket.config.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.socket.handler.TextWebSocketHandler;

@Component
class EchoHandler extends TextWebSocketHandler {
    @Override
    protected void handleTextMessage(WebSocketSession session, TextMessage msg) throws Exception {
        session.sendMessage(new TextMessage("Echo: "+msg.getPayload()));
    }
    @Override public void afterConnectionEstablished(WebSocketSession s) {
        System.out.println("Connected: "+s.getId());
    }
}

@Configuration @EnableWebSocket
class WsConfig implements WebSocketConfigurer {
    private final EchoHandler h;
    WsConfig(EchoHandler h) { this.h=h; }
    @Override public void registerWebSocketHandlers(WebSocketHandlerRegistry r) {
        r.addHandler(h,"/ws/echo").setAllowedOrigins("*");
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(connections)

### 1559. SSE Controller
**ID:** `SPRING-1559`

**Problem:** SSE Controller.

**Example Input:** client GET /api/events

**Example Output:** server pushes events every 2 seconds

**Explanation:** SseEmitter with timeout; executor thread calls emitter.send(event()); emitter.complete() when done.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.SseEmitter;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api")
public class SseController {
    @GetMapping("/events")
    public SseEmitter stream() {
        SseEmitter emitter = new SseEmitter(60_000L);
        Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor().submit(() -> {
            try {
                for (int i=1; i<=10; i++) {
                    emitter.send(SseEmitter.event().id(String.valueOf(i))
                        .name("update").data("Event #"+i));
                    Thread.sleep(2000);
                }
                emitter.complete();
            } catch (Exception e) { emitter.completeWithError(e); }
        });
        return emitter;
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(connections)
---

### 1562. RabbitMQ Listener
**ID:** `SPRING-1562`

**Problem:** RabbitMQ Listener.

**Example Input:** message on order.queue

**Example Output:** consumer processes and acknowledges

**Explanation:** @RabbitListener(queues) auto-subscribes; RabbitTemplate.convertAndSend publishes.

```java
import org.springframework.amqp.core.*;
import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.annotation.RabbitListener;
import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.core.RabbitTemplate;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Configuration
class RabbitConfig {
    @Bean Queue orderQueue() { return new Queue("order.queue",true); }
    @Bean DirectExchange exchange() { return new DirectExchange("order.exchange"); }
    @Bean Binding binding(Queue q, DirectExchange ex) { return BindingBuilder.bind(q).to(ex).with("order.key"); }
}

@Service class Publisher {
    private final RabbitTemplate tmpl;
    Publisher(RabbitTemplate t) { tmpl=t; }
    public void send(String order) { tmpl.convertAndSend("order.exchange","order.key",order); }
}

@Service class Consumer {
    @RabbitListener(queues="order.queue")
    public void consume(String msg) { System.out.println("Consumed: "+msg); }
}
```

### 1565. API Gateway Route Config
**ID:** `SPRING-1565`

**Problem:** API Gateway Route Config.

**Example Input:** request to /orders/** via gateway

**Example Output:** forwarded to order-service via lb

**Explanation:** RouteLocator bean defines predicates, filters, and lb:// URI for load-balanced routing.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.cloud.gateway.route.RouteLocator;
import org.springframework.cloud.gateway.route.builder.RouteLocatorBuilder;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.*;

@Configuration
public class GatewayConfig {
    @Bean
    public RouteLocator routes(RouteLocatorBuilder b) {
        return b.routes()
            .route("orders", r -> r.path("/orders/**")
                .filters(f -> f.addRequestHeader("X-Source","gateway")
                    .circuitBreaker(c -> c.setName("orderCB").setFallbackUri("forward:/fallback")))
                .uri("lb://order-service"))
            .route("users", r -> r.path("/users/**")
                .filters(f -> f.rewritePath("/users/(?<seg>.*)","/api/users/${seg}"))
                .uri("lb://user-service"))
            .build();
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(routes)
---

```java
record UserResponse(Long id, String name, String email) {}
record CreateUserReq(String name, String email) {}

@FeignClient(name="user-service", fallback=UserClientFallback.class)
public interface UserClient {
```

### 1569. Spring Security DSL
**ID:** `SPRING-1569`

**Problem:** Spring Security DSL.

**Example Input:** /admin/** requires ADMIN role

**Example Output:** /public/** accessible freely; 401 otherwise

**Explanation:** SecurityFilterChain bean with lambda DSL; authorizeHttpRequests defines URL rules; stateless JWT.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.context.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configuration.EnableWebSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;

@Configuration @EnableWebSecurity
public class SecurityConfig {
    @Bean
    public SecurityFilterChain filterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
        return http
            .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
            .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth
                .requestMatchers("/public/**","/actuator/health").permitAll()
                .requestMatchers("/admin/**").hasRole("ADMIN")
                .requestMatchers("/api/**").authenticated()
                .anyRequest().denyAll())
            .httpBasic(org.springframework.security.config.Customizer.withDefaults())
            .sessionManagement(sm -> sm.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
            .build();
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1573. Task Executor Config
**ID:** `SPRING-1573`

**Problem:** Task Executor Config.

**Example Input:** multiple @Async tasks submitted

**Example Output:** run concurrently in bounded thread pool

**Explanation:** ThreadPoolTaskExecutor with corePoolSize/maxPoolSize/queueCapacity; CallerRunsPolicy on rejection.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.context.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.EnableAsync;
import org.springframework.scheduling.concurrent.ThreadPoolTaskExecutor;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

@Configuration @EnableAsync
public class AsyncConfig {
    @Bean(name="taskExecutor")
    public Executor taskExecutor() {
        ThreadPoolTaskExecutor ex = new ThreadPoolTaskExecutor();
        ex.setCorePoolSize(5);
        ex.setMaxPoolSize(15);
        ex.setQueueCapacity(100);
        ex.setThreadNamePrefix("async-");
        ex.setRejectedExecutionHandler(new ThreadPoolExecutor.CallerRunsPolicy());
        ex.initialize();
        return ex;
    }
}
// @Async("taskExecutor") public CompletableFuture<String> process(String id) { ... }
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(pool+queue)

### 1574. Spring Retry Template
**ID:** `SPRING-1574`

**Problem:** Spring Retry Template.

**Example Input:** method fails 2 times

**Example Output:** succeeds on 3rd attempt after backoff

**Explanation:** RetryTemplate with SimpleRetryPolicy and ExponentialBackOffPolicy; execute() wraps logic.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.retry.backoff.ExponentialBackOffPolicy;
import org.springframework.retry.policy.SimpleRetryPolicy;
import org.springframework.retry.support.RetryTemplate;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Configuration
class RetryConfig {
    @Bean public RetryTemplate retryTemplate() {
        RetryTemplate tmpl = new RetryTemplate();
        SimpleRetryPolicy p = new SimpleRetryPolicy(); p.setMaxAttempts(3);
        ExponentialBackOffPolicy b = new ExponentialBackOffPolicy();
        b.setInitialInterval(500); b.setMultiplier(2.0); b.setMaxInterval(5000);
        tmpl.setRetryPolicy(p); tmpl.setBackOffPolicy(b);
        return tmpl;
    }
}

@Service class ExternalService {
    private int attempts=0;
    private final RetryTemplate tmpl;
    ExternalService(RetryTemplate t) { tmpl=t; }
    public String fetchData() {
        return tmpl.execute(ctx -> {
            if (++attempts<3) throw new RuntimeException("Error");
            return "Success on attempt "+attempts;
        });
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

```java
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.*;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.support.ServletUriComponentsBuilder;

class CreateUserRequest {
    @NotBlank(message = "Name required") public String name;
    @Email(message = "Valid email required") @NotBlank public String email;
    @Size(min = 8, message = "Password min 8 chars") public String password;
}

record UserResponse(Long id, String name, String email) {}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/users")
public class UserCreateController {

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<UserResponse> createUser(
            @Valid @RequestBody CreateUserRequest req) {
        // In production: userService.create(req)
        Long newId = System.currentTimeMillis() % 10000;
        UserResponse created = new UserResponse(newId, req.name, req.email);

        var location = ServletUriComponentsBuilder.fromCurrentRequest()
            .path("/{id}").buildAndExpand(newId).toUri();

        return ResponseEntity.created(location).body(created);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

```java
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.*;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.util.*;

class UpdateUserRequest {
    @NotBlank public String name;
    @Email @NotBlank public String email;
    public String phone;
}

record UserDto(Long id, String name, String email, String phone) {}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/users")
public class UserUpdateController {
    private final Map<Long, UserDto> db = new HashMap<>(
        Map.of(1L, new UserDto(1L, "Alice", "alice@example.com", "555-0001")));

    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<UserDto> updateUser(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @Valid @RequestBody UpdateUserRequest req) {
        if (!db.containsKey(id)) return ResponseEntity.notFound().build();
```

### 1578. PATCH Partial Update API
**ID:** `REST-1578`

**Problem:** PATCH Partial Update API.

**Example Input:** PATCH /api/users/1 {name:Alice New}

**Example Output:** 200 with only name changed; other fields unchanged

**Explanation:** @PatchMapping; use Map<String,Object> or Optional fields; update only non-null provided fields.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.util.*;

record UserDto(Long id, String name, String email, String phone) {}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/users")
public class UserPatchController {
    private final Map<Long, UserDto> db = new HashMap<>(
        Map.of(1L, new UserDto(1L, "Alice", "alice@example.com", "555-0001")));

    @PatchMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<UserDto> patchUser(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> updates) {
        UserDto existing = db.get(id);
        if (existing == null) return ResponseEntity.notFound().build();

        // Apply only provided fields
        String name  = (String) updates.getOrDefault("name", existing.name());
        String email = (String) updates.getOrDefault("email", existing.email());
        String phone = (String) updates.getOrDefault("phone", existing.phone());

        UserDto patched = new UserDto(id, name, email, phone);
        db.put(id, patched);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(patched);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1579. DELETE User API
**ID:** `REST-1579`

**Problem:** DELETE User API.

**Example Input:** DELETE /api/users/1

**Example Output:** 204 No Content; subsequent GET returns 404

**Explanation:** @DeleteMapping removes resource; return 204 No Content on success; 404 if not found.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.util.*;

record UserDto(Long id, String name, String email) {}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/users")
public class UserDeleteController {
    private final Map<Long, UserDto> db = new HashMap<>(
        Map.of(1L, new UserDto(1L, "Alice", "alice@example.com"),
               2L, new UserDto(2L, "Bob", "bob@example.com")));

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> deleteUser(@PathVariable Long id) {
        if (!db.containsKey(id)) return ResponseEntity.notFound().build();
        db.remove(id);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build(); // 204
    }

    @DeleteMapping // bulk delete by IDs
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> bulkDelete(@RequestBody List<Long> ids) {
        long removed = ids.stream().filter(db::containsKey)
                          .peek(db::remove).count();
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("deleted", removed, "requested", ids.size()));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1580. Search API With Filters
**ID:** `REST-1580`

**Problem:** Search API With Filters.

**Example Input:** GET /api/products?category=Electronics&minPrice=100&maxPrice=500&sort=price

**Example Output:** filtered sorted results

**Explanation:** @RequestParam optional filters; build dynamic predicate; delegate to repository with Specification.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.*;

record Product(Long id, String name, String category, double price) {}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/products")
public class ProductSearchController {
    private static final List<Product> DB = List.of(
        new Product(1L,"Laptop","Electronics",999.99),
        new Product(2L,"Phone","Electronics",499.99),
        new Product(3L,"Desk","Furniture",299.99),
        new Product(4L,"Monitor","Electronics",399.99));

    @GetMapping("/search")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> search(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String category,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Double minPrice,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Double maxPrice,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "name") String sort,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") int size) {

        var result = DB.stream()
            .filter(p -> category == null || p.category().equalsIgnoreCase(category))
            .filter(p -> minPrice == null || p.price() >= minPrice)
            .filter(p -> maxPrice == null || p.price() <= maxPrice)
            .sorted(sort.equals("price") ?
                Comparator.comparingDouble(Product::price) : Comparator.comparing(Product::name))
            .skip((long) page * size).limit(size)
            .collect(Collectors.toList());

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("data", result, "total", result.size(), "page", page));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)
---

### 1581. Pagination And Sorting API
**ID:** `REST-1581`

**Problem:** Pagination And Sorting API.

**Example Input:** GET /api/users?page=0&size=5&sort=name,asc

**Example Output:** paginated sorted user list with metadata

**Explanation:** Spring Data Pageable from @PageableDefault; Page<T> has content, totalPages, totalElements.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.data.domain.*;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.*;

record UserDto(Long id, String name, String email) {}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/users")
public class UserPaginationController {
    private static final List<UserDto> ALL_USERS = IntStream.rangeClosed(1, 50)
        .mapToObj(i -> new UserDto((long) i, "User" + i, "user" + i + "@example.com"))
        .collect(Collectors.toList());

    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> getUsers(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") int size,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "id") String sortBy,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "asc") String direction) {

        List<UserDto> sorted = ALL_USERS.stream()
            .sorted(sortBy.equals("name") ?
                Comparator.comparing(UserDto::name) : Comparator.comparing(UserDto::id))
            .collect(Collectors.toList());

        if (direction.equals("desc")) Collections.reverse(sorted);

        int from = Math.min(page * size, sorted.size());
        int to   = Math.min(from + size, sorted.size());
        var pageData = sorted.subList(from, to);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
            "content", pageData,
            "page", page, "size", size,
            "totalElements", sorted.size(),
            "totalPages", (sorted.size() + size - 1) / size));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n log n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)
---

### 1582. Bulk Upload API
**ID:** `REST-1582`

**Problem:** Bulk Upload API.

**Example Input:** POST /api/users/bulk [{name:...},{name:...}...]

**Example Output:** inserted count and any failed items

**Explanation:** @RequestBody List<DTO>; validate each; collect results; return success count and failures.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.*;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.util.*;

class UserRequest {
    @NotBlank public String name;
    @Email @NotBlank public String email;
}
record BulkResult(int success, int failed, List<String> errors) {}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/users")
public class BulkUploadController {

    @PostMapping("/bulk")
    public ResponseEntity<BulkResult> bulkCreate(
            @RequestBody List<UserRequest> users) {
        if (users == null || users.isEmpty())
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
                .body(new BulkResult(0, 0, List.of("Empty list")));
        if (users.size() > 1000)
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
                .body(new BulkResult(0, 0, List.of("Max 1000 items per batch")));

        int success = 0; List<String> errors = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < users.size(); i++) {
            UserRequest u = users.get(i);
            if (u.name == null || u.name.isBlank())
                errors.add("Row " + i + ": name required");
            else {
                // userService.save(u)
                success++;
            }
        }
        return ResponseEntity.ok(new BulkResult(success, errors.size(), errors));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

### 1583. Idempotent POST API
**ID:** `REST-1583`

**Problem:** Idempotent POST API.

**Example Input:** same POST with Idempotency-Key repeated

**Example Output:** second call returns cached response, not duplicate

**Explanation:** Store Idempotency-Key → response in Redis/cache; replay cached response for duplicate keys.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

record OrderRequest(String item, int quantity) {}
record OrderResponse(String orderId, String item, String status) {}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/orders")
public class IdempotentOrderController {
    // In production: use Redis with TTL (e.g., 24h)
    private final Map<String, OrderResponse> idempotencyCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<OrderResponse> placeOrder(
            @RequestHeader("Idempotency-Key") String key,
            @RequestBody OrderRequest req) {

        // Return cached response if key already processed
        if (idempotencyCache.containsKey(key)) {
            System.out.println("Duplicate request, returning cached: " + key);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(idempotencyCache.get(key));
        }

        // Process new order
        String orderId = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        OrderResponse response = new OrderResponse(orderId, req.item(), "CREATED");

        idempotencyCache.put(key, response); // cache for idempotency
        System.out.println("New order created: " + orderId);
        return ResponseEntity.status(201).body(response);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(keys cached)
---

### 1584. Standard Error Response
**ID:** `REST-1584`

**Problem:** Standard Error Response.

**Example Input:** any exception thrown in controller

**Example Output:** consistent JSON error body with timestamp/status/message

**Explanation:** @RestControllerAdvice returns ProblemDetail (RFC 7807) or custom ErrorResponse for all exceptions.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;

record ErrorResponse(Instant timestamp, int status, String error, Object message, String path) {}

@RestControllerAdvice
public class ApiErrorHandler {

    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleValidation(
            MethodArgumentNotValidException ex,
            jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest req) {
        Map<String, String> fieldErrors = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        ex.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors()
            .forEach(e -> fieldErrors.put(e.getField(), e.getDefaultMessage()));
        return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(
            new ErrorResponse(Instant.now(), 400, "Validation Failed", fieldErrors, req.getRequestURI()));
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(NoSuchElementException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotFound(
            NoSuchElementException ex, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest req) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(404).body(
            new ErrorResponse(Instant.now(), 404, "Not Found", ex.getMessage(), req.getRequestURI()));
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleGeneral(
            Exception ex, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest req) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(500).body(
            new ErrorResponse(Instant.now(), 500, "Internal Server Error",
                              "An unexpected error occurred", req.getRequestURI()));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

```java
import org.springframework.core.io.*;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.io.*;

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/files")
public class FileDownloadController {
    @GetMapping("/{filename}")
    public ResponseEntity<Resource> download(@PathVariable String filename) throws IOException {
        // In production: resolve from storage service
        byte[] data = ("Content of " + filename).getBytes();
        ByteArrayResource resource = new ByteArrayResource(data);
        return ResponseEntity.ok()
            .header(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION,"attachment; filename=""+filename+""")
            .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM)
            .contentLength(data.length)
            .body(resource);
    }
}
```

### 1588. Rate Limited API
**ID:** `REST-1588`

**Problem:** Rate Limited API.

**Example Input:** POST /api/payments 6 times fast

**Example Output:** first 5 succeed; 6th gets 429

**Explanation:** Bucket4j token bucket per user/IP; check tokens before processing; return 429 if exhausted.

**Answer:**
```java
import io.github.bucket4j.*;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.time.Duration; import java.util.Map; import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/payments")
public class PaymentController {
    private final Map<String, Bucket> buckets = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private Bucket bucket(String key) {
        return buckets.computeIfAbsent(key, k ->
            Bucket.builder().addLimit(Bandwidth.classic(5, Refill.greedy(5, Duration.ofMinutes(1)))).build());
    }
    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<String> pay(@RequestHeader(defaultValue="anon") String userId, @RequestBody String body) {
        if (bucket(userId).tryConsume(1)) return ResponseEntity.ok("Payment processed");
        return ResponseEntity.status(429).body("Rate limit exceeded. Try in 1 minute.");
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

```java
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/reports")
public class ReportController {
    @GetMapping("/generate")
    public CompletableFuture<ResponseEntity<String>> generate() {

            return ResponseEntity.ok("Report ready: " + System.currentTimeMillis());
        });

}
```

### 1590. Conditional Response Cache
**ID:** `REST-1590`

**Problem:** Conditional Response Cache.

**Example Input:** GET /api/products (with ETag)

**Example Output:** 304 Not Modified if unchanged

**Explanation:** ETag from content hash; If-None-Match header check; 304 saves bandwidth.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.context.request.WebRequest;
import java.util.List;

record Product(Long id, String name, double price) {}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/products")
public class CachedProductController {
    private final List<Product> products = List.of(new Product(1L,"Laptop",999.99));

    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<List<Product>> list(WebRequest request) {
        String etag = '"' + Integer.toHexString(products.hashCode()) + '"';
        if (request.checkNotModified(etag))
            return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_MODIFIED).build();
        return ResponseEntity.ok().eTag(etag)
            .cacheControl(org.springframework.http.CacheControl.maxAge(60, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            .body(products);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)
---

### 1591. HATEOAS Collection Resource
**ID:** `REST-1591`

**Problem:** HATEOAS Collection Resource.

**Example Input:** GET /api/orders

**Example Output:** each order has self and items links

**Explanation:** CollectionModel wraps list of EntityModel; each EntityModel gets self link; collection gets self.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.hateoas.*;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.*;
import java.util.List;

record OrderDto(Long id, String status, double total) {}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/orders")
public class OrderHateoasController {
    @GetMapping
    public CollectionModel<EntityModel<OrderDto>> list() {
        var orders = List.of(new OrderDto(1L,"PAID",99.0), new OrderDto(2L,"PENDING",149.0));
        var models = orders.stream().map(o ->
            EntityModel.of(o,
                linkTo(methodOn(OrderHateoasController.class).get(o.id())).withSelfRel(),
                linkTo(methodOn(OrderHateoasController.class).list()).withRel("orders"))).toList();
        return CollectionModel.of(models, linkTo(methodOn(OrderHateoasController.class).list()).withSelfRel());
    }
    @GetMapping("/{id}") public EntityModel<OrderDto> get(@PathVariable Long id) {
        return EntityModel.of(new OrderDto(id,"PAID",99.0), linkTo(methodOn(OrderHateoasController.class).get(id)).withSelfRel());
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

### 1592. Request Logging Filter
**ID:** `REST-1592`

**Problem:** Request Logging Filter.

**Example Input:** any REST call

**Example Output:** request method/path/time logged

**Explanation:** OncePerRequestFilter logs before/after; MDC stores requestId; elapsed time computed.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.servlet.*; import jakarta.servlet.http.*;
import org.slf4j.*; import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
import java.io.IOException; import java.util.UUID;

@Component
public class RequestLoggingFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {
    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RequestLoggingFilter.class);
    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res,
                                    FilterChain chain) throws ServletException, IOException {
        String id = UUID.randomUUID().toString().substring(0,8);
        MDC.put("requestId", id);
        long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
        try {
            log.info("→ {} {} [{}]", req.getMethod(), req.getRequestURI(), id);
            chain.doFilter(req, res);
        } finally {
            log.info("← {} {} {}ms [{}]", req.getMethod(), req.getRequestURI(),
                System.currentTimeMillis()-start, id);
            MDC.clear();
        }
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1594. Streaming JSON Response
**ID:** `REST-1594`

**Problem:** Streaming JSON Response.

**Example Input:** GET /api/stream/products

**Example Output:** products streamed as JSON array chunks

**Explanation:** ResponseBodyEmitter or StreamingResponseBody writes chunks; avoids OOM for large datasets.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.StreamingResponseBody;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import java.util.List;

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/stream")
public class StreamController {
    @GetMapping("/products")
    public ResponseEntity<StreamingResponseBody> stream() {
        StreamingResponseBody body = out -> {
            var products = List.of("Laptop","Phone","Tablet","Watch","Speaker");
            out.write("[".getBytes());
            for (int i=0; i<products.size(); i++) {
                String json = """ + products.get(i) + """;
                out.write(json.getBytes());
                if (i < products.size()-1) out.write(",".getBytes());
                out.flush();
            }
            out.write("]".getBytes());
        };
        return ResponseEntity.ok().contentType(org.springframework.http.MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).body(body);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1596. Circuit Breaker REST Client
**ID:** `REST-1596`

**Problem:** Circuit Breaker REST Client.

**Example Input:** GET /api/inventory (downstream down)

**Example Output:** fallback cached response

**Explanation:** @CircuitBreaker on service method; fallback returns cached or default; Resilience4j state machine.

**Answer:**
```java
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.annotation.CircuitBreaker;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

@Service
public class InventoryClient {
    private final RestTemplate rt;
    public InventoryClient(RestTemplate rt) { this.rt = rt; }
    @CircuitBreaker(name="inventory", fallbackMethod="fallback")
    public String getStock(String item) {
        return rt.getForObject("http://inventory-service/api/stock/"+item, String.class);
    }
    public String fallback(String item, Exception e) {
        return "{"item":""+item+"","stock":"unknown","cached":true}";
    }
}
// resilience4j.circuitbreaker.instances.inventory.slidingWindowSize=5
// resilience4j.circuitbreaker.instances.inventory.failureRateThreshold=50
```

### 1597. JWT Token Endpoint
**ID:** `REST-1597`

**Problem:** JWT Token Endpoint.

**Example Input:** POST /auth/login {user,pass}

**Example Output:** JWT token returned on success

**Explanation:** AuthController validates credentials; JwtUtil generates token; return token in response body.

**Answer:**
```java
import io.jsonwebtoken.*;
import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.util.*;

record LoginRequest(String username, String password) {}
record LoginResponse(String token, long expiresIn) {}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/auth")
public class AuthController {
    private static final String SECRET = "MySecretKey12345MySecretKey12345"; // 32+ chars
    @PostMapping("/login")
    public ResponseEntity<?> login(@RequestBody LoginRequest req) {
        if (!"admin".equals(req.username()) || !"pass123".equals(req.password()))
            return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED).body(Map.of("error","Invalid credentials"));
        String token = Jwts.builder()
            .subject(req.username())
            .issuedAt(new Date())
            .expiration(new Date(System.currentTimeMillis()+3600_000))
            .signWith(Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(SECRET.getBytes()))
            .compact();
        return ResponseEntity.ok(new LoginResponse(token, 3600));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1598. API Key Auth Filter
**ID:** `REST-1598`

**Problem:** API Key Auth Filter.

**Example Input:** GET /api/data with/without X-API-Key

**Example Output:** 200 or 401

**Explanation:** OncePerRequestFilter checks X-API-Key header; validates against stored keys; rejects if invalid.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.servlet.*; import jakarta.servlet.http.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
import java.io.IOException; import java.util.Set;

@Component
public class ApiKeyAuthFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {
    private static final Set<String> VALID = Set.of("key-abc-123","key-xyz-456");
    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res,
                                    FilterChain chain) throws ServletException, IOException {
        String key = req.getHeader("X-API-Key");
        if (VALID.contains(key)) { chain.doFilter(req, res); return; }
        res.setStatus(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED);
        res.setContentType("application/json");
        res.getWriter().write("{"error":"Unauthorized: invalid or missing API key"}");
    }
    @Override
    protected boolean shouldNotFilter(HttpServletRequest req) {
        return req.getServletPath().startsWith("/actuator/health");
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1599. Audit Trail Interceptor
**ID:** `REST-1599`

**Problem:** Audit Trail Interceptor.

**Example Input:** any write request (POST/PUT/DELETE)

**Example Output:** audit record created with user and timestamp

**Explanation:** HandlerInterceptor.afterCompletion logs; AuditEvent stored; SecurityContext provides user.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.HandlerInterceptor;
import jakarta.servlet.http.*;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

record AuditEvent(String method, String path, int status, String user, LocalDateTime time) {}

@Component
public class AuditInterceptor implements HandlerInterceptor {
    private final java.util.List<AuditEvent> log = new java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    @Override
    public void afterCompletion(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res,
                                Object handler, Exception ex) {
        String method = req.getMethod();
        if (Set.of("POST","PUT","DELETE","PATCH").contains(method)) {
            String user = req.getHeader("X-User-Id") != null ? req.getHeader("X-User-Id") : "anonymous";
            log.add(new AuditEvent(method, req.getRequestURI(), res.getStatus(), user, LocalDateTime.now()));
            System.out.println("AUDIT: "+method+" "+req.getRequestURI()+" by "+user);
        }
    }
    public java.util.List<AuditEvent> getLog() { return log; }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

### 1602. API Response Envelope
**ID:** `REST-1602`

**Problem:** API Response Envelope.

**Example Input:** GET /api/users/1

**Example Output:** wrapped in {success,data,timestamp,requestId}

**Explanation:** ResponseBodyAdvice wraps every response in standard envelope; X-Request-ID header added.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.core.MethodParameter;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType; import org.springframework.http.converter.HttpMessageConverter;
import org.springframework.http.server.*; import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.ResponseBodyAdvice;
import java.time.Instant; import java.util.*; import java.util.UUID;

record ApiResponse<T>(boolean success, T data, String timestamp, String requestId) {}

@RestControllerAdvice
public class ApiResponseWrapper implements ResponseBodyAdvice<Object> {
    @Override public boolean supports(MethodParameter p, Class<? extends HttpMessageConverter<?>> c) {
        return !p.getDeclaringClass().getSimpleName().contains("Actuator");
    }
    @Override public Object beforeBodyWrite(Object body, MethodParameter p, MediaType m,
        Class<? extends HttpMessageConverter<?>> c, ServerHttpRequest req, ServerHttpResponse res) {
        if (body instanceof ApiResponse) return body;
        String reqId = UUID.randomUUID().toString().substring(0,8);
        res.getHeaders().add("X-Request-ID", reqId);
        return new ApiResponse<>(true, body, Instant.now().toString(), reqId);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1603. Health Check Endpoint
**ID:** `REST-1603`

**Problem:** Health Check Endpoint.

**Example Input:** GET /actuator/health

**Example Output:** db, cache, disk status shown

**Explanation:** Custom HealthIndicators; management.endpoint.health.show-details=always in properties.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.boot.actuate.health.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import java.util.Map;

@Component("database")
class DatabaseHealthIndicator implements HealthIndicator {
    @Override public Health health() {
        try { /* run SELECT 1 */ return Health.up().withDetail("url","jdbc:postgresql://localhost/db").build(); }
        catch (Exception e) { return Health.down().withException(e).build(); }
    }
}

@Component("cache")
class CacheHealthIndicator implements HealthIndicator {
    @Override public Health health() {
        try { /* ping Redis */ return Health.up().withDetail("mode","standalone").build(); }
        catch (Exception e) { return Health.down().withDetail("error",e.getMessage()).build(); }
    }
}
// management.endpoint.health.show-details=always
// GET /actuator/health → {status:UP, components:{database:{UP}, cache:{UP}}}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

## JPA Hibernate Tasks


### 1605. One To Many Mapping
**ID:** `JPA-1605`

**Problem:** One To Many Mapping.

**Example Input:** Post with 3 Comments saved

**Example Output:** post.getComments() returns 3 Comment entities

**Explanation:** @OneToMany(mappedBy, cascade=ALL, orphanRemoval); @ManyToOne on child side; bidirectional link.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import java.util.*;

@Entity
public class Post {
    @Id @GeneratedValue Long id;
    String title;
    @OneToMany(mappedBy="post", cascade=CascadeType.ALL, orphanRemoval=true)
    List<Comment> comments = new ArrayList<>();
    public void addComment(Comment c) { comments.add(c); c.setPost(this); }
}

@Entity
class Comment {
    @Id @GeneratedValue Long id;
    String body;
    @ManyToOne(fetch=FetchType.LAZY) @JoinColumn(name="post_id")
    Post post;
    public void setPost(Post p) { post = p; }
}
// repo.save(post) cascades to all comments
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)
---

### 1606. Many To Many Mapping
**ID:** `JPA-1606`

**Problem:** Many To Many Mapping.

**Example Input:** Student enrolled in 3 Courses

**Example Output:** student.getCourses() returns all 3

**Explanation:** @ManyToMany with @JoinTable; Set avoids duplicates; manage via owner side (Student).

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import java.util.*;

@Entity
public class Student {
    @Id @GeneratedValue Long id;
    String name;
    @ManyToMany(cascade={CascadeType.PERSIST, CascadeType.MERGE})
    @JoinTable(name="student_course",
        joinColumns=@JoinColumn(name="student_id"),
        inverseJoinColumns=@JoinColumn(name="course_id"))
    Set<Course> courses = new HashSet<>();
    public void enroll(Course c) { courses.add(c); c.getStudents().add(this); }
}

@Entity
class Course {
    @Id @GeneratedValue Long id;
    String name;
    @ManyToMany(mappedBy="courses")
    Set<Student> students = new HashSet<>();
    public Set<Student> getStudents() { return students; }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)
---

### 1608. Eager Loading Demo
**ID:** `JPA-1608`

**Problem:** Eager Loading Demo.

**Example Input:** load User with roles

**Example Output:** roles loaded in same query via JOIN FETCH

**Explanation:** FetchType.EAGER or JPQL JOIN FETCH; avoids N+1 but loads always; use carefully.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.*;
import java.util.*;

@Entity class User {
    @Id @GeneratedValue Long id;
    String name;
    @ManyToMany(fetch=FetchType.EAGER)
    @JoinTable(name="user_roles")
    Set<Role> roles = new HashSet<>();
}
@Entity class Role { @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String name; }

interface UserRepository extends JpaRepository<User,Long> {
    // Explicit JOIN FETCH is better than EAGER on field
    @Query("SELECT DISTINCT u FROM User u LEFT JOIN FETCH u.roles WHERE u.id = :id")
    Optional<User> findByIdWithRoles(Long id);
}
// Use JOIN FETCH in query rather than FetchType.EAGER to avoid performance issues
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)
---

### 1609. N Plus One Problem Fix
**ID:** `JPA-1609`

**Problem:** N Plus One Problem Fix.

**Example Input:** load 10 Posts with Comments

**Example Output:** only 1 SQL query instead of 11

**Explanation:** N+1: 1 query for posts + N queries for each post's comments. Fix: JOIN FETCH or @EntityGraph.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.*;
import java.util.List;

@Entity class Post {
    @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String title;
    @OneToMany(mappedBy="post", fetch=FetchType.LAZY)
    List<Comment> comments;
}
@Entity class Comment { @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String body; @ManyToOne Post post; }

interface PostRepository extends JpaRepository<Post,Long> {
    // N+1 problem: findAll() + getComments() per post = 1+N queries
    // Fix 1: JOIN FETCH
    @Query("SELECT DISTINCT p FROM Post p LEFT JOIN FETCH p.comments")
    List<Post> findAllWithComments();
    // Fix 2: @EntityGraph
    @EntityGraph(attributePaths={"comments"})
    List<Post> findAll();
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)
---

```java
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;
import java.util.List;

@Entity class Employee {

}

interface EmployeeRepository extends JpaRepository<Employee,Long> {
    @Query("SELECT e FROM Employee e WHERE e.department = :dept AND e.salary > :min ORDER BY e.salary DESC")
    List<Employee> findHighEarners(@Param("dept") String dept, @Param("min") double min);
```

### 1612. Transaction Rollback
**ID:** `JPA-1612`

**Problem:** Transaction Rollback.

**Example Input:** save order then throw exception

**Example Output:** order NOT saved; DB unchanged

**Explanation:** @Transactional rolls back on RuntimeException; all DB ops in unit of work; atomicity guaranteed.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*; import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Entity class Order { @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String item; double amount; }

@Service
public class OrderService {
    private final javax.persistence.EntityManager em;
    // In reality: use JpaRepository
    public OrderService(javax.persistence.EntityManager em) { this.em = em; }
    @Transactional
    public void placeOrder(String item, double amount, boolean fail) {
        Order o = new Order(); o.item=item; o.amount=amount;
        em.persist(o); // not committed yet
        System.out.println("Persisted: "+item);
        if (fail) throw new RuntimeException("Payment failed — rollback");
        // Without fail: commit on method return
    }
}
// placeOrder("Laptop", 999, true) → RuntimeException → rolled back (no DB record)
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1613. Optimistic Locking
**ID:** `JPA-1613`

**Problem:** Optimistic Locking.

**Example Input:** two threads update same entity simultaneously

**Example Output:** second update gets OptimisticLockException

**Explanation:** @Version field auto-incremented on update; stale version mismatch → OptimisticLockException.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;

@Entity
public class BankAccount {
    @Id @GeneratedValue Long id;
    String owner;
    double balance;
    @Version Long version; // auto-managed by JPA

    public void withdraw(double amount) {
        if (balance < amount) throw new IllegalStateException("Insufficient funds");
        balance -= amount;
    }
}
// Thread 1: loads version=0, withdraws, saves → version becomes 1
// Thread 2: loaded version=0, tries save → OptimisticLockException
// Handle: catch ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException, retry or inform user

// public void withdraw(Long id, double amount) {
//     BankAccount acc = repo.findById(id).get();
//     acc.withdraw(amount);
//     repo.save(acc);
// }
```

### 1614. Auditing Created Date
**ID:** `JPA-1614`

**Problem:** Auditing Created Date.

**Example Input:** save new entity

**Example Output:** createdAt and updatedAt auto-populated

**Explanation:** @EnableJpaAuditing + @EntityListeners(AuditingEntityListener); @CreatedDate, @LastModifiedDate.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import org.springframework.data.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.domain.support.AuditingEntityListener;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.config.EnableJpaAuditing;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Configuration @EnableJpaAuditing class AuditConfig {}

@Entity @EntityListeners(AuditingEntityListener.class)
public class Article {
    @Id @GeneratedValue Long id;
    String title;
    @CreatedDate @Column(updatable=false) LocalDateTime createdAt;
    @LastModifiedDate LocalDateTime updatedAt;
    @CreatedBy String createdBy;
}
// Also add: @Bean AuditorAware<String> auditorProvider() { return () -> Optional.of("system"); }
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

```java
@Entity
```

### 1616. Soft Delete
**ID:** `JPA-1616`

**Problem:** Soft Delete.

**Example Input:** delete user

**Example Output:** row not removed; deleted_at set; findAll excludes it

**Explanation:** @SQLRestriction filters deleted rows automatically; @PreRemove or custom logic sets flag.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import org.hibernate.annotations.SQLRestriction;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Entity
@SQLRestriction("deleted_at IS NULL")
public class AppUser {
    @Id @GeneratedValue Long id;
    String name; String email;
    @Column(name="deleted_at") LocalDateTime deletedAt;

    public void softDelete() { deletedAt = LocalDateTime.now(); }
    public boolean isDeleted() { return deletedAt != null; }
}
// repo.findAll() → only rows where deleted_at IS NULL
// user.softDelete(); repo.save(user); // sets deleted_at, row stays in DB
// Restore: user.deletedAt = null; repo.save(user);
```

### 1618. Pessimistic Locking
**ID:** `JPA-1618`

**Problem:** Pessimistic Locking.

**Example Input:** two concurrent withdrawals

**Example Output:** second waits for first; no lost update

**Explanation:** LockModeType.PESSIMISTIC_WRITE issues SELECT FOR UPDATE; DB holds row lock until TX commits.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.*;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import java.util.Optional;

@Entity class Account { @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; double balance; }

interface AccountRepository extends JpaRepository<Account,Long> {
    @Lock(LockModeType.PESSIMISTIC_WRITE)
    @Query("SELECT a FROM Account a WHERE a.id = :id")
    Optional<Account> findByIdForUpdate(Long id);
}

@Service class TransferService {
    private final AccountRepository repo;
    TransferService(AccountRepository r) { repo=r; }
    @Transactional
    public void withdraw(Long id, double amount) {
        Account a = repo.findByIdForUpdate(id).orElseThrow();
        a.balance -= amount; // safe: row locked
        repo.save(a);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1619. Batch Insert JPA
**ID:** `JPA-1619`

**Problem:** Batch Insert JPA.

**Example Input:** save 10000 entities

**Example Output:** inserted in batches of 50; much faster

**Explanation:** hibernate.jdbc.batch_size=50; saveAll with flush+clear every batch; avoids memory overflow.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import java.util.List; import java.util.stream.IntStream;

@Entity class LogEntry { @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String message; int seq; }

@Service
public class BatchService {
    @PersistenceContext EntityManager em;
    @Transactional
    public void insertBatch(int total) {
        for (int i=0; i<total; i++) {
            LogEntry e = new LogEntry(); e.message="Log-"+i; e.seq=i;
            em.persist(e);
            if (i % 50 == 49) { em.flush(); em.clear(); } // flush every 50
        }
    }
}
// application.properties:
// spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.jdbc.batch_size=50
// spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.order_inserts=true
// spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.order_updates=true
```

> **Time:** O(n/batch) &nbsp; **Space:** O(batch)
---

### 1623. Custom Repository Implementation
**ID:** `JPA-1623`

**Problem:** Custom Repository Implementation.

**Example Input:** invoke complex query logic not in JpaRepository

**Example Output:** custom method available on repo interface

**Explanation:** Define interface + Impl class; Spring finds Impl by naming convention; mix with JpaRepository.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*; import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import java.util.List;

@Entity class Product { @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String name; double price; boolean active; }

interface ProductCustom { List<Product> findTopByPriceRange(double min, double max, int limit); }

@Component
class ProductCustomImpl implements ProductCustom {
    @PersistenceContext EntityManager em;
    @Override public List<Product> findTopByPriceRange(double min, double max, int limit) {
        return em.createQuery(
            "SELECT p FROM Product p WHERE p.price BETWEEN :min AND :max AND p.active=true ORDER BY p.price",
            Product.class).setParameter("min",min).setParameter("max",max)
            .setMaxResults(limit).getResultList();
    }
}

interface ProductRepository extends JpaRepository<Product,Long>, ProductCustom {}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

### 1626. Entity Converter
**ID:** `JPA-1626`

**Problem:** Entity Converter.

**Example Input:** save LocalDate as String in DB

**Example Output:** DB stores '2025-01-15'; entity sees LocalDate

**Explanation:** @Converter(autoApply=true); AttributeConverter<EntityType,DBType>; convertToDatabaseColumn/EntityAttribute.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import java.time.LocalDate;

@Converter(autoApply=true)
public class LocalDateConverter implements AttributeConverter<LocalDate, String> {
    @Override public String convertToDatabaseColumn(LocalDate date) {
        return date == null ? null : date.toString(); // "2025-01-15"
    }
    @Override public LocalDate convertToEntityAttribute(String s) {
        return s == null ? null : LocalDate.parse(s);
    }
}

@Entity class Event {
    @Id @GeneratedValue Long id;
    String name;
    // autoApply=true: no @Convert needed; all LocalDate fields use this converter
    LocalDate eventDate;
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1627. Named Entity Graph
**ID:** `JPA-1627`

**Problem:** Named Entity Graph.

**Example Input:** load Order with items and product in one query

**Example Output:** no N+1; eager-loaded on demand

**Explanation:** @NamedEntityGraph on entity; @EntityGraph on repo method; controls which associations to fetch.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.*;
import java.util.*;

@Entity
@NamedEntityGraph(name="Order.detail",
    attributeNodes={@NamedAttributeNode("items")})
class Order {
    @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String ref;
    @OneToMany(mappedBy="order", fetch=FetchType.LAZY)
    List<OrderItem> items;
}
@Entity class OrderItem { @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String product; int qty; @ManyToOne Order order; }

interface OrderRepository extends JpaRepository<Order,Long> {
    @EntityGraph("Order.detail")
    Optional<Order> findById(Long id); // overrides default; fetches items eagerly
    @EntityGraph(attributePaths={"items"})
    List<Order> findAll(); // alternative syntax
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

**ID:** `JPA-1629`

**Example Output:** startup fails with schema mismatch error

```java
// @Entity class User { @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String email; String phone; }

// application.properties:
// spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=validate

// If DB table 'user' has email but NOT phone:
// → SchemaManagementException: Schema-validation: missing column [phone]

// ddl-auto options:
// none       - no action
// validate   - validate schema matches entities (PRODUCTION use)
// update     - add missing columns (DEVELOPMENT use, risky)
// create     - drop+recreate on startup (TESTING only)
// create-drop- create on start, drop on end (TESTING only)

// Use Flyway/Liquibase for production schema management
// Use validate to ensure migrations applied correctly
```

### 1630. JPA Event Callback Service
**ID:** `JPA-1630`

**Problem:** JPA Event Callback Service.

**Example Input:** entity save triggers notification

**Example Output:** event sent after successful commit

**Explanation:** @PostPersist triggers immediately after insert; ApplicationEventPublisher sends async event.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisher;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.transaction.event.TransactionalEventListener;
import org.springframework.transaction.event.TransactionPhase;

record OrderCreatedEvent(Long orderId, String item) {}

@Entity class Order {
    @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String item;
    @Transient ApplicationEventPublisher publisher; // injected via @Service
}

@Service public class OrderService {
    private final ApplicationEventPublisher pub;
    public OrderService(ApplicationEventPublisher p) { pub=p; }
    @Transactional
    public void create(String item) {
        // save order...
        pub.publishEvent(new OrderCreatedEvent(1L, item));
    }
}

@Service class NotificationService {
    @TransactionalEventListener(phase=TransactionPhase.AFTER_COMMIT)
    public void on(OrderCreatedEvent e) { System.out.println("Notify: Order "+e.orderId()); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
