### 1631. Dynamic Table Sharding
**ID:** `JPA-1631`

**Problem:** Dynamic Table Sharding.

**Example Input:** save entity to table based on region

**Example Output:** NA data in na_orders; EU in eu_orders

**Explanation:** AbstractRoutingDataSource selects DataSource by lookup key; ThreadLocal stores current region.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.jdbc.datasource.lookup.AbstractRoutingDataSource;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

public class RegionRoutingDataSource extends AbstractRoutingDataSource {
    @Override
    protected Object determineCurrentLookupKey() {
        return RegionContext.get(); // "NA" or "EU"
    }
}

class RegionContext {
    private static final ThreadLocal<String> ctx = new ThreadLocal<>();
    public static void set(String r) { ctx.set(r); }
    public static String get() { return ctx.get(); }
    public static void clear() { ctx.remove(); }
}

@Service
class RegionalOrderService {
    @Transactional
    public void save(String region, String item) {
        RegionContext.set(region);
        try {
            System.out.println("Saving to "+region+" shard: "+item);
            // repo.save(order) → routes to region's DataSource
        } finally { RegionContext.clear(); }
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1632. JPA Criteria Count Query
**ID:** `JPA-1632`

**Problem:** JPA Criteria Count Query.

**Example Input:** count products in category

**Example Output:** numeric count without loading entities

**Explanation:** CriteriaBuilder.createQuery(Long.class); cb.count(root); getResultList returns count.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import jakarta.persistence.criteria.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Entity class Product { @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String name; String category; double price; }

@Service
public class ProductCountService {
    @PersistenceContext EntityManager em;
    public long countByCategory(String category) {
        CriteriaBuilder cb = em.getCriteriaBuilder();
        CriteriaQuery<Long> cq = cb.createQuery(Long.class);
        Root<Product> root = cq.from(Product.class);
        cq.select(cb.count(root))
          .where(cb.equal(root.get("category"), category));
        return em.createQuery(cq).getSingleResult();
    }
    public double avgPriceByCategory(String category) {
        CriteriaBuilder cb = em.getCriteriaBuilder();
        CriteriaQuery<Double> cq = cb.createQuery(Double.class);
        Root<Product> root = cq.from(Product.class);
        cq.select(cb.avg(root.get("price")))
          .where(cb.equal(root.get("category"),category));
        return em.createQuery(cq).getSingleResult();
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1633. Read Replica Routing
**ID:** `JPA-1633`

**Problem:** Read Replica Routing.

**Example Input:** GET request

**Example Output:** read from replica; write from primary

**Explanation:** AbstractRoutingDataSource routes reads to replica, writes to primary via TransactionSynchronizationManager.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.jdbc.datasource.lookup.AbstractRoutingDataSource;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;

public class ReadWriteRoutingDataSource extends AbstractRoutingDataSource {
    @Override
    protected Object determineCurrentLookupKey() {
        boolean readOnly = TransactionSynchronizationManager.isCurrentTransactionReadOnly();
        return readOnly ? "replica" : "primary";
    }
}
// Config: @Bean DataSource dataSource() {
//   ReadWriteRoutingDataSource routing = new ReadWriteRoutingDataSource();
//   routing.setTargetDataSources(Map.of("primary", primaryDs(), "replica", replicaDs()));
//   routing.setDefaultTargetDataSource(primaryDs());
//   return routing;
// }
// @Transactional(readOnly=true) → routes to replica
// @Transactional → routes to primary
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1634. JPA Paging Slice
**ID:** `JPA-1634`

**Problem:** JPA Paging Slice.

**Example Input:** GET /api/products?page=0&size=20

**Example Output:** slice with hasNext flag; no count query

**Explanation:** Slice avoids expensive COUNT(*); has hasNext() to check if more pages exist; better for large tables.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import org.springframework.data.domain.*;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

@Entity class Product { @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String name; double price; }

interface ProductRepository extends JpaRepository<Product,Long> {
    Slice<Product> findByPriceLessThan(double maxPrice, Pageable pageable);
}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/products")
class ProductController {
    private final ProductRepository repo;
    ProductController(ProductRepository r) { repo=r; }
    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<?> list(@RequestParam(defaultValue="0") int page,
                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue="20") int size) {
        Slice<Product> slice = repo.findByPriceLessThan(500.0, PageRequest.of(page, size));
        return ResponseEntity.ok(java.util.Map.of(
            "items", slice.getContent(), "hasNext", slice.hasNext(), "page", page));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(page)
---

## Security JWT OAuth Tasks


### 1635. JWT Login API
**ID:** `SEC-1635`

**Problem:** JWT Login API.

**Example Input:** POST /auth/login {username,password}

**Example Output:** JWT token in response body

**Explanation:** Authenticate credentials; generate JWT with jjwt; return token+expiry in LoginResponse.

**Answer:**
```java
import io.jsonwebtoken.*; import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys;
import org.springframework.http.*; import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.util.*; import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

record LoginRequest(String username, String password) {}
record TokenResponse(String token, String type, long expiresIn) {}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/auth")
public class AuthController {
    private static final String SECRET = "MySuperSecretKey12345678901234567890";
    @PostMapping("/login")
    public ResponseEntity<?> login(@RequestBody LoginRequest req) {
        if (!"admin".equals(req.username()) || !"pass123".equals(req.password()))
            return ResponseEntity.status(401).body(Map.of("error","Invalid credentials"));
        String token = Jwts.builder()
            .subject(req.username())
            .claim("role","ADMIN")
            .issuedAt(new Date())
            .expiration(new Date(System.currentTimeMillis() + 3_600_000))
            .signWith(Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(SECRET.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)))
            .compact();
        return ResponseEntity.ok(new TokenResponse(token, "Bearer", 3600));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1636. JWT Refresh Token
**ID:** `SEC-1636`

**Problem:** JWT Refresh Token.

**Example Input:** POST /auth/refresh {refreshToken}

**Example Output:** new access token if refresh valid

**Explanation:** Store refresh tokens in DB; validate on request; issue new access token; revoke old refresh.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.http.*; import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.util.*; import java.time.Instant;

record RefreshRequest(String refreshToken) {}
record TokenPair(String accessToken, String refreshToken) {}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/auth")
public class TokenController {
    private final Map<String,String> refreshStore = new HashMap<>(); // token -> username

    @PostMapping("/refresh")
    public ResponseEntity<?> refresh(@RequestBody RefreshRequest req) {
        String username = refreshStore.get(req.refreshToken());
        if (username == null)
            return ResponseEntity.status(401).body(Map.of("error","Invalid refresh token"));
        refreshStore.remove(req.refreshToken()); // rotate refresh token
        String newRefresh = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        String newAccess = "access." + username + "." + Instant.now().getEpochSecond();
        refreshStore.put(newRefresh, username);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(new TokenPair(newAccess, newRefresh));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(tokens)

### 1637. Role Based Authorization
**ID:** `SEC-1637`

**Problem:** Role Based Authorization.

**Example Input:** ADMIN hits /admin; USER hits /user

**Example Output:** ADMIN: 200; USER: 403 on /admin

**Explanation:** SecurityFilterChain with hasRole(); @PreAuthorize on methods; GrantedAuthority from UserDetails.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.context.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.method.configuration.EnableMethodSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configuration.EnableWebSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

@Configuration @EnableWebSecurity @EnableMethodSecurity
public class RbacSecurityConfig {
    @Bean SecurityFilterChain chain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
        return http.authorizeHttpRequests(a -> a
            .requestMatchers("/admin/**").hasRole("ADMIN")
            .requestMatchers("/user/**").hasAnyRole("USER","ADMIN")
            .requestMatchers("/public/**").permitAll()
            .anyRequest().authenticated())
            .httpBasic(org.springframework.security.config.Customizer.withDefaults())
            .build();
    }
}

@RestController class AdminController {
    @GetMapping("/admin/dashboard") @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')")
    public String dashboard() { return "Admin Dashboard"; }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1639. Password Hashing BCrypt
**ID:** `SEC-1639`

**Problem:** Password Hashing BCrypt.

**Example Input:** register user with plaintext password

**Example Output:** BCrypt hash stored; login validates

**Explanation:** BCryptPasswordEncoder.encode(); matches() verifies without decrypting; salt embedded in hash.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class UserAuthService {
    private final BCryptPasswordEncoder encoder = new BCryptPasswordEncoder(12); // cost=12

    public String register(String rawPassword) {
        String hash = encoder.encode(rawPassword);
        System.out.println("Stored hash: " + hash); // $2a$12$...
        return hash;
    }

    public boolean login(String rawPassword, String storedHash) {
        return encoder.matches(rawPassword, storedHash);
    }
}
// register("secret123") -> $2a$12$xyz... (different each time due to salt)
// login("secret123", hash) -> true
// login("wrong", hash)    -> false
// BCrypt is intentionally slow: 12 rounds ~= 200ms
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1640. CORS Configuration
**ID:** `SEC-1640`

**Problem:** CORS Configuration.

**Example Input:** browser from different origin calls API

**Example Output:** CORS headers present; no blocked request

**Explanation:** CorsConfigurationSource bean defines allowed origins/methods; applied globally via security filter.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.context.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
import org.springframework.web.cors.*;
import java.util.*;

@Configuration
public class CorsSecurityConfig {
    @Bean SecurityFilterChain chain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
        return http.cors(c -> c.configurationSource(corsSource())).csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable()).build();
    }
    @Bean CorsConfigurationSource corsSource() {
        CorsConfiguration cfg = new CorsConfiguration();
        cfg.setAllowedOrigins(List.of("https://app.example.com","http://localhost:3000"));
        cfg.setAllowedMethods(List.of("GET","POST","PUT","DELETE","PATCH","OPTIONS"));
        cfg.setAllowedHeaders(List.of("*"));
        cfg.setAllowCredentials(true);
        cfg.setMaxAge(3600L);
        UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource source = new UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource();
        source.registerCorsConfiguration("/**", cfg);
        return source;
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

```java
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;

@Configuration
public class CsrfConfig {
```

### 1642. Secure Cookie Setup
**ID:** `SEC-1642`

**Problem:** Secure Cookie Setup.

**Example Input:** user logs in

**Example Output:** Set-Cookie with HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict

**Explanation:** ResponseCookie builder sets HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite; prevents XSS and CSRF attacks.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseCookie;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.time.Duration;

@RestController @RequestMapping("/auth")
public class CookieAuthController {
    @PostMapping("/login")
    public String login(@RequestBody java.util.Map<String,String> req, HttpServletResponse res) {
        String token = "jwt-token-" + System.currentTimeMillis();
        ResponseCookie cookie = ResponseCookie.from("auth-token", token)
            .httpOnly(true)     // no JS access
            .secure(true)       // HTTPS only
            .sameSite("Strict") // no cross-site
            .maxAge(Duration.ofHours(1))
            .path("/")
            .build();
        res.addHeader("Set-Cookie", cookie.toString());
        return "Logged in";
    }
    @PostMapping("/logout")
    public String logout(HttpServletResponse res) {
        ResponseCookie del = ResponseCookie.from("auth-token","").maxAge(0).path("/").build();
        res.addHeader("Set-Cookie", del.toString());
        return "Logged out";
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1644. API Rate Limiting Filter
**ID:** `SEC-1644`

**Problem:** API Rate Limiting Filter.

**Example Input:** 10 rapid requests from same IP

**Example Output:** first 5 allowed; rest get 429

**Explanation:** Bucket4j per-IP bucket; check token availability; return 429 with Retry-After header.

**Answer:**
```java
import io.github.bucket4j.*;
import jakarta.servlet.*; import jakarta.servlet.http.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
import java.io.IOException; import java.time.Duration; import java.util.Map; import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

@Component
public class RateLimitFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {
    private final Map<String, Bucket> buckets = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private Bucket bucket(String ip) {
        return buckets.computeIfAbsent(ip, k ->
            Bucket.builder().addLimit(Bandwidth.classic(5, Refill.greedy(5, Duration.ofMinutes(1)))).build());
    }
    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res,
                                    FilterChain chain) throws ServletException, IOException {
        String ip = req.getRemoteAddr();
        if (bucket(ip).tryConsume(1)) { chain.doFilter(req, res); }
        else {
            res.setStatus(429); res.setContentType("application/json");
            res.addHeader("Retry-After","60");
            res.getWriter().write("{"error":"Rate limit exceeded","retryAfter":60}");
        }
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(clients)
---

### 1645. JWT Filter Chain
**ID:** `SEC-1645`

**Problem:** JWT Filter Chain.

**Example Input:** request with Bearer token

**Example Output:** SecurityContext populated; endpoint accessible

**Explanation:** OncePerRequestFilter extracts JWT; validates signature+expiry; sets UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken.

**Answer:**
```java
import io.jsonwebtoken.*; import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys;
import jakarta.servlet.*; import jakarta.servlet.http.*;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
import java.io.IOException; import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets; import java.util.*;

@Component
public class JwtAuthFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {
    private static final String SECRET = "MySuperSecretKey12345678901234567890";
    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res,
                                    FilterChain chain) throws ServletException, IOException {
        String header = req.getHeader("Authorization");
        if (header != null && header.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
            try {
                Claims claims = Jwts.parser()
                    .verifyWith(Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(SECRET.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)))
                    .build().parseSignedClaims(header.substring(7)).getPayload();
                String role = claims.get("role", String.class);
                var auth = new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(
                    claims.getSubject(), null,
                    List.of(new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_" + role)));
                SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(auth);
            } catch (JwtException e) { /* invalid token - no auth set */ }
        }
        chain.doFilter(req, res);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1646. Password Reset Flow
**ID:** `SEC-1646`

**Problem:** Password Reset Flow.

**Example Input:** POST /auth/forgot-password {email}

**Example Output:** reset token emailed; POST /reset with token sets new password

**Explanation:** Generate secure token; store with expiry; email link; validate on reset; hash new password.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import java.security.SecureRandom; import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

record ResetToken(String token, String email, LocalDateTime expiry) {}

@Service
public class PasswordResetService {
    private final Map<String, ResetToken> tokens = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final SecureRandom rng = new SecureRandom();

    public String requestReset(String email) {
        byte[] bytes = new byte[32]; rng.nextBytes(bytes);
        String token = Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(bytes);
        tokens.put(token, new ResetToken(token, email, LocalDateTime.now().plusHours(1)));
        System.out.println("Send email to " + email + " with token: " + token);
        return token;
    }

    public boolean reset(String token, String newPassword) {
        ResetToken rt = tokens.get(token);
        if (rt == null || rt.expiry().isBefore(LocalDateTime.now())) return false;
        tokens.remove(token);
        System.out.println("Reset password for " + rt.email());
        return true;
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(tokens)
---

### 1647. Account Lockout Policy
**ID:** `SEC-1647`

**Problem:** Account Lockout Policy.

**Example Input:** 5 failed logins

**Example Output:** account locked for 15 min; 423 Locked returned

**Explanation:** Track failed attempts in cache; lockout after threshold; unlock after duration or admin action.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import java.time.LocalDateTime; import java.util.Map; import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

record LockInfo(int attempts, LocalDateTime lastAttempt, LocalDateTime lockedUntil) {}

@Service
public class AccountLockoutService {
    private static final int MAX = 5;
    private static final int LOCK_MIN = 15;
    private final Map<String, LockInfo> store = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public boolean isLocked(String username) {
        LockInfo info = store.get(username);
        if (info == null || info.lockedUntil() == null) return false;
        if (info.lockedUntil().isAfter(LocalDateTime.now())) return true;
        store.remove(username); return false;
    }

    public void recordFailure(String username) {
        LockInfo prev = store.getOrDefault(username, new LockInfo(0,null,null));
        int count = prev.attempts() + 1;
        LocalDateTime locked = count >= MAX ? LocalDateTime.now().plusMinutes(LOCK_MIN) : null;
        store.put(username, new LockInfo(count, LocalDateTime.now(), locked));
        System.out.println("Failures: " + count + (locked!=null ? " -> LOCKED" : ""));
    }

    public void recordSuccess(String username) { store.remove(username); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(users)
---

**ID:** `SEC-1649`

```java
import org.springframework.context.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
import org.springframework.security.web.header.writers.StaticHeadersWriter;

@Configuration
public class CspConfig {
    @Bean
    public SecurityFilterChain chain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
        return http
            .headers(h -> h
                .contentSecurityPolicy(csp -> csp.policyDirectives(
                    "default-src 'self'; " +
                    "script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com; " +
                    "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; " +
                    "img-src 'self' data: https:; " +
                    "frame-ancestors 'none'"))
                .addHeaderWriter(new StaticHeadersWriter("X-Content-Type-Options","nosniff"))
                .frameOptions(f -> f.deny()))
            .build();
    }
}
```

### 1651. Two Factor Auth TOTP
**ID:** `SEC-1651`

**Problem:** Two Factor Auth TOTP.

**Example Input:** login with password + TOTP code

**Example Output:** 2FA verified; session granted

**Explanation:** Generate TOTP secret; QR code for authenticator app; validate 6-digit code on login.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import java.security.*; import java.util.Base64;
import javax.crypto.Mac; import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;

@Service
public class TotpService {
    public String generateSecret() {
        byte[] bytes = new byte[20]; new SecureRandom().nextBytes(bytes);
        return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(bytes);
    }
    public int generateCode(String secret, long timeStep) throws Exception {
        byte[] key = Base64.getDecoder().decode(secret);
        Mac mac = Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA1");
        mac.init(new SecretKeySpec(key,"HmacSHA1"));
        byte[] msg = new byte[8];
        for (int i=7; i>=0; i--) { msg[i]=(byte)(timeStep&0xFF); timeStep>>=8; }
        byte[] hash = mac.doFinal(msg);
        int offset = hash[19]&0xF;
        int code = ((hash[offset]&0x7F)<<24)|((hash[offset+1]&0xFF)<<16)|
                   ((hash[offset+2]&0xFF)<<8)|(hash[offset+3]&0xFF);
        return code % 1_000_000;
    }
    public boolean verify(String secret, int userCode) throws Exception {
        long step = System.currentTimeMillis()/30_000;
        for (long t=step-1; t<=step+1; t++)
            if (generateCode(secret,t)==userCode) return true;
        return false;
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1652. SQL Injection Prevention
**ID:** `SEC-1652`

**Problem:** SQL Injection Prevention.

**Example Input:** POST /api/users/search {name}

**Example Output:** parameterized query; injection blocked

**Explanation:** Use @Param in @Query or JpaRepository derived methods; never concatenate user input into SQL.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.*;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;
import java.util.List;

@Entity class User { @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String name; String email; String role; }

interface UserRepository extends JpaRepository<User,Long> {
    // SAFE: parameterized JPQL
    @Query("SELECT u FROM User u WHERE u.name LIKE %:name% AND u.role = :role")
    List<User> search(@Param("name") String name, @Param("role") String role);

    // SAFE: derived query method
    List<User> findByNameContainingAndRole(String name, String role);

    // UNSAFE (never do this):
    // @Query("SELECT u FROM User u WHERE u.name = '" + name + "'")
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)
---

### 1653. XSS Prevention
**ID:** `SEC-1653`

```java
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.apache.commons.text.StringEscapeUtils;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank; import jakarta.validation.Valid;

class CommentDto {
    @NotBlank String author;
    @NotBlank String content;
    public CommentDto sanitized() {
        return new CommentDto(
            StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml4(author),
            StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml4(content));
    }
    CommentDto(String a, String c) { author=a; content=c; }
    String author() { return author; } String content() { return content; }
}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/comments")
public class CommentController {
    @PostMapping
    public CommentDto create(@Valid @RequestBody CommentDto dto) {
        CommentDto safe = dto.sanitized();

        return safe;
    }
}
// Input: <script>alert('xss')</script>
// Output: &lt;script&gt;alert('xss')&lt;/script&gt;
```

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.servlet.*; import jakarta.servlet.http.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
import java.io.IOException; import java.util.Set;

@Component
public class IpWhitelistFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {
    private static final Set<String> ALLOWED = Set.of("127.0.0.1","192.168.1.0","10.0.0.1");
    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res,
                                    FilterChain chain) throws ServletException, IOException {
        String ip = req.getHeader("X-Forwarded-For");
        if (ip==null) ip = req.getRemoteAddr();
        ip = ip.split(",")[0].trim();
        if (ALLOWED.contains(ip)) { chain.doFilter(req, res); }
        else {
            res.setStatus(HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN);
            res.getWriter().write("{"error":"Access denied from IP: "+ip+""}");
        }
    }
    @Override
    protected boolean shouldNotFilter(HttpServletRequest req) {
        return req.getServletPath().startsWith("/actuator/health");
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

```java
import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.*;

@JsonInclude(JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL)
public class PaymentInfo {
    private String cardNumber;
    private String cvv;
    private String holderName;
    private double amount;

    @JsonProperty("cardNumber")
    public String getMaskedCard() {
        if (cardNumber==null || cardNumber.length()<4) return "****";
        return "*".repeat(cardNumber.length()-4) + cardNumber.substring(cardNumber.length()-4);
    }
    @JsonIgnore public String getCvv() { return cvv; }
    public String getHolderName() { return holderName; }
    public double getAmount() { return amount; }
    @Override public String toString() {
        return "PaymentInfo{card=****"+cardNumber.substring(cardNumber.length()-4)+",amount="+amount+"}";
    }
}
```

### 1658. API Gateway Security
**ID:** `SEC-1658`

**Problem:** API Gateway Security.

**Example Input:** all requests routed through gateway

**Example Output:** JWT validated at gateway; no re-auth on services

**Explanation:** Spring Cloud Gateway with JWT validation filter; propagate user info via X-User-Id header.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.cloud.gateway.filter.*;
import org.springframework.core.annotation.Order;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import io.jsonwebtoken.*; import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

@Component @Order(-1)
public class JwtGatewayFilter implements GlobalFilter {
    private static final String SECRET = "MySuperSecretKey12345678901234567890";
    @Override
    public Mono<Void> filter(org.springframework.web.server.ServerWebExchange exchange, GatewayFilterChain chain) {
        String header = exchange.getRequest().getHeaders().getFirst("Authorization");
        if (header==null || !header.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
            exchange.getResponse().setStatusCode(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
            return exchange.getResponse().setComplete();
        }
        try {
            Claims claims = Jwts.parser()
                .verifyWith(Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(SECRET.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)))
                .build().parseSignedClaims(header.substring(7)).getPayload();
            var newReq = exchange.getRequest().mutate().header("X-User-Id", claims.getSubject()).build();
            return chain.filter(exchange.mutate().request(newReq).build());
        } catch (JwtException e) {
            exchange.getResponse().setStatusCode(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
            return exchange.getResponse().setComplete();
        }
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1659. Encryption At Rest
**ID:** `SEC-1659`

**Problem:** Encryption At Rest.

**Example Input:** store sensitive config in encrypted form

**Example Output:** decrypted at runtime; plain in memory

**Explanation:** Spring Cloud Config encryption; Jasypt for property encryption; AES via javax.crypto.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import javax.crypto.*; import javax.crypto.spec.*;
import java.util.Base64;

@Service
public class EncryptionService {
    private static final String KEY = "AES-256-KEY-12345678901234567890"; // 32 bytes
    private final SecretKeySpec keySpec;
    public EncryptionService() { keySpec = new SecretKeySpec(KEY.getBytes(),"AES"); }

    public String encrypt(String data) throws Exception {
        Cipher c = Cipher.getInstance("AES/ECB/PKCS5Padding");
        c.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, keySpec);
        return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(c.doFinal(data.getBytes()));
    }
    public String decrypt(String encrypted) throws Exception {
        Cipher c = Cipher.getInstance("AES/ECB/PKCS5Padding");
        c.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, keySpec);
        return new String(c.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(encrypted)));
    }
}
// application.properties: app.db.password=ENC(base64encrypted)
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

### 1660. Permission Evaluator
**ID:** `SEC-1660`

**Problem:** Permission Evaluator.

**Example Input:** user accesses document owned by another

**Example Output:** 403 if not owner or ADMIN

**Explanation:** Custom PermissionEvaluator; @PreAuthorize('hasPermission(#doc, read)'); checks ownership.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.security.access.PermissionEvaluator;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import java.io.Serializable;

record Document(Long id, String owner, String content) {}

@Component
public class DocumentPermissionEvaluator implements PermissionEvaluator {
    @Override
    public boolean hasPermission(Authentication auth, Object target, Object permission) {
        if (!(target instanceof Document doc)) return false;
        boolean isAdmin = auth.getAuthorities().stream()
            .anyMatch(a -> a.getAuthority().equals("ROLE_ADMIN"));
        boolean isOwner = doc.owner().equals(auth.getName());
        return isAdmin || (isOwner && "read".equals(permission));
    }
    @Override
    public boolean hasPermission(Authentication a, Serializable id, String type, Object perm) { return false; }
}
// Service: @PreAuthorize("hasPermission(#doc,'read')") public Document get(Document doc) {...}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

```java
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Async;
import org.springframework.security.concurrent.DelegatingSecurityContextRunnable;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

@Service
public class AsyncSecurityService {

    @Async
    public void processAsync() {
        String user = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication().getName();
        System.out.println("Async user: " + user);
    }

    public void runWithContext(Runnable task) {
        executor.submit(new DelegatingSecurityContextRunnable(task,
            SecurityContextHolder.getContext()));
    }
}
```

```java
@Configuration
```

```java
import jakarta.servlet.http.*;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.security.cert.X509Certificate;

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/mtls")
public class MtlsController {
    @GetMapping("/hello")

        String cn = certs[0].getSubjectX500Principal().getName();
        return "Hello, " + cn;
    }
}
```

```java
// Resilience4j Circuit Breaker + Retry + Bulkhead
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.annotation.CircuitBreaker;
import io.github.resilience4j.retry.annotation.Retry;
import io.github.resilience4j.bulkhead.annotation.Bulkhead;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

@Service
public class OrderServiceClient {
    private final RestTemplate rest;
    OrderServiceClient(RestTemplate r) { rest = r; }

    @CircuitBreaker(name = "orderService", fallbackMethod = "orderFallback")
    @Retry(name = "orderService")
    @Bulkhead(name = "orderService")
    public String getOrder(String orderId) {
        return rest.getForObject("http://order-service/orders/" + orderId, String.class);
    }

    public String orderFallback(String orderId, Exception ex) {
        return "Order service unavailable. OrderId=" + orderId + " Error: " + ex.getMessage();
    }
}
```

```java
// Saga Pattern - Orchestration style
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import java.util.*;

@Service
public class OrderSaga {
    private final PaymentService paymentService;
    private final InventoryService inventoryService;
    private final ShippingService shippingService;

    OrderSaga(PaymentService p, InventoryService i, ShippingService s) {
        paymentService = p; inventoryService = i; shippingService = s;
    }

    public void processOrder(String orderId, double amount) {
        String paymentId = null;
        try {
            paymentId = paymentService.charge(orderId, amount);
            inventoryService.reserve(orderId);
            shippingService.schedule(orderId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // Compensating transactions
            if (paymentId != null) paymentService.refund(paymentId);
            inventoryService.release(orderId);
            throw new RuntimeException("Order failed, compensations applied", e);
        }
    }
}
// Interfaces for services (implementation omitted for brevity)
interface PaymentService { String charge(String orderId, double amount); void refund(String id); }
interface InventoryService { void reserve(String orderId); void release(String orderId); }
interface ShippingService { void schedule(String orderId); }
```

### 1669. Saga Pattern
**ID:** `MS-1669`

**Problem:** Saga Pattern.

**Example Input:** order service calls payment and inventory

**Example Output:** each step has compensating transaction on failure

**Explanation:** Choreography saga: events trigger next step; compensate on failure. Orchestration: central coordinator.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisher;
import org.springframework.context.event.EventListener;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

record OrderCreated(Long orderId, double amount) {}
record PaymentFailed(Long orderId, String reason) {}
record OrderCancelled(Long orderId, String reason) {}

@Service class OrderService {
    private final ApplicationEventPublisher pub;
    OrderService(ApplicationEventPublisher p) { pub=p; }
    public void placeOrder(Long id, double amount) {
        System.out.println("Order created: "+id);
        pub.publishEvent(new OrderCreated(id, amount));
    }
    @EventListener public void onPaymentFailed(PaymentFailed e) {
        System.out.println("Compensate: cancel order "+e.orderId()+" reason="+e.reason());
        pub.publishEvent(new OrderCancelled(e.orderId(), e.reason()));
    }
}

@Service class PaymentService {
    private final ApplicationEventPublisher pub;
    PaymentService(ApplicationEventPublisher p) { pub=p; }
    @EventListener public void onOrder(OrderCreated e) {
        if (e.amount() > 9999) pub.publishEvent(new PaymentFailed(e.orderId(),"Exceeds limit"));
        else System.out.println("Payment OK for order "+e.orderId());
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(steps) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1670. Outbox Pattern
**ID:** `MS-1670`

**Problem:** Outbox Pattern.

**Example Input:** save order and event atomically

**Example Output:** event published after commit; no lost events

**Explanation:** Transactional outbox: write event to outbox table in same TX; poller publishes to broker.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import java.time.LocalDateTime; import java.util.List;

@Entity class OutboxEvent {
    @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String type; String payload;
    boolean published = false; LocalDateTime createdAt = LocalDateTime.now();
}
@Entity class Order { @Id @GeneratedValue Long id; String item; }

@Service class OrderOutboxService {
    @PersistenceContext EntityManager em;
    @Transactional
    public void createOrder(String item) {
        Order o = new Order(); o.item=item; em.persist(o);
        OutboxEvent ev = new OutboxEvent(); ev.type="ORDER_CREATED";
        ev.payload="{"item":""+item+""}"; em.persist(ev);
        System.out.println("Order and event saved atomically");
    }
    @Scheduled(fixedDelay=5000)
    @Transactional
    public void pollAndPublish() {
        List<OutboxEvent> pending = em.createQuery(
            "SELECT e FROM OutboxEvent e WHERE e.published=false", OutboxEvent.class).getResultList();
        pending.forEach(e -> {
            System.out.println("Publishing: "+e.type+" "+e.payload);
            e.published=true;
        });
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1671. Idempotency Key
**ID:** `MS-1671`

**Problem:** Idempotency Key.

**Example Input:** POST /orders with X-Idempotency-Key header

**Example Output:** duplicate request returns same response; no double-process

**Explanation:** Store idempotency key + response; check before processing; return cached response on duplicate.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.http.*; import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import java.util.Map; import java.util.UUID; import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

record OrderRequest(String item, double amount) {}
record OrderResult(String orderId, String status) {}

@Service class IdempotencyService {
    private final Map<String, OrderResult> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    public OrderResult process(String key, OrderRequest req) {
        return cache.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> {
            System.out.println("Processing new request: "+k);
            return new OrderResult(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), "CREATED");
        });
    }
}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/orders")
class IdempotentController {
    private final IdempotencyService svc;
    IdempotentController(IdempotencyService s) { svc=s; }
    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<OrderResult> create(
            @RequestHeader("X-Idempotency-Key") String key,
            @RequestBody OrderRequest req) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(svc.process(key, req));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(requests)

### 1673. Correlation ID
**ID:** `MS-1673`

**Problem:** Correlation ID.

**Example Input:** request enters gateway

**Example Output:** same correlation ID in all downstream logs

**Explanation:** MDC.put() stores correlation ID; filter generates ID; propagated via X-Correlation-Id header.

**Answer:**
```java
import jakarta.servlet.*; import jakarta.servlet.http.*;
import org.slf4j.MDC;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
import java.io.IOException; import java.util.UUID;

@Component
public class CorrelationIdFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {
    private static final String HEADER = "X-Correlation-Id";
    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res,
                                    FilterChain chain) throws ServletException, IOException {
        String correlationId = req.getHeader(HEADER);
        if (correlationId==null || correlationId.isBlank())
            correlationId = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        MDC.put("correlationId", correlationId);
        res.setHeader(HEADER, correlationId);
        try { chain.doFilter(req, res); }
        finally { MDC.remove("correlationId"); }
    }
}
// logback.xml pattern: [%X{correlationId}] %msg
// Downstream services: extract X-Correlation-Id and MDC.put() again
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

```java
import org.springframework.cloud.openfeign.*;

@FeignClient(name="user-service", url="${user-service.url}")
interface UserClient {
    @GetMapping("/api/users/{id}")
    UserDto getUser(@PathVariable("id") Long id);
    @PostMapping("/api/users")
    UserDto createUser(@RequestBody UserCreateDto dto);
}

record UserDto(Long id, String name, String email) {}
record UserCreateDto(String name, String email) {}

@Service class OrderEnrichmentService {
    private final UserClient userClient;
    OrderEnrichmentService(UserClient uc) { userClient=uc; }
    public String enrichOrder(Long userId, String item) {
        UserDto user = userClient.getUser(userId);
        return "Order for "+user.name()+": "+item;
    }
}
// @SpringBootApplication @EnableFeignClients class App {}
```

### 1676. Bulkhead Pattern
**ID:** `MS-1676`

**Problem:** Bulkhead Pattern.

**Example Input:** inventory service slow; order requests isolated

**Example Output:** order service not affected; bulkhead limits threads

**Explanation:** Bulkhead isolates resources per service call; ThreadPoolBulkhead or SemaphoreBulkhead via Resilience4j.

**Answer:**
```java
import io.github.resilience4j.bulkhead.*;
import io.github.resilience4j.bulkhead.annotation.Bulkhead;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class InventoryService {
    @Bulkhead(name="inventory", fallbackMethod="fallback",
              type=Bulkhead.Type.THREADPOOL)
    public String checkStock(String product) {
        System.out.println("Checking stock for: "+product);
        return "In stock: "+product;
    }
    public String fallback(String product, Throwable t) {
        return "Stock check unavailable for "+product+" (bulkhead full)";
    }
}
// application.yml:
// resilience4j.bulkhead.instances.inventory:
//   maxConcurrentCalls: 10
//   maxWaitDuration: 500ms
// resilience4j.thread-pool-bulkhead.instances.inventory:
//   maxThreadPoolSize: 5
//   coreThreadPoolSize: 2
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(threads)
---

### 1677. Graceful Shutdown
**ID:** `MS-1677`

**Problem:** Graceful Shutdown.

**Example Input:** SIGTERM sent to service

**Example Output:** in-flight requests complete; no new requests accepted

**Explanation:** server.shutdown=graceful; spring.lifecycle.timeout-per-shutdown-phase; Actuator prestop hook.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.boot.web.embedded.tomcat.TomcatConnectorCustomizer;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.context.ApplicationListener;
import org.springframework.context.event.ContextClosedEvent;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

@Configuration
public class GracefulShutdownConfig {
    @Bean TomcatConnectorCustomizer gracefulConnector(GracefulShutdownHook hook) {
        return connector -> hook.setConnector(connector);
    }
    @Bean GracefulShutdownHook gracefulShutdownHook() { return new GracefulShutdownHook(); }
}

class GracefulShutdownHook implements ApplicationListener<ContextClosedEvent> {
    private volatile org.apache.catalina.connector.Connector connector;
    public void setConnector(org.apache.catalina.connector.Connector c) { connector=c; }
    @Override public void onApplicationEvent(ContextClosedEvent e) {
        if (connector==null) return;
        connector.pause();
        System.out.println("Connector paused; draining in-flight requests...");
    }
}
// application.properties:
// server.shutdown=graceful
// spring.lifecycle.timeout-per-shutdown-phase=30s
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1678. Backpressure Handling
**ID:** `MS-1678`

**Problem:** Backpressure Handling.

**Example Input:** producer faster than consumer

**Example Output:** consumer applies backpressure; producer slows

**Explanation:** Project Reactor: Flux.create with FluxSink; limitRate(); onBackpressureDrop/Buffer strategies.

**Answer:**
```java
import reactor.core.publisher.Flux;
import reactor.core.scheduler.Schedulers;

public class BackpressureDemo {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws InterruptedException {
        Flux.range(1, 1000)
            .log()
            .limitRate(10) // request 10 at a time from upstream
            .publishOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .doOnNext(i -> {
                if (i % 10 == 0) {
                    try { Thread.sleep(100); } catch (Exception ex) {}
                }
                System.out.println("Consumed: "+i);
            })
            .subscribe();
        Thread.sleep(5000);
    }
}
// Strategies:
// onBackpressureDrop() - drop items if consumer slow
// onBackpressureBuffer(100) - buffer up to 100
// onBackpressureLatest() - keep only latest
// limitRate(10) - request batch of 10
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(buffer)
---

```java
import org.springframework.boot.actuate.health.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component("database")
class DatabaseHealthIndicator implements HealthIndicator {
    @Override public Health health() {
        try { return Health.up().withDetail("db","connected").build(); }
        catch (Exception e) { return Health.down().withDetail("error",e.getMessage()).build(); }
    }
}

@Component("cache")
class RedisHealthIndicator implements HealthIndicator {
    @Override public Health health() {
        return Health.up().withDetail("redis","connected").withDetail("latency","2ms").build();
    }
}

@Component("paymentService")
class PaymentServiceHealthIndicator implements HealthIndicator {
    @Override public Health health() {
        return Health.up().withDetail("payment-api","reachable").build();
    }
}
// GET /actuator/health -> {"status":"UP","components":{"database":{"status":"UP"},...}}
// application.properties: management.endpoint.health.show-details=always
```

### 1683. Circuit Breaker Resilience4j
**ID:** `MS-1683`

**Problem:** Circuit Breaker Resilience4j.

**Example Input:** downstream service fails repeatedly

**Example Output:** circuit opens; fallback returned

**Explanation:** @CircuitBreaker(name, fallbackMethod); state machine CLOSED/OPEN/HALF_OPEN; fail-fast protection.

**Answer:**
```java
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.annotation.CircuitBreaker;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

@Service
public class PaymentClientService {
    private final RestTemplate rest;
    PaymentClientService(RestTemplate r) { rest=r; }

    @CircuitBreaker(name="paymentService", fallbackMethod="paymentFallback")
    public String processPayment(Long orderId, double amount) {
        return rest.postForObject("http://payment-service/pay",
            java.util.Map.of("orderId",orderId,"amount",amount), String.class);
    }

    public String paymentFallback(Long orderId, double amount, Exception ex) {
        return "Payment deferred for order "+orderId+" (circuit open)";
    }
}
// application.yml:
// resilience4j.circuitbreaker.instances.paymentService:
//   failure-rate-threshold: 50
//   wait-duration-in-open-state: 10s
//   sliding-window-size: 5
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1684. Event Driven Architecture
**ID:** `MS-1684`

**Problem:** Event Driven Architecture.

**Example Input:** order placed event published

**Example Output:** inventory and email services react independently

**Explanation:** ApplicationEventPublisher or Kafka topic; loose coupling; async processing; eventual consistency.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisher;
import org.springframework.context.event.EventListener;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Async;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

record OrderPlacedEvent(Long orderId, String item, int qty, String email) {}

@Service class OrderService {
    private final ApplicationEventPublisher pub;
    OrderService(ApplicationEventPublisher p) { pub=p; }
    public void place(Long id, String item, int qty, String email) {
        System.out.println("Order placed: "+id);
        pub.publishEvent(new OrderPlacedEvent(id, item, qty, email));
    }
}

@Service class InventoryService {
    @Async @EventListener
    public void on(OrderPlacedEvent e) { System.out.println("Reserve "+e.qty()+" of "+e.item()); }
}

@Service class NotificationService {
    @Async @EventListener
    public void on(OrderPlacedEvent e) { System.out.println("Email "+e.email()+": order "+e.orderId()+" confirmed"); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(subscribers)

### 1685. CQRS Pattern
**ID:** `MS-1685`

**Problem:** CQRS Pattern.

**Example Input:** write via command; read via query model

**Example Output:** command updates write DB; query reads optimized view

**Explanation:** Command model (write): handles business logic; Query model (read): denormalized for fast reads.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

record CreateProductCommand(String name, double price) {}
record ProductView(Long id, String name, double price, int sales) {}

// Write side (Command)
@Service class ProductCommandService {
    private final Map<Long,ProductView> readStore; // shared or replicated
    private long seq=1;
    ProductCommandService(Map<Long,ProductView> rs) { readStore=rs; }
    public Long handle(CreateProductCommand cmd) {
        Long id = seq++;
        System.out.println("Command: create product "+cmd.name());
        readStore.put(id, new ProductView(id, cmd.name(), cmd.price(), 0));
        return id;
    }
}

// Read side (Query)
@Service class ProductQueryService {
    private final Map<Long,ProductView> readStore;
    ProductQueryService(Map<Long,ProductView> rs) { readStore=rs; }
    public ProductView find(Long id) { return readStore.get(id); }
    public List<ProductView> findAll() { return new ArrayList<>(readStore.values()); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) write &nbsp; **Space:** O(n) read
---

### 1688. Canary Deployment
**ID:** `MS-1688`

**Problem:** Canary Deployment.

```java
// Kubernetes canary with two deployments:
// order-service-stable: replicas: 9  (90%)
// order-service-canary: replicas: 1  (10%)
// Same service selector label hits both proportionally

// Istio canary (precise control):
// VirtualService: weight 95% to stable, 5% to canary
// Monitor: Prometheus error rate on canary vs stable
// Auto-rollback: Flagger or Argo Rollouts

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.boot.actuate.health.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component class VersionHealthIndicator implements HealthIndicator {
    @Value("${app.version:stable}") String version;
    @Value("${app.canary:false}") boolean canary;
    @Override public Health health() {
        return Health.up().withDetail("version",version).withDetail("canary",canary).build();
    }
}
// Canary metric: if errorRate(canary) > 1% -> rollback
```

### 1691. Async Messaging RabbitMQ
**ID:** `MS-1691`

**Problem:** Async Messaging RabbitMQ.

**Example Input:** publish order event to RabbitMQ

**Example Output:** consumer processes asynchronously

**Explanation:** RabbitTemplate.convertAndSend(); @RabbitListener on consumer; exchange+queue+binding setup.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.core.RabbitTemplate;
import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.annotation.RabbitListener;
import org.springframework.amqp.core.*;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Configuration class RabbitConfig {
    @Bean DirectExchange exchange() { return new DirectExchange("orders.exchange"); }
    @Bean Queue queue() { return new Queue("orders.queue", true); }
    @Bean Binding binding(Queue q, DirectExchange ex) {
        return BindingBuilder.bind(q).to(ex).with("order.created");
    }
}

@Service class OrderPublisher {
    private final RabbitTemplate rabbit;
    OrderPublisher(RabbitTemplate r) { rabbit=r; }
    public void publish(Long orderId, String item) {
        rabbit.convertAndSend("orders.exchange","order.created",
            "{"orderId":"+orderId+","item":""+item+""}");
        System.out.println("Published order: "+orderId);
    }
}

@Service class OrderConsumer {
    @RabbitListener(queues="orders.queue")
    public void consume(String message) { System.out.println("Received: "+message); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

```java
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Flux; import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import java.time.Duration; import java.util.List;

record Product(Long id, String name, double price) {}

@Service class ReactiveProductService {
    public Flux<Product> findAll() {
        return Flux.just(
            new Product(1L,"Laptop",999.0),
            new Product(2L,"Phone",699.0),
            new Product(3L,"Tablet",449.0));
    }
    public Mono<Product> findById(Long id) {
        return Flux.just(
            new Product(1L,"Laptop",999.0),
            new Product(2L,"Phone",699.0))
            .filter(p -> p.id().equals(id)).next();
    }
}

@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/products")
class ReactiveController {

    ReactiveController(ReactiveProductService s) { svc=s; }
    @GetMapping(produces="application/json")
    public Flux<Product> all() { return svc.findAll(); }
    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public Mono<Product> one(@PathVariable Long id) { return svc.findById(id); }
}
```

```java
import com.hazelcast.core.HazelcastInstance;
import org.springframework.cache.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import java.util.List;

@Service @EnableCaching
public class CachedProductService {
    private final HazelcastInstance hazelcast;
    CachedProductService(HazelcastInstance h) { hazelcast=h; }

    @Cacheable(value="products", key="#category")
    public List<String> getByCategory(String category) {
        System.out.println("DB query for category: "+category);
        return List.of("Product-A","Product-B","Product-C");
    }

    @CacheEvict(value="products", key="#category")
    public void evict(String category) { System.out.println("Cache evicted: "+category); }

    @CachePut(value="products", key="#category")
    public List<String> refresh(String category, List<String> products) { return products; }
}
// application.yml:

```

```java
import org.springframework.graphql.data.method.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Controller;
import java.util.*;

record User(Long id, String name, String email) {}
record Order(Long id, String item, double amount) {}

@Controller
public class GraphQLResolver {
    @QueryMapping
    public User user(@Argument Long id) {
        return new User(id, "Alice", "alice@example.com");
    }
    @SchemaMapping(typeName="User", field="orders")
    public List<Order> orders(User user) {
        return List.of(new Order(1L,"Laptop",999.0), new Order(2L,"Phone",699.0));
    }
    @QueryMapping
    public List<User> users() {
        return List.of(new User(1L,"Alice","alice@example.com"), new User(2L,"Bob","bob@example.com"));
    }
}
// schema.graphqls:
// type Query { user(id: ID): User; users: [User] }
// type User { id: ID; name: String; email: String; orders: [Order] }
// type Order { id: ID; item: String; amount: Float }
```

```java
// inventory.proto:
// syntax = "proto3";
// service InventoryService { rpc CheckStock (StockRequest) returns (StockResponse); }
// message StockRequest { string product = 1; int32 quantity = 2; }
// message StockResponse { bool available = 1; int32 current = 2; }

import io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver;
import net.devh.boot.grpc.server.service.GrpcService;
import net.devh.boot.grpc.client.inject.GrpcClient;

// Server (inventory-service):
@GrpcService
class InventoryGrpcService extends InventoryServiceGrpc.InventoryServiceImplBase {
    @Override
    public void checkStock(StockRequest req, StreamObserver<StockResponse> observer) {
        boolean available = req.getQuantity() <= 100;
        observer.onNext(StockResponse.newBuilder().setAvailable(available).setCurrent(100).build());
        observer.onCompleted();
    }
}

// Client (order-service):
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
@Service class OrderGrpcClient {
    @GrpcClient("inventory-service")
    private InventoryServiceGrpc.InventoryServiceBlockingStub stub;
    public boolean check(String product, int qty) {
        return stub.checkStock(StockRequest.newBuilder().setProduct(product).setQuantity(qty).build()).getAvailable();
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1696. Event Sourcing Implementation
**ID:** `MS-1696`

**Problem:** Event Sourcing Implementation.

**Example Input:** save account state as events

**Example Output:** replay events to rebuild current state

**Explanation:** Store events not state; aggregate rebuilt by replaying; Axon Framework or custom EventStore.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import java.util.*; import java.time.LocalDateTime;

sealed interface AccountEvent permits AccountCreated, MoneyDeposited, MoneyWithdrawn {}
record AccountCreated(Long id, String owner, double initial, LocalDateTime at) implements AccountEvent {}
record MoneyDeposited(Long id, double amount, LocalDateTime at) implements AccountEvent {}
record MoneyWithdrawn(Long id, double amount, LocalDateTime at) implements AccountEvent {}

class Account {
    Long id; String owner; double balance;
    static Account replay(List<AccountEvent> events) {
        Account a = new Account();
        for (AccountEvent e : events) switch(e) {
            case AccountCreated c -> { a.id=c.id(); a.owner=c.owner(); a.balance=c.initial(); }
            case MoneyDeposited d -> a.balance += d.amount();
            case MoneyWithdrawn w -> a.balance -= w.amount();
        }
        return a;
    }
}

@Service class EventStore {
    private final Map<Long,List<AccountEvent>> store = new HashMap<>();
    public void append(Long id, AccountEvent event) {
        store.computeIfAbsent(id, k->new ArrayList<>()).add(event);
    }
    public Account load(Long id) { return Account.replay(store.getOrDefault(id, List.of())); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(events) &nbsp; **Space:** O(events)

### 1700. Anti Corruption Layer
**ID:** `MS-1700`

**Problem:** Anti Corruption Layer.

**Example Output:** ACL translates to domain model

**Explanation:** ACL adapter/translator between bounded contexts; prevent legacy model from polluting domain.

```java
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

// Legacy system model (external)
record LegacyCustomer(String custNo, String fullName, String addr, String contactPhone) {}

// Our domain model
record Customer(String id, String name, String address, String phone) {}

// Anti-Corruption Layer: translates legacy -> domain
@Service
public class LegacyCustomerAcl {
    private final LegacyCustomerClient legacyClient;
    LegacyCustomerAcl(LegacyCustomerClient c) { legacyClient=c; }

    public Customer getCustomer(String id) {
        LegacyCustomer lc = legacyClient.findByCustNo(id);
        return translate(lc);
    }
    private Customer translate(LegacyCustomer lc) {
        return new Customer(lc.custNo(), lc.fullName(), lc.addr(), lc.contactPhone());
    }
}

class LegacyCustomerClient {
    public LegacyCustomer findByCustNo(String no) {
        return new LegacyCustomer(no,"John Doe","123 Main St","555-1234");
    }
}
```

### 1702. Aggregator Pattern
**ID:** `MS-1702`

**Problem:** Aggregator Pattern.

**Example Input:** client needs order + user + inventory data

**Example Output:** aggregator calls all 3; returns combined response

**Explanation:** Aggregator service calls multiple services in parallel; merges responses; returns unified DTO.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*;

record OrderSummary(Map order, Map user, Map inventory) {}

@Service
public class OrderAggregatorService {
    private final RestTemplate rest;
    OrderAggregatorService(RestTemplate r) { rest=r; }

    public OrderSummary aggregate(Long orderId) throws Exception {
        ExecutorService exec = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3);
        Future<Map> orderFuture = exec.submit(() ->
            rest.getForObject("http://order-service/api/orders/"+orderId, Map.class));
        Future<Map> userFuture = exec.submit(() ->
            rest.getForObject("http://user-service/api/users/1", Map.class));
        Future<Map> inventoryFuture = exec.submit(() ->
            rest.getForObject("http://inventory-service/api/stock", Map.class));
        Map order = orderFuture.get(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        Map user = userFuture.get(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        Map inventory = inventoryFuture.get(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        exec.shutdown();
        return new OrderSummary(order, user, inventory);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(max(calls)) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)
---

### 1703. Compensating Transaction
**ID:** `MS-1703`

**Problem:** Compensating Transaction.

**Example Input:** transfer fails midway

**Example Output:** rollback via compensating transactions

**Explanation:** Saga compensating: each step defines undo action; on failure trigger compensation in reverse.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import java.util.*;

interface SagaStep { void execute(); void compensate(); }

@Service
public class TransferSaga {
    private final List<SagaStep> executed = new ArrayList<>();

    public void execute(SagaStep step) {
        step.execute(); executed.add(step);
    }

    public void rollback() {
        List<SagaStep> reversed = new ArrayList<>(executed);
        Collections.reverse(reversed);
        for (SagaStep s : reversed) { try { s.compensate(); } catch (Exception e) { /* log */ } }
        executed.clear();
    }

    public boolean transfer(Long fromId, Long toId, double amount) {
        try {
            execute(new SagaStep() {
                public void execute() { System.out.println("Debit "+fromId+" by "+amount); }
                public void compensate() { System.out.println("Credit back "+fromId+" "+amount); }
            });
            execute(new SagaStep() {
                public void execute() { System.out.println("Credit "+toId+" by "+amount); if(amount>9999) throw new RuntimeException("Limit exceeded"); }
                public void compensate() { System.out.println("Debit back "+toId+" "+amount); }
            });
            return true;
        } catch (Exception e) { rollback(); return false; }
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(steps) &nbsp; **Space:** O(steps)
---

### 1705. Distributed Saga Choreography
**ID:** `MS-1705`

**Problem:** Distributed Saga Choreography.

**Example Input:** order placement triggers saga across 3 services

**Example Output:** each service reacts to events; eventual consistency

**Explanation:** Choreography: services publish events and react to each other; no central coordinator.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisher;
import org.springframework.context.event.EventListener;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

// Events
record OrderCreated(Long id, String item, double amount) {}
record PaymentCompleted(Long orderId) {}
record PaymentFailed(Long orderId) {}
record InventoryReserved(Long orderId) {}
record OrderCompleted(Long orderId) {}
record OrderFailed(Long orderId, String reason) {}

@Service class PaymentSagaService {
    private final ApplicationEventPublisher pub;
    PaymentSagaService(ApplicationEventPublisher p){pub=p;}
    @EventListener public void on(OrderCreated e) {
        System.out.println("Payment for order "+e.id());
        if (e.amount()>0) pub.publishEvent(new PaymentCompleted(e.id()));
        else pub.publishEvent(new PaymentFailed(e.id()));
    }
}
@Service class InventorySagaService {
    private final ApplicationEventPublisher pub;
    InventorySagaService(ApplicationEventPublisher p){pub=p;}
    @EventListener public void on(PaymentCompleted e) {
        System.out.println("Reserve inventory for order "+e.orderId());
        pub.publishEvent(new InventoryReserved(e.orderId()));
    }
}
@Service class CompletionService {
    @EventListener public void on(InventoryReserved e) {
        System.out.println("Order "+e.orderId()+" COMPLETE");
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(steps) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1706. Rate Limiting Gateway
**ID:** `MS-1706`

**Problem:** Rate Limiting Gateway.

**Example Input:** 100 req/min per API key

**Example Output:** over limit: 429; headers show remaining

**Explanation:** Spring Cloud Gateway RequestRateLimiter filter with Redis; KeyResolver by header/IP.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.cloud.gateway.filter.ratelimit.*;
import org.springframework.cloud.gateway.route.RouteLocator;
import org.springframework.cloud.gateway.route.builder.RouteLocatorBuilder;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ServerWebExchange;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

@Configuration
public class GatewayRateLimitConfig {
    @Bean KeyResolver apiKeyResolver() {
        return exchange -> Mono.justOrEmpty(exchange.getRequest().getHeaders().getFirst("X-API-Key"))
            .defaultIfEmpty("anonymous");
    }
    @Bean RouteLocator routes(RouteLocatorBuilder builder, RedisRateLimiter limiter) {
        return builder.routes()
            .route("api", r -> r.path("/api/**")
                .filters(f -> f.requestRateLimiter(c -> {
                    c.setRateLimiter(limiter);
                    c.setKeyResolver(apiKeyResolver());
                }))
                .uri("lb://backend-service"))
            .build();
    }
    @Bean RedisRateLimiter rateLimiter() {
        return new RedisRateLimiter(100, 100, 1); // replenish 100/sec, burst 100
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1709. Metrics Collection Prometheus
**ID:** `MS-1709`

**Problem:** Metrics Collection Prometheus.

**Example Input:** GET /actuator/prometheus

**Example Output:** JVM, HTTP, custom metrics exposed

**Explanation:** Micrometer with Prometheus registry; @Timed; Counter/Gauge; Prometheus scrapes; Grafana visualizes.

**Answer:**
```java
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.*;
import io.micrometer.core.annotation.Timed;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class MetricsService {
    private final MeterRegistry registry;
    private final Counter orderCounter;
    private final Gauge queueGauge;
    private int queueSize = 0;

    MetricsService(MeterRegistry reg) {
        registry = reg;
        orderCounter = Counter.builder("orders.placed")
            .description("Total orders placed")
            .tag("env","prod")
            .register(reg);
        queueGauge = Gauge.builder("orders.queue.size", this, m -> m.queueSize)
            .description("Current queue size")
            .register(reg);
    }

    @Timed(value="order.processing.time", description="Time to process order")
    public void processOrder(Long id) {
        orderCounter.increment();
        queueSize++;
        System.out.println("Processing order "+id);
        queueSize--;
    }
}
// GET /actuator/prometheus -> Prometheus text format
// Grafana dashboard: orders_placed_total, http_server_requests_seconds
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1710. Trace Context Propagation
**ID:** `MS-1710`

**Problem:** Trace Context Propagation.

**Example Input:** request crosses 3 services

**Example Output:** single traceId in all service logs

**Explanation:** Micrometer Tracing propagates W3C traceparent header; MDC bridge logs traceId automatically.

**Answer:**
```java
import io.micrometer.tracing.Tracer;
import io.micrometer.tracing.Span;
import io.micrometer.tracing.annotation.NewSpan;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

@Service
public class TracePropagationService {
    private final Tracer tracer; private final RestTemplate rest;
    TracePropagationService(Tracer t, RestTemplate r) { tracer=t; rest=r; }

    @NewSpan("processOrder")
    public String processOrder(Long id) {
        Span current = tracer.currentSpan();
        System.out.println("TraceId="+current.context().traceId()+" SpanId="+current.context().spanId());
        // RestTemplate propagates traceparent header automatically
        String result = rest.getForObject("http://payment-service/pay/"+id, String.class);
        return "Order "+id+" done: "+result;
    }
}
// W3C traceparent: 00-{traceId}-{spanId}-01
// application.properties:
// management.tracing.sampling.probability=1.0
// spring.sleuth.propagation.type=W3C
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1711. Chaos Engineering
**ID:** `MS-1711`

**Problem:** Chaos Engineering.

**Example Input:** inject failures into system

**Example Output:** system recovers; resilience verified

**Explanation:** Chaos Monkey for Spring Boot; kill pod randomly; latency injection; circuit breakers validated.

**Answer:**
```java
import de.codecentric.spring.boot.chaos.monkey.configuration.*;
import de.codecentric.spring.boot.chaos.monkey.assaults.*;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.*;

@Configuration
public class ChaosMonkeyConfig {
    @Bean WatcherProperties watcherProperties() {
        WatcherProperties props = new WatcherProperties();
        props.setService(true);
        props.setRestController(true);
        return props;
    }
    @Bean AssaultProperties assaultProperties() {
        AssaultProperties props = new AssaultProperties();
        props.setLevel(5);              // assault every 5th request
        props.setLatencyActive(true);   // add latency
        props.setLatencyRangeStart(1000);
        props.setLatencyRangeEnd(3000);
        props.setExceptionsActive(false);
        return props;
    }
}
// application.properties:
// chaos.monkey.enabled=true
// chaos.monkey.assaults.level=5
// Validates: circuit breakers open, fallbacks work, timeouts configured correctly
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1715. Kafka Producer
**ID:** `KFK-1715`

**Problem:** Kafka Producer.

**Example Input:** publish order event to orders topic

**Example Output:** message delivered to Kafka broker

**Explanation:** KafkaTemplate.send(); ProducerConfig: bootstrap servers, key/value serializer; acks for durability.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.kafka.core.KafkaTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import java.util.Map;

@Service
public class OrderEventProducer {
    private final KafkaTemplate<String, String> kafka;
    OrderEventProducer(KafkaTemplate<String,String> k) { kafka=k; }

    public void publish(Long orderId, String item, double amount) {
        String key = "order-"+orderId;
        String payload = String.format("{"orderId":%d,"item":"%s","amount":%.2f}", orderId, item, amount);
        kafka.send("orders", key, payload)
            .whenComplete((result, ex) -> {
                if (ex != null) System.err.println("Failed: "+ex.getMessage());
                else System.out.println("Sent to partition "+result.getRecordMetadata().partition()
                    +" offset "+result.getRecordMetadata().offset());
            });
    }
}
// application.properties:
// spring.kafka.bootstrap-servers=localhost:9092
// spring.kafka.producer.key-serializer=org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.StringSerializer
// spring.kafka.producer.value-serializer=org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.StringSerializer
// spring.kafka.producer.acks=all
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1717. Consumer Group Demo
**ID:** `KFK-1717`

**Problem:** Consumer Group Demo.

**Example Input:** 3 consumers in same group; 3-partition topic

**Example Output:** each consumer handles 1 partition

**Explanation:** Consumer group balances partitions across instances; rebalance on join/leave; parallel processing.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.ConsumerRecord;
import org.springframework.kafka.annotation.KafkaListener;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class ConsumerGroupDemo {
    // All 3 instances share groupId="inventory-group"
    // With 3 partitions: each instance handles 1 partition
    @KafkaListener(topics="orders", groupId="inventory-group",
                   concurrency="3") // 3 threads = 3 consumer instances
    public void consume(ConsumerRecord<String,String> record) {
        System.out.printf("[Thread-%s] Partition=%d Key=%s Value=%s%n",
            Thread.currentThread().getName(),
            record.partition(), record.key(), record.value());
    }
}
// Kafka assigns partitions on group join (rebalance)
// partition 0 -> consumer-0 | partition 1 -> consumer-1 | partition 2 -> consumer-2
// If one consumer dies: rebalance redistributes its partitions
// concurrency > partition count = wasted consumers
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1718. Manual Offset Commit
**ID:** `KFK-1718`

**Problem:** Manual Offset Commit.

**Example Input:** process message; commit only on success

**Example Output:** no message lost; no duplicate on failure

**Explanation:** AckMode.MANUAL; Acknowledgment.acknowledge() after business logic; prevents premature commit.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.ConsumerRecord;
import org.springframework.kafka.annotation.KafkaListener;
import org.springframework.kafka.listener.AcknowledgingMessageListener;
import org.springframework.kafka.support.Acknowledgment;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class ManualCommitConsumer {
    @KafkaListener(topics="payments", groupId="payment-processor",
                   containerFactory="manualAckFactory")
    public void consume(ConsumerRecord<String,String> record, Acknowledgment ack) {
        try {
            System.out.println("Processing: "+record.value());
            processPayment(record.value());
            ack.acknowledge(); // commit only after successful processing
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("Failed; offset NOT committed: "+e.getMessage());
            // message will be redelivered on restart
        }
    }
    private void processPayment(String json) { System.out.println("Payment processed: "+json); }
}
// Config: spring.kafka.listener.ack-mode=manual
// @Bean ConcurrentKafkaListenerContainerFactory<?,?> manualAckFactory() {
//   factory.getContainerProperties().setAckMode(AckMode.MANUAL); }
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

### 1719. Retry Topic
**ID:** `KFK-1719`

**Problem:** Retry Topic.

**Example Input:** consumer fails processing

**Example Output:** message retried 3x then sent to retry topic

**Explanation:** Spring Kafka retry topics; @RetryableTopic with backoff; after max retries -> DLT.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.springframework.kafka.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.kafka.retrytopic.TopicSuffixingStrategy;
import org.springframework.retry.annotation.Backoff;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class RetryableConsumer {
    @RetryableTopic(
        attempts="4",
        backoff=@Backoff(delay=1000, multiplier=2.0),
        dltTopicSuffix="-dlt",
        topicSuffixingStrategy=TopicSuffixingStrategy.SUFFIX_WITH_DELAY_VALUE)
    @KafkaListener(topics="orders", groupId="retry-demo")
    public void consume(String message) {
        System.out.println("Attempt for: "+message);
        if (message.contains("fail")) throw new RuntimeException("Processing failed");
        System.out.println("Success: "+message);
    }

    @DltHandler
    public void handleDlt(String message) {
        System.out.println("DLT received (all retries exhausted): "+message);
    }
}
// Topics created automatically:
// orders, orders-retry-1000, orders-retry-2000, orders-retry-4000, orders-dlt
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

**Example Output:** message in DLQ; alert raised; manual reprocess

**Explanation:** DLQ is final destination for unprocessable messages; monitor and alert; replay after fix.

**Answer:**
```java
import org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.ConsumerRecord;
import org.springframework.kafka.annotation.KafkaListener;
import org.springframework.kafka.core.KafkaTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class DlqHandlerService {
    private final KafkaTemplate<String,String> kafka;
    DlqHandlerService(KafkaTemplate<String,String> k) { kafka=k; }

    // Consumer that sends to DLQ on unrecoverable error
    @KafkaListener(topics="orders", groupId="dlq-demo")
    public void consume(ConsumerRecord<String,String> record) {
        try {
            if (record.value().contains("poison")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Poison pill");
            System.out.println("Processed: "+record.value());
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            System.err.println("Sending to DLQ: "+record.value());
            kafka.send("orders-dlq", record.key(), record.value());
        }
    }

    // DLQ Monitor
    @KafkaListener(topics="orders-dlq", groupId="dlq-monitor")
    public void monitorDlq(ConsumerRecord<String,String> record) {
        System.out.println("ALERT: DLQ message key="+record.key()+" val="+record.value());
        // Send alert to Slack/PagerDuty; log for manual reprocessing
    }
}
```
