### 1947. Design ATM
**ID:** `LLD-1947`

**Problem:** Design ATM.

**Example Input:** user inserts card, enters PIN, withdraws cash

**Example Output:** cash dispensed; balance updated

**Explanation:** ATMState machine: IDLE->CARD_INSERTED->PIN_ENTERED->TRANSACTION->IDLE; Account locked after 3 fails.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
enum ATMState { IDLE, CARD_INSERTED, PIN_VERIFIED, TRANSACTION }
class Account {
    final String id; private double balance; private final String pin;
    Account(String id, double bal, String pin) { this.id=id; balance=bal; this.pin=pin; }
    boolean checkPin(String p) { return pin.equals(p); }
    double getBalance() { return balance; }
    void withdraw(double amt) {
        if(amt>balance) throw new IllegalStateException("Insufficient funds");
        balance -= amt;
    }
}
class ATM {
    private ATMState state = ATMState.IDLE;
    private Account currentAccount; private int failedAttempts = 0;
    private final Map<String,Account> accounts = new HashMap<>();
    void addAccount(Account a) { accounts.put(a.id, a); }
    void insertCard(String accountId) {
        if(state!=ATMState.IDLE) throw new IllegalStateException("ATM busy");
        currentAccount = accounts.get(accountId);
        if(currentAccount==null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found");
        state = ATMState.CARD_INSERTED; failedAttempts = 0;
    }
    void enterPin(String pin) {
        if(state!=ATMState.CARD_INSERTED) throw new IllegalStateException("Insert card first");
        if(currentAccount.checkPin(pin)) { state=ATMState.PIN_VERIFIED; failedAttempts=0; }
        else if(++failedAttempts>=3) { ejectCard(); throw new SecurityException("Card blocked"); }
        else throw new SecurityException("Wrong PIN, "+failedAttempts+"/3 attempts");
    }
    double checkBalance() { require(ATMState.PIN_VERIFIED); return currentAccount.getBalance(); }
    void withdraw(double amt) {
        require(ATMState.PIN_VERIFIED);
        currentAccount.withdraw(amt);
        System.out.printf("Dispensed %.2f%n", amt);
        ejectCard();
    }
    void ejectCard() { state=ATMState.IDLE; currentAccount=null; }
    private void require(ATMState s){ if(state!=s) throw new IllegalStateException("Expected "+s+" but was "+state); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(accounts)
---

### 1948. Design Library System
**ID:** `LLD-1948`

**Problem:** Design Library System.

**Example Input:** borrow and return books; track availability

**Example Output:** checkout/return with due dates

**Explanation:** Book, Member, Library; checkout assigns due date; return clears borrow; overdue fine calculation.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*; import java.time.*;
class Book {
    final String isbn, title, author; boolean available = true;
    Book(String isbn, String title, String author) { this.isbn=isbn; this.title=title; this.author=author; }
}
class BorrowRecord {
    final String memberId; final String isbn; final LocalDate borrowDate; final LocalDate dueDate;
    BorrowRecord(String m, String i, LocalDate borrow) {
        memberId=m; isbn=i; borrowDate=borrow; dueDate=borrow.plusDays(14);
    }
    double fineIfLate(LocalDate returnDate) {
        long overdueDays = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(dueDate, returnDate);
        return overdueDays > 0 ? overdueDays * 0.5 : 0.0;
    }
}
class Library {
    private final Map<String,Book> books = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String,BorrowRecord> active = new HashMap<>();  // isbn -> record
    void addBook(Book b) { books.put(b.isbn, b); }
    BorrowRecord checkout(String memberId, String isbn) {
        Book book = books.get(isbn);
        if(book==null) throw new NoSuchElementException("Book not found: "+isbn);
        if(!book.available) throw new IllegalStateException("Book already borrowed");
        book.available = false;
        BorrowRecord rec = new BorrowRecord(memberId, isbn, LocalDate.now());
        active.put(isbn, rec);
        return rec;
    }
    double returnBook(String isbn) {
        BorrowRecord rec = active.remove(isbn);
        if(rec==null) throw new IllegalStateException("Book not borrowed");
        books.get(isbn).available = true;
        return rec.fineIfLate(LocalDate.now());
    }
    List<Book> search(String keyword) {
        return books.values().stream()
            .filter(b -> b.title.contains(keyword) || b.author.contains(keyword))
            .toList();
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(books)
---

### 1949. Design Splitwise
**ID:** `LLD-1949`

**Problem:** Design Splitwise.

**Example Input:** group expense splitting; track who owes whom

**Example Output:** balances settled with minimum transactions

**Explanation:** Expense, Split types (EQUAL/EXACT/PERCENT); Group maintains balance map; simplify debts.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
enum SplitType { EQUAL, EXACT, PERCENT }
record Split(String userId, double amount) {}
class Expense {
    final String id = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
    final String paidBy; final double amount; final List<Split> splits; final String description;
    Expense(String paidBy, double amount, List<Split> splits, String desc) {
        this.paidBy=paidBy; this.amount=amount; this.splits=splits; description=desc;
    }
    static Expense equal(String paidBy, double amount, List<String> members, String desc) {
        double each = amount / members.size();
        List<Split> splits = members.stream().map(m -> new Split(m, each)).toList();
        return new Expense(paidBy, amount, splits, desc);
    }
}
class Group {
    final String name; private final Map<String, Double> balances = new HashMap<>();
    Group(String name) { this.name=name; }
    void addExpense(Expense e) {
        balances.merge(e.paidBy, e.amount, Double::sum);
        e.splits.forEach(s -> balances.merge(s.userId(), -s.amount(), Double::sum));
    }
    Map<String,Double> getBalances() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(balances); }
    List<String> getSettlements() {
        List<Map.Entry<String,Double>> pos = balances.entrySet().stream().filter(en->en.getValue()>0.01).sorted(Map.Entry.comparingByValue()).toList();
        List<Map.Entry<String,Double>> neg = balances.entrySet().stream().filter(en->en.getValue()<-0.01).sorted(Map.Entry.comparingByValue()).toList();
        return pos.stream().map(p -> p.getKey()+" is owed "+String.format("%.2f",p.getValue())).toList();
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(members) &nbsp; **Space:** O(members)

### 1950. Design Cab Booking
**ID:** `LLD-1950`

**Problem:** Design Cab Booking.

**Example Input:** rider requests cab; driver accepts; trip completes

**Example Output:** trip tracked from booking to completion

**Explanation:** Driver, Rider, Trip with status; CabService matches nearest driver; location tracking.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
enum TripStatus { REQUESTED, ACCEPTED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED }
class Location { double lat, lon; Location(double lat, double lon){this.lat=lat;this.lon=lon;} }
class Driver {
    final String id, name; boolean available=true; Location location;
    Driver(String id,String name,Location loc){this.id=id;this.name=name;location=loc;}
    double distanceTo(Location l){ return Math.sqrt(Math.pow(location.lat-l.lat,2)+Math.pow(location.lon-l.lon,2)); }
}
class Trip {
    final String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString(); final String riderId; final Driver driver;
    final Location pickup, dropoff; TripStatus status=TripStatus.REQUESTED; double fare;
    Trip(String rid,Driver d,Location pick,Location drop){riderId=rid;driver=d;pickup=pick;dropoff=drop;}
}
class CabService {
    private final List<Driver> drivers=new ArrayList<>();
    private final Map<String,Trip> trips=new HashMap<>();
    void registerDriver(Driver d){ drivers.add(d); }
    Trip bookRide(String riderId, Location pickup, Location dropoff) {
        Driver nearest=drivers.stream().filter(d->d.available)
            .min(Comparator.comparingDouble(d->d.distanceTo(pickup)))
            .orElseThrow(()->new RuntimeException("No driver available"));
        nearest.available=false;
        Trip trip=new Trip(riderId,nearest,pickup,dropoff);
        trips.put(trip.id,trip);
        trip.status=TripStatus.ACCEPTED;
        return trip;
    }
    void completeTrip(String tripId) {
        Trip t=trips.get(tripId);
        double dist=t.driver.distanceTo(t.dropoff);
        t.fare=Math.max(50,dist*100);
        t.status=TripStatus.COMPLETED;
        t.driver.available=true;
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(drivers) &nbsp; **Space:** O(trips)
---

### 1951. Design Vending Machine
**ID:** `LLD-1951`

**Problem:** Design Vending Machine.

**Example Input:** insert coin, select item, dispense product or refund

**Example Output:** item dispensed or coins returned

**Explanation:** State pattern: IDLE -> HAS_MONEY -> DISPENSING -> IDLE; handles insufficient funds and sold-out.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
interface VendingState { void insertCoin(VendingMachine m, int cents); void selectItem(VendingMachine m, String code); void dispense(VendingMachine m); }
class IdleState implements VendingState {
    public void insertCoin(VendingMachine m,int c){ m.addBalance(c); m.setState(m.hasMoney); System.out.println("Balance: "+m.getBalance()+"c"); }
    public void selectItem(VendingMachine m,String c){ System.out.println("Insert coin first"); }
    public void dispense(VendingMachine m){ System.out.println("Select item first"); }
}
class HasMoneyState implements VendingState {
    public void insertCoin(VendingMachine m,int c){ m.addBalance(c); System.out.println("Balance: "+m.getBalance()+"c"); }
    public void selectItem(VendingMachine m,String code){
        int price=m.getPrice(code);
        if(price<0){ System.out.println("No such item"); return; }
        if(m.getBalance()<price){ System.out.println("Need "+(price-m.getBalance())+" more cents"); return; }
        m.setSelected(code); m.setState(m.dispensing);
        m.getState().dispense(m);
    }
    public void dispense(VendingMachine m){}
}
class DispensingState implements VendingState {
    public void insertCoin(VendingMachine m,int c){ m.addBalance(c); }
    public void selectItem(VendingMachine m,String c){}
    public void dispense(VendingMachine m){
        int price=m.getPrice(m.getSelected()); m.deductBalance(price);
        System.out.println("Dispensed: "+m.getSelected()+" Change: "+m.getBalance()+"c");
        m.setBalance(0); m.setState(m.idle);
    }
}
class VendingMachine {
    VendingState idle=new IdleState(), hasMoney=new HasMoneyState(), dispensing=new DispensingState();
    private VendingState state=idle; private int balance=0; private String selected;
    private final Map<String,Integer> prices=Map.of("A1",150,"B2",200,"C3",100);
    void setState(VendingState s){state=s;} VendingState getState(){return state;}
    void addBalance(int c){balance+=c;} void deductBalance(int c){balance-=c;}
    void setBalance(int b){balance=b;} int getBalance(){return balance;}
    int getPrice(String code){return prices.getOrDefault(code,-1);}
    String getSelected(){return selected;} void setSelected(String s){selected=s;}
    void insertCoin(int c){state.insertCoin(this,c);}
    void selectItem(String code){state.selectItem(this,code);}
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(items)

### 1952. Design Movie Booking
**ID:** `LLD-1952`

**Problem:** Design Movie Booking.

**Example Input:** book seats for a show at a theatre

**Example Output:** seats reserved; booking confirmed

**Explanation:** Movie, Theatre, Show, Seat with status; BookingService handles concurrent seat reservation.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
enum SeatStatus { AVAILABLE, RESERVED, BOOKED }
class Seat {
    final String id; final int row, col; SeatStatus status=SeatStatus.AVAILABLE; double price;
    Seat(int row,int col,double price){this.row=row;this.col=col;id=row+"-"+col;this.price=price;}
    synchronized boolean reserve(){if(status==SeatStatus.AVAILABLE){status=SeatStatus.RESERVED;return true;}return false;}
    synchronized void confirm(){status=SeatStatus.BOOKED;}
    synchronized void release(){status=SeatStatus.AVAILABLE;}
}
class Show {
    final String id,movieName; final java.time.LocalDateTime time; final Seat[][] seats;
    Show(String id,String movie,java.time.LocalDateTime t,int rows,int cols){
        this.id=id;movieName=movie;time=t;
        seats=new Seat[rows][cols];
        for(int r=0;r<rows;r++) for(int c=0;c<cols;c++) seats[r][c]=new Seat(r,c,200.0);
    }
    Optional<Seat> getSeat(int r,int c){ return Optional.of(seats[r][c]); }
}
class Booking {
    final String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString(); final String userId; final String showId;
    final List<String> seatIds; final double totalAmount;
    Booking(String uid,String sid,List<String> seats,double total){userId=uid;showId=sid;seatIds=seats;totalAmount=total;}
}
class BookingService {
    private final Map<String,Show> shows=new HashMap<>();
    void addShow(Show s){shows.put(s.id,s);}
    Booking book(String userId,String showId,List<int[]> seatPositions){
        Show show=shows.get(showId);
        List<Seat> reserved=new ArrayList<>();
        for(int[]pos:seatPositions){
            Seat seat=show.seats[pos[0]][pos[1]];
            if(!seat.reserve()){reserved.forEach(Seat::release);throw new IllegalStateException("Seat "+seat.id+" unavailable");}
            reserved.add(seat);
        }
        reserved.forEach(Seat::confirm);
        double total=reserved.stream().mapToDouble(s->s.price).sum();
        return new Booking(userId,showId,reserved.stream().map(s->s.id).toList(),total);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(seats) &nbsp; **Space:** O(shows*seats)
---

### 1953. Design Snake And Ladder
**ID:** `LLD-1953`

**Problem:** Design Snake And Ladder.

**Example Input:** two players; dice roll; snakes go down, ladders go up

**Example Output:** player reaches 100 wins

**Explanation:** Board has snakes and ladders as maps; Player tracks position; Die rolls 1-6; Game loop.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
class Board {
    private final Map<Integer,Integer> snakes=new HashMap<>(), ladders=new HashMap<>();
    Board(){
        // snakes: head->tail (go down)
        snakes.put(99,7); snakes.put(54,34); snakes.put(87,24); snakes.put(62,19);
        // ladders: bottom->top (go up)
        ladders.put(3,22); ladders.put(5,8); ladders.put(11,26); ladders.put(20,38);
    }
    int applyCell(int position){
        if(snakes.containsKey(position)){ System.out.println("Snake! "+position+"->"+snakes.get(position)); return snakes.get(position); }
        if(ladders.containsKey(position)){ System.out.println("Ladder! "+position+"->"+ladders.get(position)); return ladders.get(position); }
        return position;
    }
}
class Die { private final Random rand=new Random(); int roll(){ return rand.nextInt(6)+1; } }
class Player { final String name; int position=0; Player(String n){name=n;} }
class SnakeLadderGame {
    private final Board board=new Board(); private final Die die=new Die();
    private final List<Player> players=new ArrayList<>();
    void addPlayer(String name){ players.add(new Player(name)); }
    String play(){
        while(true){
            for(Player p:players){
                int roll=die.roll(); int newPos=p.position+roll;
                if(newPos>100) continue;  // must land exactly on 100
                newPos=board.applyCell(newPos);
                p.position=newPos;
                System.out.printf("%s rolled %d -> position %d%n",p.name,roll,p.position);
                if(p.position==100) return p.name+" wins!";
            }
        }
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(snakes+ladders)
---

### 1954. Design Chess Game
**ID:** `LLD-1954`

**Problem:** Design Chess Game.

**Example Input:** two players; validate moves; check detection

**Example Output:** legal moves enforced; check/checkmate detected

**Explanation:** PieceType enum, Piece, Board 8x8, Player; move validation per piece type; check detection.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
enum PieceType { KING, QUEEN, ROOK, BISHOP, KNIGHT, PAWN }
enum Color { WHITE, BLACK }
class Piece {
    final PieceType type; final Color color; boolean moved=false;
    Piece(PieceType t,Color c){type=t;color=c;}
    char symbol(){ return switch(type){case KING->'K';case QUEEN->'Q';case ROOK->'R';case BISHOP->'B';case KNIGHT->'N';case PAWN->'P';}; }
}
class Position { final int row,col; Position(int r,int c){row=r;col=c;} boolean valid(){return row>=0&&row<8&&col>=0&&col<8;} }
class ChessBoard {
    final Piece[][] grid=new Piece[8][8];
    void setup(){
        Color[]cs={Color.WHITE,Color.BLACK}; int[]rows={0,7};
        PieceType[]back={PieceType.ROOK,PieceType.KNIGHT,PieceType.BISHOP,PieceType.QUEEN,PieceType.KING,PieceType.BISHOP,PieceType.KNIGHT,PieceType.ROOK};
        for(int i=0;i<2;i++){grid[rows[i]][4]=new Piece(back[4],cs[i]); for(int c=0;c<8;c++){grid[rows[i]][c]=new Piece(back[c],cs[i]);grid[rows[i]^1^6][c]=new Piece(PieceType.PAWN,cs[i]);}}
        // simplified setup
        grid[0]=new Piece[]{new Piece(PieceType.ROOK,Color.WHITE),new Piece(PieceType.KNIGHT,Color.WHITE),new Piece(PieceType.BISHOP,Color.WHITE),new Piece(PieceType.QUEEN,Color.WHITE),new Piece(PieceType.KING,Color.WHITE),new Piece(PieceType.BISHOP,Color.WHITE),new Piece(PieceType.KNIGHT,Color.WHITE),new Piece(PieceType.ROOK,Color.WHITE)};
        for(int c=0;c<8;c++){grid[1][c]=new Piece(PieceType.PAWN,Color.WHITE); grid[6][c]=new Piece(PieceType.PAWN,Color.BLACK);}
        grid[7]=new Piece[]{new Piece(PieceType.ROOK,Color.BLACK),new Piece(PieceType.KNIGHT,Color.BLACK),new Piece(PieceType.BISHOP,Color.BLACK),new Piece(PieceType.QUEEN,Color.BLACK),new Piece(PieceType.KING,Color.BLACK),new Piece(PieceType.BISHOP,Color.BLACK),new Piece(PieceType.KNIGHT,Color.BLACK),new Piece(PieceType.ROOK,Color.BLACK)};
    }
    Piece at(int r,int c){return grid[r][c];}
    void move(int fr,int fc,int tr,int tc){ grid[tr][tc]=grid[fr][fc]; grid[fr][fc]=null; if(grid[tr][tc]!=null)grid[tr][tc].moved=true; }
}
class ChessGame {
    final ChessBoard board=new ChessBoard(); Color turn=Color.WHITE;
    ChessGame(){ board.setup(); }
    boolean tryMove(int fr,int fc,int tr,int tc){
        Piece p=board.at(fr,fc);
        if(p==null||p.color!=turn) return false;
        Piece target=board.at(tr,tc);
        if(target!=null&&target.color==turn) return false;  // can't capture own piece
        board.move(fr,fc,tr,tc);
        turn=(turn==Color.WHITE)?Color.BLACK:Color.WHITE;
        return true;
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(64)
---

### 1955. Design Logger Framework
**ID:** `LLD-1955`

**Problem:** Design Logger Framework.

**Example Input:** custom logging framework with levels and handlers

**Example Output:** log at INFO; skip DEBUG when level=INFO

**Explanation:** LogLevel enum; Logger routes to handlers; ConsoleHandler, FileHandler chain of responsibility.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
enum LogLevel { DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR }
interface LogHandler { void handle(LogLevel level, String msg); void setNext(LogHandler next); }
abstract class BaseHandler implements LogHandler {
    private LogHandler next;
    public void setNext(LogHandler h){ next=h; }
    protected void passToNext(LogLevel l, String m){ if(next!=null) next.handle(l,m); }
}
class ConsoleHandler extends BaseHandler {
    private final LogLevel minLevel;
    ConsoleHandler(LogLevel min){ minLevel=min; }
    public void handle(LogLevel l, String m){
        if(l.ordinal()>=minLevel.ordinal()) System.out.printf("[%s] %s%n",l,m);
        passToNext(l,m);
    }
}
class FileHandler extends BaseHandler {
    private final List<String> lines=new ArrayList<>();
    public void handle(LogLevel l, String m){ lines.add("["+l+"] "+m); passToNext(l,m); }
    List<String> getLines(){ return lines; }
}
class Logger {
    private static final Map<String,Logger> instances=new HashMap<>();
    private final String name; private LogLevel level=LogLevel.INFO; private LogHandler handler;
    private Logger(String n){ name=n; }
    static Logger getLogger(String name){ return instances.computeIfAbsent(name,Logger::new); }
    void setLevel(LogLevel l){ level=l; }
    void setHandler(LogHandler h){ handler=h; }
    void log(LogLevel l, String msg){ if(l.ordinal()>=level.ordinal()&&handler!=null) handler.handle(l,name+": "+msg); }
    void info(String m){ log(LogLevel.INFO,m); }
    void debug(String m){ log(LogLevel.DEBUG,m); }
    void warn(String m){ log(LogLevel.WARN,m); }
    void error(String m){ log(LogLevel.ERROR,m); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(handlers) &nbsp; **Space:** O(handlers)
---

### 1956. Design Event Bus
**ID:** `LLD-1956`

**Problem:** Design Event Bus.

**Example Input:** components publish events; subscribers react

**Example Output:** subscriber receives published event

**Explanation:** EventBus with publish/subscribe; event type routing; async option via executor.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
class Event { final String type; final Object payload; final long timestamp=System.currentTimeMillis();
    Event(String type, Object payload){ this.type=type; this.payload=payload; } }
class EventBus {
    private final Map<String, List<Consumer<Event>>> handlers=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final ExecutorService async=Executors.newCachedThreadPool();
    void subscribe(String eventType, Consumer<Event> handler){
        handlers.computeIfAbsent(eventType,k->new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>()).add(handler);
    }
    void unsubscribe(String eventType, Consumer<Event> handler){
        handlers.getOrDefault(eventType,List.of()).remove(handler);
    }
    void publish(Event event){
        handlers.getOrDefault(event.type, List.of()).forEach(h -> h.accept(event));
    }
    void publishAsync(Event event){
        handlers.getOrDefault(event.type, List.of()).forEach(h -> async.submit(() -> h.accept(event)));
    }
    void publishAsync(String type, Object payload){ publishAsync(new Event(type,payload)); }
    void publish(String type, Object payload){ publish(new Event(type,payload)); }
    static EventBus INSTANCE = new EventBus();  // singleton
}
class OrderService {
    void placeOrder(String orderId){
        System.out.println("Order placed: "+orderId);
        EventBus.INSTANCE.publish("ORDER_PLACED", orderId);
    }
}
class EmailService {
    EmailService(){ EventBus.INSTANCE.subscribe("ORDER_PLACED", e -> System.out.println("Email for order: "+e.payload)); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(subscribers) &nbsp; **Space:** O(eventTypes*subscribers)
---

### 1957. Design Plugin System
**ID:** `LLD-1957`

**Problem:** Design Plugin System.

**Example Input:** dynamically load plugins at runtime

**Example Output:** plugin registered; hook methods called

**Explanation:** Plugin interface with lifecycle; PluginRegistry; class loading from JAR or classpath.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
interface Plugin {
    String getName();
    String getVersion();
    void onLoad(PluginContext ctx);
    void onUnload();
}
class PluginContext {
    private final Map<String,Object> services=new HashMap<>();
    void registerService(String name, Object svc){ services.put(name,svc); }
    Object getService(String name){ return services.get(name); }
}
class PluginRegistry {
    private final Map<String,Plugin> plugins=new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final PluginContext ctx=new PluginContext();
    void register(Plugin p){
        if(plugins.containsKey(p.getName())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Plugin already registered: "+p.getName());
        plugins.put(p.getName(),p);
        p.onLoad(ctx);
        System.out.printf("Plugin loaded: %s v%s%n",p.getName(),p.getVersion());
    }
    void unregister(String name){
        Plugin p=plugins.remove(name);
        if(p!=null){ p.onUnload(); System.out.println("Plugin unloaded: "+name); }
    }
    Optional<Plugin> get(String name){ return Optional.ofNullable(plugins.get(name)); }
    Collection<Plugin> all(){ return plugins.values(); }
}
class AuditPlugin implements Plugin {
    private PluginContext ctx;
    public String getName(){ return "audit"; }
    public String getVersion(){ return "1.0"; }
    public void onLoad(PluginContext c){ ctx=c; ctx.registerService("auditLog", new ArrayList<String>()); }
    public void onUnload(){ System.out.println("AuditPlugin: flushing logs..."); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(plugins) &nbsp; **Space:** O(plugins)
---

### 1958. Design Rate Limiter LLD
**ID:** `LLD-1958`

**Problem:** Design Rate Limiter LLD.

**Example Input:** 100 requests/minute per user; reject excess

**Example Output:** request allowed or 429 returned

**Explanation:** Token bucket: each user gets bucket refilled at fixed rate; tryAcquire() consumes token.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;
class TokenBucket {
    private final int capacity; private final double refillRatePerMs;
    private final AtomicLong tokens; private volatile long lastRefillTime;
    TokenBucket(int capacity, int refillPerSecond){
        this.capacity=capacity; this.refillRatePerMs=refillPerSecond/1000.0;
        tokens=new AtomicLong(capacity); lastRefillTime=System.currentTimeMillis();
    }
    synchronized boolean tryAcquire(){
        refill();
        if(tokens.get()>0){ tokens.decrementAndGet(); return true; }
        return false;
    }
    private void refill(){
        long now=System.currentTimeMillis();
        long elapsed=now-lastRefillTime;
        long toAdd=(long)(elapsed*refillRatePerMs);
        if(toAdd>0){ tokens.set(Math.min(capacity,tokens.get()+toAdd)); lastRefillTime=now; }
    }
    long availableTokens(){ refill(); return tokens.get(); }
}
class RateLimiter {
    private final int capacity, refillPerSecond;
    private final Map<String,TokenBucket> buckets=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    RateLimiter(int capacity, int refillPerSecond){ this.capacity=capacity; this.refillPerSecond=refillPerSecond; }
    boolean allowRequest(String userId){
        TokenBucket bucket=buckets.computeIfAbsent(userId,k->new TokenBucket(capacity,refillPerSecond));
        return bucket.tryAcquire();
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(users)
---

### 1959. Design Connection Pool LLD
**ID:** `LLD-1959`

**Problem:** Design Connection Pool LLD.

**Example Input:** limited DB connections shared among threads

**Example Output:** connection borrowed; returned after use

**Explanation:** Pool holds pre-created connections; borrow blocks if empty; return signals waiting threads.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.concurrent.*;
class FakeConnection { private final int id; boolean closed=false;
    FakeConnection(int id){ this.id=id; System.out.println("Connection "+id+" created"); }
    void execute(String sql){ if(closed) throw new IllegalStateException("Connection closed"); System.out.println("Conn"+id+": "+sql); }
    void close(){ closed=true; }
}
class ConnectionPool implements AutoCloseable {
    private final BlockingQueue<FakeConnection> pool;
    private final int maxSize;
    ConnectionPool(int maxSize) throws Exception {
        this.maxSize=maxSize; pool=new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(maxSize);
        for(int i=0;i<maxSize;i++) pool.put(new FakeConnection(i));
    }
    FakeConnection borrow(long timeoutMs) throws InterruptedException {
        FakeConnection conn=pool.poll(timeoutMs,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
        if(conn==null) throw new RuntimeException("No connection available after "+timeoutMs+"ms");
        return conn;
    }
    void returnConnection(FakeConnection conn){
        if(conn!=null&&!conn.closed) pool.offer(conn);
    }
    int available(){ return pool.size(); }
    public void close(){ pool.forEach(FakeConnection::close); }
    // Usage pattern:
    static void usageExample(ConnectionPool pool) throws Exception {
        FakeConnection conn=pool.borrow(3000);
        try { conn.execute("SELECT 1"); }
        finally { pool.returnConnection(conn); }  // always return in finally
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(poolSize)
---

### 1960. Design Thread Pool LLD
**ID:** `LLD-1960`

**Problem:** Design Thread Pool LLD.

**Example Input:** custom thread pool with worker threads and task queue

**Example Output:** tasks executed by worker threads

**Explanation:** Workers loop on BlockingQueue; submit() adds tasks; shutdown() signals all workers to stop.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.*;
class CustomThreadPool {
    private final BlockingQueue<Runnable> taskQueue;
    private final List<Thread> workers=new ArrayList<>();
    private volatile boolean shutdown=false;
    CustomThreadPool(int numThreads, int queueCapacity){
        taskQueue=new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(queueCapacity);
        for(int i=0;i<numThreads;i++){
            Thread t=new Thread(this::workerLoop,"worker-"+i);
            t.setDaemon(true); workers.add(t); t.start();
        }
    }
    private void workerLoop(){
        while(!shutdown||!taskQueue.isEmpty()){
            try {
                Runnable task=taskQueue.poll(100,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
                if(task!=null) task.run();
            } catch(InterruptedException e){ Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); break; }
              catch(Exception e){ System.err.println("Task error: "+e.getMessage()); }
        }
    }
    void submit(Runnable task) throws RejectedExecutionException {
        if(shutdown) throw new RejectedExecutionException("Pool is shut down");
        if(!taskQueue.offer(task)) throw new RejectedExecutionException("Queue full");
    }
    void shutdown(){
        shutdown=true;
        workers.forEach(Thread::interrupt);
    }
    void awaitTermination(long ms) throws InterruptedException {
        long deadline=System.currentTimeMillis()+ms;
        for(Thread t:workers){ long left=deadline-System.currentTimeMillis(); if(left>0) t.join(left); }
    }
    int queueSize(){ return taskQueue.size(); }
    int activeWorkers(){ return (int)workers.stream().filter(Thread::isAlive).count(); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(queue+threads)
---

### 1961. Design Circuit Breaker LLD
**ID:** `LLD-1961`

**Problem:** Design Circuit Breaker LLD.

**Example Input:** protect service from cascading failures

**Example Output:** open circuit after 5 failures; auto-reset

**Explanation:** States: CLOSED(normal)->OPEN(fail fast)->HALF_OPEN(test)->CLOSED; failure count and timeout.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;
import java.util.function.*;
enum CBState { CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN }
class CircuitBreaker {
    private final String name; private final int failureThreshold; private final long openDurationMs;
    private volatile CBState state=CBState.CLOSED;
    private final AtomicInteger failures=new AtomicInteger(0);
    private volatile long openedAt=0;
    CircuitBreaker(String name,int failureThreshold,long openDurationMs){
        this.name=name; this.failureThreshold=failureThreshold; this.openDurationMs=openDurationMs;
    }
    <T> T execute(Supplier<T> action) {
        if(state==CBState.OPEN){
            if(System.currentTimeMillis()-openedAt>openDurationMs){
                state=CBState.HALF_OPEN; System.out.println(name+": HALF_OPEN - testing...");
            } else throw new RuntimeException(name+": Circuit OPEN - fast fail");
        }
        try {
            T result=action.get();
            onSuccess(); return result;
        } catch(Exception e){ onFailure(); throw e; }
    }
    private void onSuccess(){
        failures.set(0);
        if(state==CBState.HALF_OPEN){ state=CBState.CLOSED; System.out.println(name+": CLOSED - recovered"); }
    }
    private void onFailure(){
        int f=failures.incrementAndGet();
        System.out.println(name+": failure "+f+"/"+failureThreshold);
        if(f>=failureThreshold||state==CBState.HALF_OPEN){
            state=CBState.OPEN; openedAt=System.currentTimeMillis();
            System.out.println(name+": OPEN - circuit tripped");
        }
    }
    CBState getState(){ return state; }
    int getFailures(){ return failures.get(); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1962. Design Observer Pattern
**ID:** `LLD-1962`

**Problem:** Design Observer Pattern.

**Example Input:** weather station notifies displays on data change

**Example Output:** all displays updated on new measurement

**Explanation:** Subject interface with attach/detach/notify; Observer interface with update(); pull vs push.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
interface Observer { void update(float temp, float humidity, float pressure); }
interface Subject { void attach(Observer o); void detach(Observer o); void notifyObservers(); }
class WeatherStation implements Subject {
    private final List<Observer> observers=new ArrayList<>();
    private float temperature, humidity, pressure;
    public void attach(Observer o){ observers.add(o); }
    public void detach(Observer o){ observers.remove(o); }
    public void notifyObservers(){ observers.forEach(o->o.update(temperature,humidity,pressure)); }
    void setMeasurements(float temp, float hum, float pres){
        temperature=temp; humidity=hum; pressure=pres;
        notifyObservers();
    }
}
class CurrentConditionsDisplay implements Observer {
    private float temperature, humidity;
    public void update(float t, float h, float p){ temperature=t; humidity=h; display(); }
    void display(){ System.out.printf("Current: %.1fC, %.1f%%%n",temperature,humidity); }
}
class StatisticsDisplay implements Observer {
    private float maxTemp=Float.MIN_VALUE, minTemp=Float.MAX_VALUE, sumTemp=0; private int count=0;
    public void update(float t, float h, float p){
        maxTemp=Math.max(maxTemp,t); minTemp=Math.min(minTemp,t); sumTemp+=t; count++;
        System.out.printf("Stats: avg=%.1f max=%.1f min=%.1fC%n",sumTemp/count,maxTemp,minTemp);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(observers) &nbsp; **Space:** O(observers)
---

### 1963. Design Strategy Pattern
**ID:** `LLD-1963`

**Problem:** Design Strategy Pattern.

**Example Input:** sorting algorithm switchable at runtime

**Example Output:** array sorted by selected strategy

**Explanation:** SortStrategy interface; BubbleSort, QuickSort, MergeSort implementations; Sorter context.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
@FunctionalInterface interface SortStrategy { void sort(int[] arr); }
class BubbleSort implements SortStrategy {
    public void sort(int[] a){
        for(int i=0;i<a.length-1;i++) for(int j=0;j<a.length-1-i;j++) if(a[j]>a[j+1]){int t=a[j];a[j]=a[j+1];a[j+1]=t;}
    }
}
class QuickSort implements SortStrategy {
    public void sort(int[] a){ qs(a,0,a.length-1); }
    private void qs(int[]a,int lo,int hi){
        if(lo<hi){int p=partition(a,lo,hi);qs(a,lo,p-1);qs(a,p+1,hi);}
    }
    private int partition(int[]a,int lo,int hi){
        int pivot=a[hi],i=lo-1;
        for(int j=lo;j<hi;j++) if(a[j]<=pivot){i++;int t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;}
        int t=a[i+1];a[i+1]=a[hi];a[hi]=t; return i+1;
    }
}
class Sorter {
    private SortStrategy strategy;
    Sorter(SortStrategy s){ strategy=s; }
    void setStrategy(SortStrategy s){ strategy=s; }
    int[] sort(int[] arr){
        int[] copy=Arrays.copyOf(arr,arr.length);
        strategy.sort(copy); return copy;
    }
}
// Strategy can also be a lambda:
// Sorter sorter = new Sorter(arr -> Arrays.sort(arr));
// sorter.setStrategy(new QuickSort());
```

> **Time:** O(n log n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)
---

### 1964. Design Command Pattern
**ID:** `LLD-1964`

**Problem:** Design Command Pattern.

**Example Input:** text editor with undo/redo support

**Example Output:** commands execute and can be undone

**Explanation:** Command interface with execute/undo; CommandHistory as stack; Editor as receiver.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
interface Command { void execute(); void undo(); }
class TextEditor {
    private StringBuilder text=new StringBuilder();
    void insert(int pos, String s){ text.insert(pos,s); }
    void delete(int pos, int len){ text.delete(pos,pos+len); }
    String getText(){ return text.toString(); }
}
class InsertCommand implements Command {
    private final TextEditor editor; private final int pos; private final String text;
    InsertCommand(TextEditor e,int pos,String text){editor=e;this.pos=pos;this.text=text;}
    public void execute(){ editor.insert(pos,text); }
    public void undo(){ editor.delete(pos,text.length()); }
}
class DeleteCommand implements Command {
    private final TextEditor editor; private final int pos; private final int len; private String deleted;
    DeleteCommand(TextEditor e,int pos,int len){editor=e;this.pos=pos;this.len=len;}
    public void execute(){ deleted=editor.getText().substring(pos,pos+len); editor.delete(pos,len); }
    public void undo(){ editor.insert(pos,deleted); }
}
class CommandHistory {
    private final Deque<Command> undoStack=new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final Deque<Command> redoStack=new ArrayDeque<>();
    void execute(Command cmd){ cmd.execute(); undoStack.push(cmd); redoStack.clear(); }
    void undo(){ if(!undoStack.isEmpty()){ Command c=undoStack.pop(); c.undo(); redoStack.push(c); } }
    void redo(){ if(!redoStack.isEmpty()){ Command c=redoStack.pop(); c.execute(); undoStack.push(c); } }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(history)
---

### 1965. Design Decorator Pattern
**ID:** `LLD-1965`

**Problem:** Design Decorator Pattern.

**Example Input:** add features to a coffee order at runtime

**Example Output:** coffee with milk, sugar, whip priced correctly

**Explanation:** Component interface; concrete coffee; decorators for each add-on; chained wrapping pattern.

**Answer:**
```java
interface Coffee { String description(); double cost(); }
class SimpleCoffee implements Coffee {
    public String description(){ return "Simple coffee"; }
    public double cost(){ return 1.00; }
}
abstract class CoffeeDecorator implements Coffee {
    protected final Coffee wrapped;
    CoffeeDecorator(Coffee c){ wrapped=c; }
    public String description(){ return wrapped.description(); }
    public double cost(){ return wrapped.cost(); }
}
class Milk extends CoffeeDecorator {
    Milk(Coffee c){ super(c); }
    public String description(){ return wrapped.description()+", Milk"; }
    public double cost(){ return wrapped.cost()+0.25; }
}
class Sugar extends CoffeeDecorator {
    Sugar(Coffee c){ super(c); }
    public String description(){ return wrapped.description()+", Sugar"; }
    public double cost(){ return wrapped.cost()+0.10; }
}
class Whip extends CoffeeDecorator {
    Whip(Coffee c){ super(c); }
    public String description(){ return wrapped.description()+", Whip"; }
    public double cost(){ return wrapped.cost()+0.50; }
}
// Usage:
// Coffee order = new Whip(new Sugar(new Milk(new SimpleCoffee())));
// order.description() -> "Simple coffee, Milk, Sugar, Whip"
// order.cost()        -> 1.85
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(decorators)
---

### 1966. Design Proxy Pattern
**ID:** `LLD-1966`

**Problem:** Design Proxy Pattern.

**Example Input:** virtual proxy for lazy loading large images

**Example Output:** image loaded only when first displayed

**Explanation:** Subject interface; RealImage loads from disk; ProxyImage delays load until display() called.

**Answer:**
```java
interface Image { void display(); }
class RealImage implements Image {
    private final String filename; private byte[] data;
    RealImage(String filename){ this.filename=filename; loadFromDisk(); }
    private void loadFromDisk(){
        // simulate expensive disk I/O
        System.out.println("Loading "+filename+" from disk...");
        data=new byte[1024*1024];  // 1MB placeholder
    }
    public void display(){ System.out.println("Displaying "+filename); }
}
class ProxyImage implements Image {
    private final String filename; private RealImage realImage;
    ProxyImage(String filename){ this.filename=filename; }
    public void display(){
        if(realImage==null) realImage=new RealImage(filename);  // lazy load
        realImage.display();
    }
}
// Access control proxy example:
class SecureImageProxy implements Image {
    private final Image target; private final String userRole;
    SecureImageProxy(Image t, String role){ target=t; userRole=role; }
    public void display(){
        if(!userRole.equals("ADMIN")) throw new SecurityException("Access denied");
        target.display();
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1967. Design Factory Pattern
**ID:** `LLD-1967`

**Problem:** Design Factory Pattern.

**Example Input:** create different payment methods via factory

**Example Output:** PaymentFactory.create() returns correct type

**Explanation:** PaymentMethod interface; CreditCard, UPI, Wallet implementations; PaymentFactory switches on type.

**Answer:**
```java
interface PaymentMethod { void pay(double amount); String getType(); }
class CreditCard implements PaymentMethod {
    private final String cardNumber;
    CreditCard(String num){ cardNumber=num; }
    public void pay(double amt){ System.out.printf("CreditCard(%s): paying %.2f%n",cardNumber,amt); }
    public String getType(){ return "CREDIT_CARD"; }
}
class UPI implements PaymentMethod {
    private final String upiId;
    UPI(String id){ upiId=id; }
    public void pay(double amt){ System.out.printf("UPI(%s): paying %.2f%n",upiId,amt); }
    public String getType(){ return "UPI"; }
}
class Wallet implements PaymentMethod {
    private double balance; Wallet(double bal){ balance=bal; }
    public void pay(double amt){
        if(amt>balance) throw new IllegalStateException("Insufficient wallet balance");
        balance-=amt; System.out.printf("Wallet: paying %.2f, balance=%.2f%n",amt,balance);
    }
    public String getType(){ return "WALLET"; }
}
class PaymentFactory {
    static PaymentMethod create(String type, String param){
        return switch(type.toUpperCase()){
            case "CREDIT_CARD" -> new CreditCard(param);
            case "UPI"         -> new UPI(param);
            case "WALLET"      -> new Wallet(Double.parseDouble(param));
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown payment type: "+type);
        };
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1968. Design Builder Pattern
**ID:** `LLD-1968`

**Problem:** Design Builder Pattern.

**Example Input:** build complex Order object step by step

**Example Output:** Order built with only required fields; optional fields default

**Explanation:** Order.Builder with fluent methods; mandatory fields validated in build(); immutable Order.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
class Order {
    private final String id; private final String customerId; private final List<String> items;
    private final String address; private final String coupon; private final double discount;
    private Order(Builder b){
        id=b.id; customerId=b.customerId; items=List.copyOf(b.items);
        address=b.address; coupon=b.coupon; discount=b.discount;
    }
    String getId(){ return id; } List<String> getItems(){ return items; }
    double getDiscount(){ return discount; }
    @Override public String toString(){ return "Order{id="+id+",customer="+customerId+",items="+items+",discount="+discount+"}"; }
    static class Builder {
        private final String id; private final String customerId;      // required
        private final List<String> items=new ArrayList<>();
        private String address=""; private String coupon=""; private double discount=0;
        Builder(String id, String customerId){
            if(id==null||customerId==null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("id and customerId required");
            this.id=id; this.customerId=customerId;
        }
        Builder addItem(String item){ items.add(item); return this; }
        Builder address(String a){ address=a; return this; }
        Builder coupon(String c){ this.coupon=c; this.discount=0.10; return this; }
        Builder discount(double d){ discount=d; return this; }
        Order build(){
            if(items.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("Order must have at least one item");
            return new Order(this);
        }
    }
}
// Usage:
// Order o = new Order.Builder("ORD-1","USR-42")
//     .addItem("Pizza").addItem("Coke")
//     .address("123 Main St")
//     .coupon("SAVE10")
//     .build();
```

> **Time:** O(items) &nbsp; **Space:** O(items)
---

### 1969. Design Singleton Pattern
**ID:** `LLD-1969`

**Problem:** Design Singleton Pattern.

**Example Input:** exactly one instance of Config shared app-wide

**Example Output:** Config.getInstance() always returns same object

**Explanation:** Thread-safe double-checked locking; or enum singleton; or static inner holder pattern.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
// Pattern 1: Double-Checked Locking
class Config {
    private static volatile Config instance;
    private final Map<String,String> props=new HashMap<>();
    private Config(){ props.put("env","prod"); props.put("db.url","jdbc:mysql://localhost/app"); }
    static Config getInstance(){
        if(instance==null) synchronized(Config.class){
            if(instance==null) instance=new Config();
        }
        return instance;
    }
    String get(String key){ return props.getOrDefault(key,""); }
    void set(String key, String val){ props.put(key,val); }
}
// Pattern 2: Enum singleton (serialization-safe)
enum AppConfig {
    INSTANCE;
    private final Map<String,String> settings=new HashMap<>();
    { settings.put("timeout","30"); }
    String get(String k){ return settings.getOrDefault(k,""); }
}
// Pattern 3: Initialization-on-demand holder (lazy, thread-safe, no sync overhead)
class Registry {
    private Registry(){}
    private static class Holder { static final Registry INSTANCE=new Registry(); }
    static Registry getInstance(){ return Holder.INSTANCE; }
    private final Map<String,Object> store=new HashMap<>();
    void register(String k,Object v){ store.put(k,v); }
    Object get(String k){ return store.get(k); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1970. Design Iterator Pattern
**ID:** `LLD-1970`

**Problem:** Design Iterator Pattern.

**Example Input:** custom collection with external iteration support

**Example Output:** iterate over Playlist without exposing internal structure

**Explanation:** Iterator interface with hasNext/next; Playlist implements Iterable; supports foreach loop.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
class Song { String title, artist; Song(String t, String a){title=t;artist=a;}
    @Override public String toString(){ return title+" by "+artist; } }
class Playlist implements Iterable<Song> {
    private final List<Song> songs=new ArrayList<>();
    void addSong(Song s){ songs.add(s); }
    void addSong(String title, String artist){ songs.add(new Song(title,artist)); }
    int size(){ return songs.size(); }
    // filtered iterator for a specific artist
    Iterator<Song> byArtist(String artist){
        return new Iterator<>(){
            int idx=0; Song next;
            { advance(); }
            private void advance(){
                next=null;
                while(idx<songs.size()){
                    Song s=songs.get(idx++);
                    if(s.artist.equals(artist)){next=s;break;}
                }
            }
            public boolean hasNext(){ return next!=null; }
            public Song next(){ Song s=next; advance(); return s; }
        };
    }
    @Override public Iterator<Song> iterator(){ return songs.iterator(); }
}
// Usage:
// Playlist p = new Playlist();
// p.addSong("Bohemian Rhapsody","Queen");
// for(Song s : p) System.out.println(s);  // uses Iterable
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1971. Design Composite Pattern
**ID:** `LLD-1971`

**Problem:** Design Composite Pattern.

**Example Input:** file system with files and folders; get total size

**Example Output:** folder.size() sums all nested files recursively

**Explanation:** Component interface with size(); Leaf=File; Composite=Folder; recursive size traversal.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
interface FileSystemItem { String getName(); long size(); void print(String indent); }
class File implements FileSystemItem {
    private final String name; private final long bytes;
    File(String name, long bytes){ this.name=name; this.bytes=bytes; }
    public String getName(){ return name; }
    public long size(){ return bytes; }
    public void print(String indent){ System.out.printf("%s[File] %s (%d bytes)%n",indent,name,bytes); }
}
class Folder implements FileSystemItem {
    private final String name; private final List<FileSystemItem> children=new ArrayList<>();
    Folder(String name){ this.name=name; }
    void add(FileSystemItem item){ children.add(item); }
    void remove(FileSystemItem item){ children.remove(item); }
    public String getName(){ return name; }
    public long size(){ return children.stream().mapToLong(FileSystemItem::size).sum(); }
    public void print(String indent){
        System.out.printf("%s[Dir] %s%n",indent,name);
        children.forEach(c->c.print(indent+"  "));
    }
}
// Usage:
// Folder root=new Folder("root");
// root.add(new File("readme.txt",1024));
// Folder src=new Folder("src");
// src.add(new File("Main.java",2048));
// root.add(src);
// root.size() -> 3072
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(depth)
---

### 1972. Design Flyweight Pattern
**ID:** `LLD-1972`

**Problem:** Design Flyweight Pattern.

**Example Input:** render 10000 trees in a forest; minimize memory

**Example Output:** shared TreeType objects; extrinsic state per tree

**Explanation:** TreeType (intrinsic: color, texture) shared via factory; Tree stores position + TreeType ref.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
class TreeType {
    final String name, color, texture;
    TreeType(String name, String color, String texture){ this.name=name; this.color=color; this.texture=texture; }
    void draw(int x, int y){ System.out.printf("Tree[%s] at (%d,%d) color=%s%n",name,x,y,color); }
}
class TreeTypeFactory {
    private static final Map<String,TreeType> pool=new HashMap<>();
    static TreeType get(String name, String color, String texture){
        String key=name+"|"+color+"|"+texture;
        return pool.computeIfAbsent(key,k->new TreeType(name,color,texture));
    }
    static int getPoolSize(){ return pool.size(); }
}
class Tree {
    final int x, y; final TreeType type;  // only position is unique (extrinsic state)
    Tree(int x, int y, TreeType type){ this.x=x; this.y=y; this.type=type; }
    void draw(){ type.draw(x,y); }
}
class Forest {
    private final List<Tree> trees=new ArrayList<>();
    void plantTree(int x, int y, String name, String color, String texture){
        TreeType type=TreeTypeFactory.get(name,color,texture);
        trees.add(new Tree(x,y,type));
    }
    void draw(){ trees.forEach(Tree::draw); }
    int treeCount(){ return trees.size(); }
    int typeCount(){ return TreeTypeFactory.getPoolSize(); }
}
// 10000 trees share only a few TreeType objects -> memory savings
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(types)
---

### 1973. Design Template Method
**ID:** `LLD-1973`

**Problem:** Design Template Method.

**Example Input:** report generation; steps fixed; format varies

**Example Output:** CSV report generates header,rows,footer in order

**Explanation:** AbstractReport defines algorithm skeleton; CsvReport, HtmlReport override format-specific steps.

**Answer:**
```java
abstract class Report {
    // Template Method — defines the algorithm skeleton
    final void generate(){
        fetchData();
        processData();
        renderHeader();
        renderBody();
        renderFooter();
        deliver();
    }
    protected abstract void fetchData();
    protected abstract void processData();
    protected abstract void renderHeader();
    protected abstract void renderBody();
    protected abstract void renderFooter();
    protected void deliver(){ System.out.println("Delivering report..."); }  // hook with default
}
class CsvReport extends Report {
    private String[] data;
    protected void fetchData(){ data=new String[]{"Alice,100","Bob,200","Carol,150"}; }
    protected void processData(){ System.out.println("CSV: sorting "+data.length+" rows"); }
    protected void renderHeader(){ System.out.println("name,amount"); }
    protected void renderBody(){ for(String row:data) System.out.println(row); }
    protected void renderFooter(){ System.out.println("Total rows: "+data.length); }
}
class HtmlReport extends Report {
    private String[] data;
    protected void fetchData(){ data=new String[]{"Alice","Bob"}; }
    protected void processData(){ System.out.println("HTML: applying styles"); }
    protected void renderHeader(){ System.out.println("<html><body><table>"); }
    protected void renderBody(){ for(String row:data) System.out.printf("<tr><td>%s</td></tr>%n",row); }
    protected void renderFooter(){ System.out.println("</table></body></html>"); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)
---

### 1974. Design Chain Of Responsibility
**ID:** `LLD-1974`

**Problem:** Design Chain Of Responsibility.

**Example Input:** expense approval based on amount thresholds

**Example Output:** request routed to correct approver level

**Explanation:** Handler interface with setNext; Manager, Director, CEO handlers; chain traversal on request.

**Answer:**
```java
abstract class Approver {
    private Approver next;
    Approver setNext(Approver a){ next=a; return a; }
    void approve(double amount){
        if(canApprove(amount)) doApprove(amount);
        else if(next!=null) next.approve(amount);
        else System.out.printf("Amount %.2f requires board approval%n",amount);
    }
    protected abstract boolean canApprove(double amount);
    protected abstract void doApprove(double amount);
}
class Manager extends Approver {
    protected boolean canApprove(double a){ return a<=1000; }
    protected void doApprove(double a){ System.out.printf("Manager approved: %.2f%n",a); }
}
class Director extends Approver {
    protected boolean canApprove(double a){ return a<=10000; }
    protected void doApprove(double a){ System.out.printf("Director approved: %.2f%n",a); }
}
class VP extends Approver {
    protected boolean canApprove(double a){ return a<=100000; }
    protected void doApprove(double a){ System.out.printf("VP approved: %.2f%n",a); }
}
class CEO extends Approver {
    protected boolean canApprove(double a){ return a<=1000000; }
    protected void doApprove(double a){ System.out.printf("CEO approved: %.2f%n",a); }
}
// Setup chain: Manager -> Director -> VP -> CEO
// Usage:
// Manager mgr=new Manager(); Director dir=new Director();
// mgr.setNext(dir).setNext(new VP()).setNext(new CEO());
// mgr.approve(500);    // Manager approved
// mgr.approve(50000);  // VP approved
```

> **Time:** O(chain length) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
---

### 1975. Design State Machine
**ID:** `LLD-1975`

**Problem:** Design State Machine.

**Example Input:** order goes through PLACED->SHIPPED->DELIVERED; invalid transitions rejected

**Example Output:** order.ship() succeeds; order.place() from SHIPPED throws

**Explanation:** OrderState enum; Order holds current state; transition table enforces valid transitions.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
enum OrderState { PLACED, CONFIRMED, SHIPPED, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, CANCELLED }
class Order {
    final String id; private OrderState state=OrderState.PLACED;
    private static final Map<OrderState,Set<OrderState>> VALID=Map.of(
        OrderState.PLACED,       Set.of(OrderState.CONFIRMED, OrderState.CANCELLED),
        OrderState.CONFIRMED,    Set.of(OrderState.SHIPPED, OrderState.CANCELLED),
        OrderState.SHIPPED,      Set.of(OrderState.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY),
        OrderState.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, Set.of(OrderState.DELIVERED),
        OrderState.DELIVERED,    Set.of(),
        OrderState.CANCELLED,    Set.of()
    );
    Order(String id){ this.id=id; }
    void transition(OrderState next){
        if(!VALID.getOrDefault(state,Set.of()).contains(next))
            throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot go "+state+"->"+next);
        System.out.printf("Order %s: %s -> %s%n",id,state,next);
        state=next;
    }
    void confirm(){ transition(OrderState.CONFIRMED); }
    void ship(){ transition(OrderState.SHIPPED); }
    void outForDelivery(){ transition(OrderState.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY); }
    void deliver(){ transition(OrderState.DELIVERED); }
    void cancel(){ transition(OrderState.CANCELLED); }
    OrderState getState(){ return state; }
    boolean isTerminal(){ return state==OrderState.DELIVERED||state==OrderState.CANCELLED; }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(states)
---

### 1976. Design Notification Center
**ID:** `LLD-1976`

**Problem:** Design Notification Center.

**Example Input:** send push, email, SMS notifications via appropriate channels

**Example Output:** notification dispatched to correct handlers

**Explanation:** Notification with type/channel; NotificationCenter routes to registered handlers; observer chain.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
enum Channel { PUSH, EMAIL, SMS, IN_APP }
record Notification(String userId, String title, String body, Channel channel) {}
interface NotificationHandler { boolean canHandle(Channel c); void send(Notification n); }
class PushHandler implements NotificationHandler {
    public boolean canHandle(Channel c){ return c==Channel.PUSH; }
    public void send(Notification n){ System.out.printf("PUSH to %s: %s%n",n.userId(),n.title()); }
}
class EmailHandler implements NotificationHandler {
    public boolean canHandle(Channel c){ return c==Channel.EMAIL; }
    public void send(Notification n){ System.out.printf("EMAIL to %s: %s - %s%n",n.userId(),n.title(),n.body()); }
}
class SMSHandler implements NotificationHandler {
    public boolean canHandle(Channel c){ return c==Channel.SMS; }
    public void send(Notification n){ System.out.printf("SMS to %s: %s%n",n.userId(),n.body()); }
}
class NotificationCenter {
    private final List<NotificationHandler> handlers=new ArrayList<>();
    private final java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService exec=java.util.concurrent.Executors.newCachedThreadPool();
    void register(NotificationHandler h){ handlers.add(h); }
    void send(Notification n){ handlers.stream().filter(h->h.canHandle(n.channel())).forEach(h->h.send(n)); }
    void sendAsync(Notification n){ handlers.stream().filter(h->h.canHandle(n.channel())).forEach(h->exec.submit(()->h.send(n))); }
    void broadcast(String userId,String title,String body){
        for(Channel ch:Channel.values()) send(new Notification(userId,title,body,ch));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(handlers) &nbsp; **Space:** O(handlers)
---

### 1977. Design Ride Sharing LLD
**ID:** `LLD-1977`

**Problem:** Design Ride Sharing LLD.

**Example Input:** multiple riders; driver matches; surge pricing applies

**Example Output:** trip cost includes surge multiplier

**Explanation:** Driver, Rider, Trip; matchmaking by proximity; SurgePricing based on demand/supply ratio.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*;
enum DriverStatus { AVAILABLE, ON_TRIP, OFFLINE }
class RideLocation { double lat,lon; RideLocation(double lat,double lon){this.lat=lat;this.lon=lon;}
    double distanceTo(RideLocation l){return Math.sqrt(Math.pow(lat-l.lat,2)+Math.pow(lon-l.lon,2));} }
class RideDriver { final String id,name; DriverStatus status=DriverStatus.AVAILABLE; RideLocation loc;
    RideDriver(String id,String name,double lat,double lon){this.id=id;this.name=name;loc=new RideLocation(lat,lon);} }
class RideTripRequest { final String riderId; final RideLocation pickup,dropoff;
    RideTripRequest(String rid,RideLocation pick,RideLocation drop){riderId=rid;pickup=pick;dropoff=drop;} }
class RideTrip { final String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString(); final RideDriver driver;
    final RideTripRequest request; double fare;
    RideTrip(RideDriver d,RideTripRequest r){driver=d;request=r;} }
class SurgePricing {
    static double getSurge(int availableDrivers, int pendingRequests){
        if(availableDrivers==0) return 3.0;
        double ratio=(double)pendingRequests/availableDrivers;
        if(ratio>2.0) return 2.5; if(ratio>1.5) return 2.0; if(ratio>1.0) return 1.5; return 1.0;
    }
}
class RideShareService {
    private final List<RideDriver> drivers=new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    private final Queue<RideTripRequest> pending=new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
    void registerDriver(RideDriver d){ drivers.add(d); }
    RideTrip requestRide(String riderId, double pickLat,double pickLon,double dropLat,double dropLon){
        RideLocation pick=new RideLocation(pickLat,pickLon),drop=new RideLocation(dropLat,dropLon);
        RideTripRequest req=new RideTripRequest(riderId,pick,drop); pending.add(req);
        RideDriver nearest=drivers.stream().filter(d->d.status==DriverStatus.AVAILABLE)
            .min(Comparator.comparingDouble(d->d.loc.distanceTo(pick)))
            .orElseThrow(()->new RuntimeException("No drivers available"));
        nearest.status=DriverStatus.ON_TRIP; pending.remove(req);
        long avail=drivers.stream().filter(d->d.status==DriverStatus.AVAILABLE).count();
        double surge=SurgePricing.getSurge((int)avail,pending.size());
        double dist=pick.distanceTo(drop); double fare=Math.max(50,dist*80)*surge;
        RideTrip trip=new RideTrip(nearest,req); trip.fare=fare; return trip;
    }
    void completeTrip(RideTrip t){ t.driver.status=DriverStatus.AVAILABLE; }
}
```

> **Time:** O(drivers) &nbsp; **Space:** O(trips)
---

### 1978. Design Hotel Booking LLD
**ID:** `LLD-1978`

**Problem:** Design Hotel Booking LLD.

**Example Input:** search rooms, book with dates, prevent double-booking

**Example Output:** room booked; conflict returns error

**Explanation:** Room, Reservation with date range; Hotel checks overlapping reservations before booking.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*; import java.time.*;
class Room {
    final String number; final String type; final double pricePerNight;
    Room(String num,String type,double price){this.number=num;this.type=type;this.pricePerNight=price;}
}
class Reservation {
    final String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString(); final String guestId; final Room room;
    final LocalDate checkIn, checkOut; final double totalCost;
    Reservation(String gid,Room r,LocalDate ci,LocalDate co){
        guestId=gid;room=r;checkIn=ci;checkOut=co;
        totalCost=r.pricePerNight*ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(ci,co);
    }
    boolean overlaps(LocalDate ci,LocalDate co){ return !co.isAfter(checkIn)==false&&!ci.isBefore(checkOut)==false||
        (ci.isBefore(checkOut)&&co.isAfter(checkIn)); }
}
class Hotel {
    private final Map<String,Room> rooms=new HashMap<>();
    private final List<Reservation> reservations=new ArrayList<>();
    void addRoom(Room r){ rooms.put(r.number,r); }
    List<Room> search(String type,LocalDate ci,LocalDate co){
        return rooms.values().stream()
            .filter(r->r.type.equals(type))
            .filter(r->reservations.stream().noneMatch(res->res.room==r&&res.overlaps(ci,co)))
            .toList();
    }
    synchronized Reservation book(String guestId,String roomNumber,LocalDate ci,LocalDate co){
        Room room=rooms.get(roomNumber);
        if(room==null) throw new NoSuchElementException("Room not found: "+roomNumber);
        boolean conflict=reservations.stream().anyMatch(r->r.room==room&&r.overlaps(ci,co));
        if(conflict) throw new IllegalStateException("Room "+roomNumber+" already booked for those dates");
        Reservation res=new Reservation(guestId,room,ci,co);
        reservations.add(res); return res;
    }
    void cancel(String reservationId){ reservations.removeIf(r->r.id.equals(reservationId)); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(reservations) &nbsp; **Space:** O(rooms+reservations)
---

### 1979. Design Social Network LLD
**ID:** `LLD-1979`

**Problem:** Design Social Network LLD.

**Example Input:** users connect as friends; post content; view feed

**Example Output:** friend requests accepted; feed shows friends posts

**Explanation:** User, FriendRequest, Post; SocialNetwork manages relationships; feed = friends posts sorted by time.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*; import java.time.*;
class SocialUser {
    final String id,name; private final Set<String> friends=new HashSet<>();
    private final List<Post> posts=new ArrayList<>();
    SocialUser(String id,String name){this.id=id;this.name=name;}
    boolean addFriend(String friendId){ return friends.add(friendId); }
    boolean removeFriend(String friendId){ return friends.remove(friendId); }
    Set<String> getFriends(){ return Collections.unmodifiableSet(friends); }
    void addPost(Post p){ posts.add(p); }
    List<Post> getPosts(){ return posts; }
}
class Post {
    final String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString(); final String authorId,content;
    final Instant createdAt=Instant.now(); int likes=0;
    Post(String authorId,String content){this.authorId=authorId;this.content=content;}
    void like(){ likes++; }
}
class FriendRequest { final String fromId,toId; boolean accepted=false;
    FriendRequest(String from,String to){fromId=from;toId=to;} }
class SocialNetwork {
    private final Map<String,SocialUser> users=new HashMap<>();
    private final List<FriendRequest> requests=new ArrayList<>();
    void registerUser(SocialUser u){ users.put(u.id,u); }
    void sendFriendRequest(String fromId,String toId){ requests.add(new FriendRequest(fromId,toId)); }
    void acceptFriendRequest(String fromId,String toId){
        requests.stream().filter(r->r.fromId.equals(fromId)&&r.toId.equals(toId)&&!r.accepted)
            .findFirst().ifPresent(r->{ r.accepted=true;
                users.get(toId).addFriend(fromId); users.get(fromId).addFriend(toId); });
    }
    Post createPost(String userId,String content){
        Post p=new Post(userId,content); users.get(userId).addPost(p); return p;
    }
    List<Post> getFeed(String userId){
        SocialUser u=users.get(userId);
        return u.getFriends().stream().map(users::get).filter(Objects::nonNull)
            .flatMap(f->f.getPosts().stream())
            .sorted(Comparator.comparing((Post p)->p.createdAt).reversed()).toList();
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(friends*posts) &nbsp; **Space:** O(users+posts)
---

### 1980. Design E Commerce Cart LLD
**ID:** `LLD-1980`

**Problem:** Design E Commerce Cart LLD.

**Example Input:** add items, apply coupon, checkout with inventory check

**Example Output:** cart total computed; inventory decremented on checkout

**Explanation:** CartItem, Cart, Inventory; coupon applies percentage discount; checkout validates stock.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
class Product { final String id,name; double price; Product(String id,String name,double p){this.id=id;this.name=name;price=p;} }
class CartItem { final Product product; int quantity;
    CartItem(Product p,int qty){product=p;quantity=qty;}
    double subtotal(){ return product.price*quantity; } }
class Coupon { final String code; final double discountPct;
    Coupon(String code,double pct){this.code=code;discountPct=pct;} }
class Inventory {
    private final Map<String,Integer> stock=new HashMap<>();
    void addStock(String productId,int qty){ stock.merge(productId,qty,Integer::sum); }
    int getStock(String productId){ return stock.getOrDefault(productId,0); }
    synchronized boolean reserve(String productId,int qty){
        int cur=stock.getOrDefault(productId,0);
        if(cur<qty) return false;
        stock.put(productId,cur-qty); return true;
    }
}
class Cart {
    final String userId; private final List<CartItem> items=new ArrayList<>();
    private Coupon coupon;
    Cart(String uid){ userId=uid; }
    void addItem(Product p,int qty){ items.stream().filter(i->i.product.id.equals(p.id)).findFirst()
        .ifPresentOrElse(i->i.quantity+=qty,()->items.add(new CartItem(p,qty))); }
    void removeItem(String productId){ items.removeIf(i->i.product.id.equals(productId)); }
    void applyCoupon(Coupon c){ coupon=c; }
    double getTotal(){ double sub=items.stream().mapToDouble(CartItem::subtotal).sum();
        return coupon==null?sub:sub*(1-coupon.discountPct/100); }
    List<CartItem> getItems(){ return items; }
    void clear(){ items.clear(); coupon=null; }
}
class CheckoutService {
    private final Inventory inventory;
    CheckoutService(Inventory inv){ inventory=inv; }
    Map<String,Object> checkout(Cart cart){
        for(CartItem item:cart.getItems()){
            if(!inventory.reserve(item.product.id,item.quantity))
                throw new IllegalStateException("Out of stock: "+item.product.name);
        }
        double total=cart.getTotal(); cart.clear();
        return Map.of("status","SUCCESS","total",total);
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(items) &nbsp; **Space:** O(items)
---

### 1981. Design Auction System LLD
**ID:** `LLD-1981`

**Problem:** Design Auction System LLD.

**Example Input:** users bid on items; highest bid wins after timer

**Example Output:** winner determined; seller notified

**Explanation:** Item, Bid, Auction with closing time; AuctionService manages active auctions; winner on close.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*; import java.time.*;
class AuctionItem { final String id,title; final double startingPrice;
    AuctionItem(String id,String title,double sp){this.id=id;this.title=title;startingPrice=sp;} }
class Bid { final String bidderId; final double amount; final Instant placedAt=Instant.now();
    Bid(String bid,double amt){bidderId=bid;amount=amt;} }
class Auction {
    final String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString(); final AuctionItem item; final String sellerId;
    final Instant closingTime; private final List<Bid> bids=new ArrayList<>();
    Auction(AuctionItem item,String seller,Instant close){this.item=item;sellerId=seller;closingTime=close;}
    synchronized void placeBid(String bidderId,double amount){
        if(Instant.now().isAfter(closingTime)) throw new IllegalStateException("Auction closed");
        double highest=bids.stream().mapToDouble(b->b.amount).max().orElse(item.startingPrice);
        if(amount<=highest) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bid must exceed current highest: "+highest);
        bids.add(new Bid(bidderId,amount));
        System.out.printf("Bid %.2f placed by %s on %s%n",amount,bidderId,item.title);
    }
    Optional<Bid> getWinner(){ return bids.stream().max(Comparator.comparingDouble(b->b.amount)); }
    double getCurrentPrice(){ return bids.stream().mapToDouble(b->b.amount).max().orElse(item.startingPrice); }
    List<Bid> getBids(){ return List.copyOf(bids); }
}
class AuctionService {
    private final Map<String,Auction> auctions=new HashMap<>();
    Auction createAuction(AuctionItem item,String sellerId,long durationSeconds){
        Auction a=new Auction(item,sellerId,Instant.now().plusSeconds(durationSeconds));
        auctions.put(a.id,a); return a;
    }
    void closeAuction(String auctionId){
        Auction a=auctions.get(auctionId);
        a.getWinner().ifPresentOrElse(
            w->System.out.printf("Auction %s: WINNER=%s with %.2f%n",auctionId,w.bidderId,w.amount),
            ()->System.out.println("Auction "+auctionId+": No bids"));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(bids) &nbsp; **Space:** O(auctions*bids)
---

### 1982. Design Document Editor LLD
**ID:** `LLD-1982`

**Problem:** Design Document Editor LLD.

**Example Input:** collaborative text editing with undo/redo and cursor tracking

**Example Output:** edit operations applied and undoable

**Explanation:** Document stores content; EditOperation history with undo/redo stacks; Cursor per user.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*;
class Document {
    private final StringBuilder content=new StringBuilder();
    void insert(int pos,String text){ content.insert(pos,text); }
    void delete(int pos,int len){ content.delete(pos,pos+len); }
    String getContent(){ return content.toString(); }
    int length(){ return content.length(); }
}
interface EditOp { void apply(Document doc); void revert(Document doc); }
class InsertOp implements EditOp {
    final int pos; final String text;
    InsertOp(int pos,String text){this.pos=pos;this.text=text;}
    public void apply(Document d){ d.insert(pos,text); }
    public void revert(Document d){ d.delete(pos,text.length()); }
}
class DeleteOp implements EditOp {
    final int pos; final int len; String deleted;
    DeleteOp(int pos,int len){this.pos=pos;this.len=len;}
    public void apply(Document d){ deleted=d.getContent().substring(pos,pos+len); d.delete(pos,len); }
    public void revert(Document d){ d.insert(pos,deleted); }
}
class DocumentEditor {
    private final Document doc=new Document();
    private final Deque<EditOp> undoStack=new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final Deque<EditOp> redoStack=new ArrayDeque<>();
    void execute(EditOp op){ op.apply(doc); undoStack.push(op); redoStack.clear(); }
    void undo(){ if(!undoStack.isEmpty()){ EditOp op=undoStack.pop(); op.revert(doc); redoStack.push(op); } }
    void redo(){ if(!redoStack.isEmpty()){ EditOp op=redoStack.pop(); op.apply(doc); undoStack.push(op); } }
    void insert(int pos,String text){ execute(new InsertOp(pos,text)); }
    void delete(int pos,int len){ execute(new DeleteOp(pos,len)); }
    String getContent(){ return doc.getContent(); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(history)
---

### 1983. Design Calendar Application
**ID:** `LLD-1983`

**Problem:** Design Calendar Application.

**Example Input:** create events, invite attendees, detect conflicts

**Example Output:** event added; conflict detection for overlapping times

**Explanation:** Event with time range, attendees; Calendar per user; ConflictDetector checks overlapping events.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*; import java.time.*;
class CalendarEvent {
    final String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString(); final String title,organizerId;
    final LocalDateTime start,end; private final Set<String> attendeeIds=new HashSet<>();
    CalendarEvent(String title,String orgId,LocalDateTime s,LocalDateTime e){
        if(!s.isBefore(e)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Start must be before end");
        this.title=title;organizerId=orgId;start=s;end=e;
    }
    void addAttendee(String uid){ attendeeIds.add(uid); }
    Set<String> getAttendees(){ return Collections.unmodifiableSet(attendeeIds); }
    boolean overlaps(CalendarEvent other){ return start.isBefore(other.end)&&end.isAfter(other.start); }
}
class UserCalendar {
    final String userId; private final List<CalendarEvent> events=new ArrayList<>();
    UserCalendar(String uid){ userId=uid; }
    boolean addEvent(CalendarEvent e){
        boolean hasConflict=events.stream().anyMatch(existing->existing.overlaps(e));
        if(hasConflict) return false;  // or throw; here return false to indicate conflict
        events.add(e); return true;
    }
    List<CalendarEvent> getEventsOn(LocalDate date){
        return events.stream().filter(e->e.start.toLocalDate().equals(date)).toList();
    }
    List<CalendarEvent> getFreeSlots(LocalDate date, Duration minDuration){
        // simplified: return events and caller computes gaps
        return getEventsOn(date);
    }
}
class CalendarService {
    private final Map<String,UserCalendar> calendars=new HashMap<>();
    void createCalendar(String userId){ calendars.put(userId,new UserCalendar(userId)); }
    boolean scheduleEvent(CalendarEvent event){
        List<String> attendees=new ArrayList<>(event.getAttendees());
        attendees.add(event.organizerId);
        for(String uid:attendees){
            UserCalendar cal=calendars.computeIfAbsent(uid,UserCalendar::new);
            if(!cal.addEvent(event)){
                System.out.println("Conflict for user: "+uid+" on event: "+event.title); return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(events) &nbsp; **Space:** O(users*events)
---

### 1984. Design Banking System LLD
**ID:** `LLD-1984`

**Problem:** Design Banking System LLD.

**Example Input:** accounts, transfers, transaction history, interest calculation

**Example Output:** transfer deducted/credited; history recorded

**Explanation:** Account, Transaction, Bank; transfer uses locks for thread safety; TransactionHistory per account.

**Answer:**
```java
import java.util.*; import java.time.*; import java.util.concurrent.locks.*;
enum TxType { DEPOSIT, WITHDRAWAL, TRANSFER_OUT, TRANSFER_IN }
class Transaction { final String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString(); final TxType type;
    final double amount; final Instant at=Instant.now(); final String note;
    Transaction(TxType t,double amt,String note){type=t;amount=amt;this.note=note;} }
class BankAccount {
    final String accountNumber; private volatile double balance;
    private final List<Transaction> history=Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
    private final ReentrantLock lock=new ReentrantLock();
    BankAccount(String num,double initial){accountNumber=num;balance=initial;}
    void deposit(double amount){
        if(amount<=0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be positive");
        lock.lock(); try{ balance+=amount; history.add(new Transaction(TxType.DEPOSIT,amount,"deposit")); } finally{lock.unlock();}
    }
    void withdraw(double amount){
        if(amount<=0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be positive");
        lock.lock(); try{
            if(balance<amount) throw new IllegalStateException("Insufficient funds");
            balance-=amount; history.add(new Transaction(TxType.WITHDRAWAL,amount,"withdrawal"));
        } finally{lock.unlock();}
    }
    double getBalance(){ return balance; }
    List<Transaction> getHistory(){ return List.copyOf(history); }
    ReentrantLock getLock(){ return lock; }
}
class Bank {
    private final Map<String,BankAccount> accounts=new HashMap<>();
    void openAccount(BankAccount a){ accounts.put(a.accountNumber,a); }
    void transfer(String fromNum,String toNum,double amount){
        BankAccount from=accounts.get(fromNum), to=accounts.get(toNum);
        if(from==null||to==null) throw new NoSuchElementException("Account not found");
        BankAccount first=fromNum.compareTo(toNum)<0?from:to, second=first==from?to:from;
        first.getLock().lock(); try{ second.getLock().lock(); try{
            from.withdraw(amount); to.deposit(amount);
            from.getHistory().size();  // just to access
            System.out.printf("Transferred %.2f from %s to %s%n",amount,fromNum,toNum);
        } finally{second.getLock().unlock();} } finally{first.getLock().unlock();}
    }
    BankAccount getAccount(String num){ return accounts.get(num); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(accounts+txns)
---

## System Design HLD


### 1985. Design URL Shortener
**ID:** `HLD-1985`

**Problem:** Design URL Shortener.

**Example Input:** long URL input; custom or random short code

**Example Output:** https://short.ly/abc123 -> redirects to original

**Explanation:** Hash long URL to 7-char base62; KV store for shortCode->longURL; Redis cache + DB; CDN for redirects.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: URL Shortener
// Components: API Service | Redis Cache | DB (Cassandra/MySQL) | CDN
// Flow: POST /shorten -> generate base62 code -> store in DB + cache
//       GET /{code}   -> check cache first -> DB fallback -> 301 redirect

import java.util.Base64;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

class UrlShortenerService {
```
