```java
    private static final String BASE62 = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz";
    private static final int CODE_LEN = 7;
    private final Map<String,String> cache  = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();   // Redis
    private final Map<String,String> db     = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();   // persistent store
    private final Map<String,String> reverse= new ConcurrentHashMap<>();   // longUrl -> code
    private long counter = 1_000_000L;                                     // auto-increment ID

    String shorten(String longUrl) {
        if (reverse.containsKey(longUrl)) return "https://short.ly/" + reverse.get(longUrl);
        String code = toBase62(++counter);
        db.put(code, longUrl); cache.put(code, longUrl); reverse.put(longUrl, code);
        return "https://short.ly/" + code;
    }

    String expand(String code) {
        if (cache.containsKey(code)) return cache.get(code);   // L1 hit
        String url = db.get(code);
        if (url != null) cache.put(code, url);                 // populate cache
        return url;                                             // null if not found
    }

    private String toBase62(long n) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        while (sb.length() < CODE_LEN) { sb.append(BASE62.charAt((int)(n % 62))); n /= 62; }
        return sb.reverse().toString();
    }
}
// Scalability notes:
// - Partition by hash prefix; replicate DB across regions
// - 301 Permanent vs 302 Temporary redirect (caching implications)
// - Analytics: click tracking via async Kafka events
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(urls)
---

### 1986. Design WhatsApp
**ID:** `HLD-1986`

**Problem:** Design WhatsApp.

**Example Input:** billions of users; real-time messaging; group chats; media

**Example Output:** message delivered with status: sent/delivered/read

**Explanation:** WebSocket for real-time; message queue per user; Cassandra for msg history; E2E encryption; fan-out for groups.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: WhatsApp Messaging System
// Components: Client App | WebSocket Servers | Message Queue (Kafka) |
//             Message Store (Cassandra) | Media Store (S3) | Presence Service | Push Notification

// Key Design Decisions:
// 1. WebSocket for online users; APNS/FCM for offline users
// 2. Message ID = (sender_id, timestamp, seq) for ordering
// 3. Cassandra schema: partition by conversationId, cluster by messageId DESC
// 4. Group messages fan-out: sender -> Kafka topic -> group member queues
// 5. End-to-End Encryption: keys exchanged via Signal Protocol (no server decryption)

import java.util.*;
import java.time.Instant;

enum MsgStatus { SENT, DELIVERED, READ }
record Message(String id, String senderId, String chatId, String cipherText,
               Instant ts, MsgStatus status) {}

class ConversationStore {  // simplified Cassandra model
    private final Map<String, Deque<Message>> byChat = new HashMap<>();
    void save(Message m){ byChat.computeIfAbsent(m.chatId(), k->new ArrayDeque<>()).addFirst(m); }
    List<Message> fetch(String chatId, int limit){
        Deque<Message> q = byChat.getOrDefault(chatId, new ArrayDeque<>());
        List<Message> res = new ArrayList<>();
        Iterator<Message> it = q.iterator();
        while(it.hasNext() && res.size()<limit) res.add(it.next());
        return res;
    }
}

class PresenceService {
    private final Map<String,Instant> lastSeen = new HashMap<>();
    void heartbeat(String userId){ lastSeen.put(userId, Instant.now()); }
    boolean isOnline(String userId){
        Instant ls = lastSeen.get(userId);
        return ls != null && Instant.now().minusSeconds(30).isBefore(ls);
    }
}
// Message delivery: route via Kafka partition per userId -> WebSocket server -> client
// Undelivered: stored in message queue; delivered on reconnect
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(msgs)
---

### 1987. Design Instagram Feed
**ID:** `HLD-1987`

**Problem:** Design Instagram Feed.

**Example Input:** user uploads photo; followers see it in ranked feed

**Example Output:** feed loads top 20 posts sorted by relevance

**Explanation:** Media upload to S3; feed generation: push model for celebrities, pull+merge for regular users; Redis timeline.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Instagram-like Feed System
// Components: Upload Service | CDN (CloudFront) | Feed Service |
//             Graph Service (followers) | Ranking Service | Timeline Cache (Redis)

// Key Decisions:
// 1. Hybrid fan-out: push for normal users (write fan-out to follower timelines),
//    pull for celebrities (>1M followers) to avoid fan-out storm
// 2. Each user's timeline = sorted set in Redis (score = relevance score)
// 3. Ranking factors: recency, likes, relationship strength, media type
// 4. Media: upload -> S3 -> Lambda generates thumbnails -> CloudFront CDN

import java.util.*;

record FeedPost(String postId, String authorId, long score, String mediaUrl) {}

class TimelineCache {  // Redis Sorted Set abstraction
    private final Map<String, TreeSet<FeedPost>> timelines = new HashMap<>();
    void pushPost(String userId, FeedPost post){
        timelines.computeIfAbsent(userId, k->new TreeSet<>(
            Comparator.comparingLong((FeedPost p)->p.score()).reversed()))
        .add(post);
    }
    List<FeedPost> getTimeline(String userId, int limit){
        TreeSet<FeedPost> ts = timelines.getOrDefault(userId, new TreeSet<>());
        List<FeedPost> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for(FeedPost p : ts){ if(res.size()>=limit) break; res.add(p); }
        return res;
    }
}
class FanOutService {
    private final Map<String,List<String>> followers = new HashMap<>();  // Graph DB
    private final TimelineCache cache = new TimelineCache();
    void addFollower(String author, String follower){ followers.computeIfAbsent(author,k->new ArrayList<>()).add(follower); }
    void publishPost(String authorId, String postId, String mediaUrl){
        long score = System.currentTimeMillis();
        FeedPost post = new FeedPost(postId, authorId, score, mediaUrl);
        List<String> fols = followers.getOrDefault(authorId, List.of());
        if(fols.size() > 1_000_000) return;  // celebrity: skip push fan-out, use pull
        fols.forEach(f -> cache.pushPost(f, post));
    }
    List<FeedPost> getFeed(String userId, int limit){ return cache.getTimeline(userId, limit); }
}
```

> **Time:** O(followers) &nbsp; **Space:** O(users*feedSize)
---

### 1988. Design Notification System
**ID:** `HLD-1988`

**Problem:** Design Notification System.

**Example Input:** millions of users; multi-channel; templated; prioritized

**Example Output:** notification sent via correct channel with correct template

**Explanation:** Kafka topic per priority; NotificationWorker dequeues; TemplateEngine renders; DeliveryAdapter per channel.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Multi-Channel Notification System
// Components: Notification API | Kafka (priority queues) | Worker Pool |
//             Template Engine | Channel Adapters (Email/SMS/Push/In-App) | Delivery DB

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

enum Priority { CRITICAL, HIGH, NORMAL, LOW }
enum NChannel { EMAIL, SMS, PUSH, IN_APP }
record NotifRequest(String userId, String templateId, Map<String,String> params,
                    NChannel channel, Priority priority) {}
record RenderedNotif(String subject, String body, NChannel channel) {}

class TemplateEngine {
    private final Map<String,String> templates = Map.of(
        "WELCOME", "Hi {{name}}, welcome to {{app}}!",
        "OTP",     "Your OTP is {{otp}}. Valid for 5 minutes.",
        "PROMO",   "{{name}}, get {{discount}}% off today!"
    );
    RenderedNotif render(NotifRequest req){
        String tmpl = templates.getOrDefault(req.templateId(), "Hello {{name}}");
        String body = tmpl;
        for(Map.Entry<String,String> e : req.params().entrySet())
            body = body.replace("{{"+e.getKey()+"}}", e.getValue());
        return new RenderedNotif(req.templateId(), body, req.channel());
    }
}

class NotificationWorker {
    private final TemplateEngine engine = new TemplateEngine();
    private final Map<NChannel,Consumer<RenderedNotif>> adapters = new EnumMap<>(NChannel.class);
    NotificationWorker(){
        adapters.put(NChannel.EMAIL, n->System.out.println("EMAIL: "+n.body()));
        adapters.put(NChannel.SMS,   n->System.out.println("SMS: "+n.body()));
        adapters.put(NChannel.PUSH,  n->System.out.println("PUSH: "+n.subject()));
        adapters.put(NChannel.IN_APP,n->System.out.println("IN_APP: "+n.body()));
    }
    void process(NotifRequest req){
        RenderedNotif rendered = engine.render(req);
        adapters.getOrDefault(req.channel(), n->{}).accept(rendered);
    }
}
// Rate limiting: per-user per-channel limits to avoid spam
// Retry: exponential backoff with dead-letter queue for failed deliveries
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(templates)
---

### 1989. Design API Gateway
**ID:** `HLD-1989`

**Problem:** Design API Gateway.

**Example Input:** single entry point; auth, rate limit, routing, LB

**Example Output:** request authenticated, rate-checked, routed to service

**Explanation:** Gateway pipeline: Auth filter -> Rate limiter -> Router -> Load balancer -> downstream service.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: API Gateway
// Components: TLS termination | Auth (JWT/OAuth) | Rate Limiter | Router |
//             Load Balancer | Service Registry | Circuit Breaker | Response Cache | Logging

import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.*;

record GatewayRequest(String method, String path, Map<String,String> headers, String body) {}
record GatewayResponse(int status, String body) {}

interface Filter { GatewayResponse apply(GatewayRequest req, Supplier<GatewayResponse> next); }

class AuthFilter implements Filter {
    public GatewayResponse apply(GatewayRequest req, Supplier<GatewayResponse> next){
        String auth = req.headers().get("Authorization");
        if(auth==null||!auth.startsWith("Bearer "))
            return new GatewayResponse(401, "Unauthorized");
        // validate JWT (simplified)
        return next.get();
    }
}

class RateLimitFilter implements Filter {
    private final Map<String,Integer> counts = new HashMap<>();
    private final int limit;
    RateLimitFilter(int limit){ this.limit=limit; }
    public GatewayResponse apply(GatewayRequest req, Supplier<GatewayResponse> next){
        String key = req.headers().getOrDefault("X-User-Id","anon");
        int count = counts.merge(key, 1, Integer::sum);
        if(count > limit) return new GatewayResponse(429, "Too Many Requests");
        return next.get();
    }
}

class ApiGateway {
    private final List<Filter> filters = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Map<String,String> routes = new HashMap<>();  // path prefix -> service URL
    void addFilter(Filter f){ filters.add(f); }
    void addRoute(String prefix, String serviceUrl){ routes.put(prefix, serviceUrl); }
    GatewayResponse handle(GatewayRequest req){
        return applyFilters(req, 0, ()-> route(req));
    }
    private GatewayResponse applyFilters(GatewayRequest req, int idx, Supplier<GatewayResponse> terminal){
        if(idx>=filters.size()) return terminal.get();
        return filters.get(idx).apply(req, ()->applyFilters(req,idx+1,terminal));
    }
    private GatewayResponse route(GatewayRequest req){
        return routes.entrySet().stream()
            .filter(e->req.path().startsWith(e.getKey())).findFirst()
            .map(e->new GatewayResponse(200,"Routed to: "+e.getValue()))
            .orElse(new GatewayResponse(404,"No route for: "+req.path()));
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(filters) &nbsp; **Space:** O(routes)
---

### 1990. Design Rate Limiter
**ID:** `HLD-1990`

**Problem:** Design Rate Limiter.

**Example Input:** distributed rate limiter; 100 req/min per user

**Example Output:** allow or reject request based on token count

**Explanation:** Token bucket per user in Redis; sliding window log; distributed counter with TTL; Lua atomic script.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Distributed Rate Limiter
// Algorithms: Token Bucket, Sliding Window Counter, Fixed Window Counter
// Storage: Redis with atomic Lua scripts for distributed correctness

import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;
import java.util.*;

// Sliding Window Counter (approximated)
class SlidingWindowRateLimiter {
    private final int limit; private final long windowMs;
    private final Map<String, Deque<Long>> timestamps = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    SlidingWindowRateLimiter(int limit, long windowMs){ this.limit=limit; this.windowMs=windowMs; }
    synchronized boolean tryAcquire(String userId){
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        Deque<Long> ts = timestamps.computeIfAbsent(userId, k->new ArrayDeque<>());
        while(!ts.isEmpty() && now-ts.peekFirst()>windowMs) ts.pollFirst();
        if(ts.size()>=limit) return false;
        ts.addLast(now); return true;
    }
}
// Token Bucket (production-grade)
class DistributedTokenBucket {
    // In production: Redis EVAL script runs atomically:
    // local tokens = redis.call('GET', key) or capacity
    // if tokens >= 1 then redis.call('DECR', key); return 1 else return 0 end
    // redis.call('EXPIRE', key, ttl)
    private final Map<String,AtomicInteger> store = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final int capacity;
    DistributedTokenBucket(int capacity){ this.capacity=capacity; }
    boolean tryAcquire(String key){
        AtomicInteger tokens = store.computeIfAbsent(key, k->new AtomicInteger(capacity));
        int cur;
        do { cur = tokens.get(); if(cur<=0) return false; } while(!tokens.compareAndSet(cur,cur-1));
        return true;
    }
}
// Response headers per RFC 6585:
// X-RateLimit-Limit: 100
// X-RateLimit-Remaining: 75
// X-RateLimit-Reset: 1715000000
// Retry-After: 30  (on 429)
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(users)
---

### 1991. Design Distributed Cache
**ID:** `HLD-1991`

**Problem:** Design Distributed Cache.

**Example Input:** in-memory cache with TTL, eviction, clustering

**Example Output:** get/set with TTL; LRU eviction when full

**Explanation:** Local LRU + TTL; consistent hashing for sharding; replication for HA; cache-aside/write-through patterns.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Distributed Cache (Redis-like)
// Components: Cache Nodes | Consistent Hashing Ring | Replica Sets | Client Library

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

class CacheEntry<V> {
    final V value; final long expiresAt;
    CacheEntry(V v, long ttlMs){ value=v; expiresAt=ttlMs>0?System.currentTimeMillis()+ttlMs:-1; }
    boolean isExpired(){ return expiresAt>0 && System.currentTimeMillis()>expiresAt; }
}

class LRUCache<K,V> {
    private final int capacity;
    private final LinkedHashMap<K,CacheEntry<V>> map;
    LRUCache(int capacity){ this.capacity=capacity;
        map = new LinkedHashMap<>(16,0.75f,true){ protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<K,CacheEntry<V>> e){ return size()>capacity; } };
    }
    synchronized void put(K key, V value, long ttlMs){ map.put(key,new CacheEntry<>(value,ttlMs)); }
    synchronized Optional<V> get(K key){
        CacheEntry<V> e = map.get(key);
        if(e==null) return Optional.empty();
        if(e.isExpired()){ map.remove(key); return Optional.empty(); }
        return Optional.of(e.value);
    }
    synchronized void evictExpired(){ map.entrySet().removeIf(e->e.getValue().isExpired()); }
    int size(){ return map.size(); }
}

class ConsistentHash {
    private final TreeMap<Long,String> ring = new TreeMap<>();
    private final int virtualNodes;
    ConsistentHash(int vNodes){ virtualNodes=vNodes; }
    void addNode(String node){ for(int i=0;i<virtualNodes;i++) ring.put(hash(node+"-"+i),node); }
    String getNode(String key){
        if(ring.isEmpty()) return null;
        Long h = ring.ceilingKey(hash(key));
        return ring.get(h!=null?h:ring.firstKey());
    }
    private long hash(String s){ return s.hashCode() & 0xFFFFFFFFL; }
}
// Cache patterns: cache-aside (read), write-through, write-behind, read-through
// Eviction policies: LRU (access time), LFU (frequency), TTL-based
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(capacity)
---

**ID:** `HLD-1992`

**Problem:** Design YouTube.

**Example Input:** video upload, processing, streaming, search, recommendations

```java
// High-Level Design: Video Streaming Platform (YouTube-like)
// Components: Upload Service | Transcoding Service | CDN | Metadata DB |
//             Search Service | Recommendation Engine | View Counter

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

enum VideoStatus { UPLOADING, PROCESSING, READY, FAILED }
record VideoMetadata(String videoId, String title, String channelId,
                     List<String> tags, VideoStatus status, long views) {}
record StreamManifest(String videoId, Map<String,String> resolutionUrls) {} // HLS/DASH manifest

class UploadService {
    private final Map<String,VideoMetadata> metaStore = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final BlockingQueue<String> transcodingQueue = new LinkedBlockingQueue<>();

    String initiateUpload(String channelId, String title, List<String> tags){
        String videoId = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        metaStore.put(videoId, new VideoMetadata(videoId,title,channelId,tags,VideoStatus.UPLOADING,0));
        return videoId;  // client uploads chunks to pre-signed S3 URL
    }
    void onUploadComplete(String videoId){
        // update status and enqueue for transcoding
        transcodingQueue.offer(videoId);
        System.out.println("Queued for transcoding: "+videoId);
    }
}

class TranscodingService {

    StreamManifest transcode(String videoId){

            "720p",  "https://cdn.example.com/"+videoId+"/720p.m3u8",
            "1080p", "https://cdn.example.com/"+videoId+"/1080p.m3u8"
        );
        System.out.println("Transcoded: "+videoId+" to "+urls.size()+" resolutions");
        return new StreamManifest(videoId, urls);
    }
}
// View counter: approximate with Redis INCR; batch flush to DB every 5 min
// Recommendations: collaborative filtering + watch history + trending signals
```

### 1994. Design Search Autocomplete
**ID:** `HLD-1994`

**Problem:** Design Search Autocomplete.

**Example Input:** type-ahead suggestions as user types query

**Example Output:** ['apple pie','apple watch','apple music'] for 'appl'

**Explanation:** Trie for prefix matching; Redis sorted set for trending; top-K by frequency; debounce on client side.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Search Autocomplete
// Components: Trie Service | Frequency Store (Redis Sorted Set) | Suggestion API | CDN cache

import java.util.*;

class TrieNode {
    Map<Character,TrieNode> children = new HashMap<>();
    List<String> topSuggestions = new ArrayList<>(); // precomputed top-K at each node
    boolean isEnd; String word;
}

class AutocompleteTrie {
    private final TrieNode root = new TrieNode();
    private final int topK;
    AutocompleteTrie(int topK){ this.topK=topK; }

    void insert(String word, long freq){
        TrieNode node = root;
        for(char c : word.toCharArray()){
            node.children.putIfAbsent(c, new TrieNode());
            node = node.children.get(c);
            addToTopK(node, word, freq);  // update suggestions along path
        }
        node.isEnd=true; node.word=word;
    }

    private void addToTopK(TrieNode node, String word, long freq){
        node.topSuggestions.removeIf(s->s.equals(word));
        node.topSuggestions.add(word);
        if(node.topSuggestions.size()>topK) node.topSuggestions.remove(node.topSuggestions.size()-1);
    }

    List<String> suggest(String prefix){
        TrieNode node = root;
        for(char c : prefix.toCharArray()){
            if(!node.children.containsKey(c)) return List.of();
            node = node.children.get(c);
        }
        return List.copyOf(node.topSuggestions);
    }
}

class AutocompleteService {
    private final AutocompleteTrie trie = new AutocompleteTrie(10);
    // Preload top search queries with frequencies
    void loadFromLogs(Map<String,Long> queryFreqs){
        // Sort by freq desc and insert
        queryFreqs.entrySet().stream()
            .sorted(Map.Entry.<String,Long>comparingByValue().reversed())
            .forEach(e->trie.insert(e.getKey(),e.getValue()));
    }
    List<String> getSuggestions(String prefix){ return trie.suggest(prefix.toLowerCase()); }
}
// Scale: 1B queries/day -> shard trie by first character
// Cache: CDN caches common prefixes; 1-char prefix pre-warmed
```

> **Time:** O(prefix len) &nbsp; **Space:** O(total chars)
---

```java
// Components: Tweet Service | Fan-out Service | Timeline Service | Trending Service |
//             Search Service | Notification Service | Media Service

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

record Tweet(String id, String authorId, String content, Instant ts, List<String> hashtags) {}

class TweetFanOut {
    private final Map<String,List<String>> following = new HashMap<>();  // userId->followees
    private final Map<String,Deque<Tweet>> timelines = new HashMap<>();  // userId->timeline
    private static final int MAX_TIMELINE = 800;  // store last 800 tweets in memory

    void addFollow(String userId, String followeeId){
        following.computeIfAbsent(userId,k->new ArrayList<>()).add(followeeId);
    }
    void onNewTweet(Tweet tweet, List<String> followerIds){
        // Push fan-out to each follower's timeline (skip for celebrities >1M followers)
        for(String fId : followerIds){
            Deque<Tweet> tl = timelines.computeIfAbsent(fId,k->new ArrayDeque<>());
            tl.addFirst(tweet);
            if(tl.size()>MAX_TIMELINE) tl.pollLast();
        }
    }
    List<Tweet> getTimeline(String userId, int limit){
        Deque<Tweet> tl = timelines.getOrDefault(userId,new ArrayDeque<>());
        return tl.stream().limit(limit).toList();
    }
}

class TrendingService {
    // Sliding window count of hashtags in last 1h
    private final Map<String,Deque<Instant>> tagEvents = new HashMap<>();
    void recordHashtag(String tag){ tagEvents.computeIfAbsent(tag,k->new ArrayDeque<>()).addLast(Instant.now()); }
    List<String> getTopTrending(int k){
        Instant cutoff = Instant.now().minusSeconds(3600);
        Map<String,Long> counts = new HashMap<>();
        tagEvents.forEach((tag,dq)->{ while(!dq.isEmpty()&&dq.peekFirst().isBefore(cutoff)) dq.pollFirst();
            if(!dq.isEmpty()) counts.put(tag,(long)dq.size()); });
        return counts.entrySet().stream().sorted(Map.Entry.<String,Long>comparingByValue().reversed())
            .limit(k).map(Map.Entry::getKey).toList();
    }
}
// Scale: 150M DAU; 500M tweets/day; fan-out storm prevention for celebrities
// Storage: Cassandra for tweets; Redis for timelines; Elasticsearch for search
```

> **Time:** O(followers) &nbsp; **Space:** O(users*800)
---

### 1996. Design Uber HLD
**ID:** `HLD-1996`

**Problem:** Design Uber HLD.

**Example Input:** rider requests ride; driver accepts; real-time tracking

**Example Output:** matched driver shows on map; fare calculated on completion

**Explanation:** Driver location in Redis geospatial; matching via geosearch; trip state via Kafka events; ETA from maps.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Uber Ride Sharing
// Components: Location Service (Redis Geo) | Matching Service | Trip Service |
//             Pricing Service | ETA Engine | Payment Service | Notification Service

import java.util.*;

record DriverLocation(String driverId, double lat, double lon, boolean available) {}
record UberRideRequest(String requestId, String riderId, double pickLat, double pickLon, double dropLat, double dropLon) {}
record UberTrip(String tripId, String requestId, String driverId, double estimatedFare, String eta) {}

class LocationService {
    // In production: Redis GEOADD / GEOSEARCH
    private final Map<String,DriverLocation> locations = new HashMap<>();
    void updateLocation(DriverLocation dl){ locations.put(dl.driverId(),dl); }
    List<DriverLocation> findNearby(double lat, double lon, double radiusKm){
        return locations.values().stream().filter(DriverLocation::available)
            .filter(d->distance(lat,lon,d.lat(),d.lon())<radiusKm)
            .sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(d->distance(lat,lon,d.lat(),d.lon())))
            .toList();
    }
    private double distance(double lat1,double lon1,double lat2,double lon2){
        return Math.sqrt(Math.pow(lat1-lat2,2)+Math.pow(lon1-lon2,2))*111;  // approx km
    }
}

class PricingService {
    double calculateFare(double distanceKm, String vehicleType, double surgeMult){
        double base = switch(vehicleType){ case "UberX"->2.0; case "UberXL"->3.5; default->2.5; };
        return Math.max(5.0,(base+distanceKm*1.2)*surgeMult);
    }
    double getSurge(int availableDrivers,int pendingRiders){
        double ratio = availableDrivers==0?5.0:(double)pendingRiders/availableDrivers;
        if(ratio>3) return 3.0; if(ratio>2) return 2.0; if(ratio>1) return 1.5; return 1.0;
    }
}
// Trip lifecycle events via Kafka: REQUEST->MATCHED->STARTED->COMPLETED->PAYMENT_DONE
// Driver income computed per trip; weekly settlement via ACH transfer
```

> **Time:** O(drivers) &nbsp; **Space:** O(drivers)
---

```java
// High-Level Design: Netflix Video Streaming
// Components: API Gateway | Content Service | Streaming Service | CDN (Open Connect) |
//             Recommendation Engine | Analytics Pipeline | User Service

import java.util.*;

record NetflixContent(String contentId, String title, String genre, List<String> cdnUrls, Map<String,String> resolutions) {}
record WatchEvent(String userId, String contentId, long watchedSeconds, double completionPct, Instant at) {}

class ContentDeliveryService {
    // Selects best CDN PoP based on user location and load
    String selectStreamingUrl(String contentId, String userRegion, String quality){
        // In production: Anycast routing + latency-based DNS -> nearest Open Connect Appliance
        return "https://cdn-"+userRegion+".nflxvideo.net/"+contentId+"/"+quality+".m3u8";
    }
    // Adaptive bitrate: client monitors buffer health and switches quality
    List<String> getAvailableQualities(){ return List.of("240p","480p","720p","1080p","4K","HDR"); }
}

class RecommendationEngine {
    // Collaborative filtering: users who watched X also watched Y
    // Content-based: embeddings from title, genre, actors
    private final Map<String,List<String>> watchHistory = new HashMap<>();
    void recordWatch(WatchEvent e){ watchHistory.computeIfAbsent(e.userId(),k->new ArrayList<>()).add(e.contentId()); }
    List<String> recommend(String userId, int limit){
        // Simplified: return items watched by similar users (cosine similarity on watch vectors)
        List<String> watched = watchHistory.getOrDefault(userId,List.of());

        return watched.stream().limit(limit).map(id->"RECOMMENDED-"+id).toList();

}

class AnalyticsPipeline {

}
// Costs: 15% of global internet traffic; CDN crucial for quality and cost
```

### 1998. Design Amazon HLD
**ID:** `HLD-1998`

**Problem:** Design Amazon HLD.

**Example Input:** product catalog, cart, orders, payments, delivery tracking

**Example Output:** order placed end-to-end with tracking ID

**Explanation:** Product service, Order service, Inventory service, Payment service; event-driven via SNS/SQS; DynamoDB.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Amazon E-Commerce Platform
// Components: Product Catalog | Search (Elasticsearch) | Recommendations | Cart Service |
//             Order Service | Inventory | Payment | Fulfillment | Delivery Tracking

import java.util.*;

enum OrderStatus { PENDING_PAYMENT, PAYMENT_CONFIRMED, WAREHOUSE_PROCESSING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED }
record AmazonProduct(String asin, String title, double price, int stock) {}
record AmazonCartItem(String asin, int quantity) {}
record AmazonOrder(String orderId, String userId, List<AmazonCartItem> items, double total, OrderStatus status, String trackingId) {}

class ProductCatalog {
    private final Map<String,AmazonProduct> products = new HashMap<>();
    void addProduct(AmazonProduct p){ products.put(p.asin(),p); }
    Optional<AmazonProduct> find(String asin){ return Optional.ofNullable(products.get(asin)); }
    List<AmazonProduct> search(String query){
        return products.values().stream().filter(p->p.title().toLowerCase().contains(query.toLowerCase())).toList();
    }
}

class InventoryService {
    private final Map<String,Integer> stock = new HashMap<>();
    void setStock(String asin,int qty){ stock.put(asin,qty); }
    synchronized boolean reserve(String asin,int qty){
        int cur=stock.getOrDefault(asin,0);
        if(cur<qty) return false;
        stock.put(asin,cur-qty); return true;
    }
    void release(String asin,int qty){ stock.merge(asin,qty,Integer::sum); }
}

class OrderService {
    private final InventoryService inventory;
    private final Map<String,AmazonOrder> orders=new HashMap<>();
    OrderService(InventoryService inv){ inventory=inv; }
    AmazonOrder placeOrder(String userId,List<AmazonCartItem> items,double total){
        for(AmazonCartItem item:items) if(!inventory.reserve(item.asin(),item.quantity())) throw new IllegalStateException("Out of stock: "+item.asin());
        String orderId=UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        String trackingId="TRK-"+orderId.substring(0,8).toUpperCase();
        AmazonOrder order=new AmazonOrder(orderId,userId,items,total,OrderStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT,trackingId);
        orders.put(orderId,order); return order;
    }
    void advanceStatus(String orderId){
        AmazonOrder o=orders.get(orderId);
        OrderStatus next=OrderStatus.values()[Math.min(o.status().ordinal()+1,OrderStatus.values().length-1)];
        orders.put(orderId,new AmazonOrder(o.orderId(),o.userId(),o.items(),o.total(),next,o.trackingId()));
    }
}
// Prime: 2-day fulfillment via regional warehouses + same-day via local delivery hubs
// Payments: tokenized card storage; 3DS for international; EMI via lending partners
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(products+orders)

### 1999. Design Google Maps HLD
**ID:** `HLD-1999`

**Problem:** Design Google Maps HLD.

**Example Input:** route from A to B; traffic-aware; turn-by-turn navigation

**Example Output:** fastest/shortest route with ETA and traffic overlays

**Explanation:** Graph of road segments; Dijkstra/A* on pre-computed regions; real-time traffic via probe vehicles; tile CDN.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Google Maps
// Components: Map Tile Service (CDN) | Routing Service | Traffic Service |
//             Search/Geocoding | Navigation Service | ETA Engine | Places API

import java.util.*;

class RoadNode { final String id; double lat,lon; RoadNode(String id,double lat,double lon){this.id=id;this.lat=lat;this.lon=lon;} }
class RoadEdge { final RoadNode from,to; double baseWeightMin; volatile double trafficMultiplier=1.0;
    RoadEdge(RoadNode f,RoadNode t,double baseMin){from=f;to=t;baseWeightMin=baseMin;}
    double effectiveWeight(){ return baseWeightMin*trafficMultiplier; } }

class RoadGraph {
    private final Map<String,RoadNode> nodes=new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String,List<RoadEdge>> adj=new HashMap<>();
    void addNode(RoadNode n){ nodes.put(n.id,n); }
    void addEdge(RoadEdge e){ adj.computeIfAbsent(e.from.id,k->new ArrayList<>()).add(e); }
    List<String> dijkstra(String srcId, String dstId){
        Map<String,Double> dist=new HashMap<>(); Map<String,String> prev=new HashMap<>();
        PriorityQueue<String> pq=new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingDouble(n->dist.getOrDefault(n,Double.MAX_VALUE)));
        nodes.keySet().forEach(k->dist.put(k,Double.MAX_VALUE));
        dist.put(srcId,0.0); pq.add(srcId);
        while(!pq.isEmpty()){
            String cur=pq.poll();
            if(cur.equals(dstId)) break;
            for(RoadEdge e:adj.getOrDefault(cur,List.of())){
                double nd=dist.get(cur)+e.effectiveWeight();
                if(nd<dist.getOrDefault(e.to.id,Double.MAX_VALUE)){
                    dist.put(e.to.id,nd); prev.put(e.to.id,cur); pq.remove(e.to.id); pq.add(e.to.id);
                }
            }
        }
        List<String> path=new ArrayList<>(); String cur=dstId;
        while(cur!=null){path.add(0,cur);cur=prev.get(cur);} return path;
    }
}
// Scale: road network = 250M segments globally; hierarchical routing (local->highway->local)
// Traffic: 1B GPS probe updates/day; aggregated to segment-level speed; ETA via ML model
// Tile serving: pre-rendered at zoom levels 0-22; cached at CDN PoPs
```

> **Time:** O((V+E)logV) &nbsp; **Space:** O(V+E)
---

### 2000. Design Payment System HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2000`

**Problem:** Design Payment System HLD.

**Example Input:** transfer money between users; idempotent; no double-spend

**Example Output:** payment committed exactly once; balance updated atomically

**Explanation:** Idempotency key per request; ledger table with double-entry; saga pattern for distributed rollback.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Payment System (like Stripe/PayPal)
// Components: Payment API | Idempotency Store | Ledger DB | Bank Gateway | Fraud Detection |
//             Notification Service | Reconciliation Job

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

enum PaymentStatus { PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED, REFUNDED }
record PaymentRequest(String idempotencyKey, String payerId, String payeeId, double amount, String currency) {}
record LedgerEntry(String id, String accountId, double amount, String type, Instant at, String reference) {}

class IdempotencyStore {
    private final Map<String,PaymentStatus> store=new HashMap<>();
    Optional<PaymentStatus> get(String key){ return Optional.ofNullable(store.get(key)); }
    void set(String key,PaymentStatus s){ store.put(key,s); }
}

class Ledger {
    // Double-entry: every debit has a corresponding credit
    private final Map<String,Double> balances=new HashMap<>();
    private final List<LedgerEntry> entries=new ArrayList<>();
    synchronized void transfer(String payerId,String payeeId,double amount,String ref){
        double payerBal=balances.getOrDefault(payerId,0.0);
        if(payerBal<amount) throw new IllegalStateException("Insufficient balance");
        balances.put(payerId,payerBal-amount);
        balances.merge(payeeId,amount,Double::sum);
        Instant now=Instant.now();
        entries.add(new LedgerEntry(UUID.randomUUID().toString(),payerId,-amount,"DEBIT",now,ref));
        entries.add(new LedgerEntry(UUID.randomUUID().toString(),payeeId,amount,"CREDIT",now,ref));
    }
    void addFunds(String accountId,double amount){ balances.merge(accountId,amount,Double::sum); }
    double getBalance(String accountId){ return balances.getOrDefault(accountId,0.0); }
}

class PaymentService {
    private final IdempotencyStore idempotency=new IdempotencyStore();
    private final Ledger ledger=new Ledger();
    PaymentStatus process(PaymentRequest req){
        Optional<PaymentStatus> existing=idempotency.get(req.idempotencyKey());
        if(existing.isPresent()) return existing.get();  // idempotent return
        idempotency.set(req.idempotencyKey(),PaymentStatus.PROCESSING);
        try {
            ledger.transfer(req.payerId(),req.payeeId(),req.amount(),req.idempotencyKey());
            idempotency.set(req.idempotencyKey(),PaymentStatus.COMPLETED);
            return PaymentStatus.COMPLETED;
        } catch(Exception e){
            idempotency.set(req.idempotencyKey(),PaymentStatus.FAILED);
            return PaymentStatus.FAILED;
        }
    }
}
// PCI DSS compliance: no raw card storage; tokenization via HSM
// Fraud: ML model scores each transaction in <100ms; rules engine for block/review
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(entries)
---

### 2001. Design Email System HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2001`

**Problem:** Design Email System HLD.

**Example Input:** send/receive email; spam filtering; search; attachments

**Example Output:** email delivered to inbox with spam score

**Explanation:** SMTP/IMAP stack; spam filter (Naive Bayes); message stored in blob+metadata DB; full-text search index.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Email System (like Gmail)
// Components: SMTP Server | MTA (Message Transfer Agent) | Spam Filter |
//             Storage (Blob + Metadata DB) | IMAP/POP3 | Search (Elasticsearch) | Push Sync

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

record EmailMessage(String id, String from, List<String> to, String subject, String body,
                    List<String> attachmentIds, Instant sentAt, boolean spam, String folderId) {}
record Attachment(String id, String filename, long sizeBytes, String s3Key) {}

class SpamFilter {
    // Simplified Naive Bayes spam scoring
    private final Set<String> spamWords=Set.of("free","winner","click here","urgent","lottery","prize");
    double score(String subject,String body){
        String text=(subject+" "+body).toLowerCase();
        long hits=spamWords.stream().filter(text::contains).count();
        return (double)hits/spamWords.size();  // 0.0 = not spam, 1.0 = definitely spam
    }
    boolean isSpam(String subject,String body){ return score(subject,body)>0.3; }
}

class MailboxStore {
    private final Map<String,Deque<EmailMessage>> inboxes=new HashMap<>();  // userId->msgs
    void deliver(String userId,EmailMessage msg){ inboxes.computeIfAbsent(userId,k->new ArrayDeque<>()).addFirst(msg); }
    List<EmailMessage> fetch(String userId,int limit){
        return inboxes.getOrDefault(userId,new ArrayDeque<>()).stream().limit(limit).toList();
    }
    List<EmailMessage> search(String userId,String keyword){
        return inboxes.getOrDefault(userId,new ArrayDeque<>()).stream()
            .filter(m->m.subject().contains(keyword)||m.body().contains(keyword)).toList();
    }
}

class EmailService {
    private final SpamFilter spamFilter=new SpamFilter();
    private final MailboxStore store=new MailboxStore();
    void receive(EmailMessage msg){
        boolean spam=spamFilter.isSpam(msg.subject(),msg.body());
        String folder=spam?"SPAM":"INBOX";
        EmailMessage stored=new EmailMessage(msg.id(),msg.from(),msg.to(),msg.subject(),msg.body(),
            msg.attachmentIds(),msg.sentAt(),spam,folder);
        msg.to().forEach(to->store.deliver(to,stored));
    }
    List<EmailMessage> getInbox(String userId){ return store.fetch(userId,50); }
}
// Scale: Gmail stores 15GB/user; messages deduplicated; DKIM/SPF/DMARC for auth
```

> **Time:** O(recipients) &nbsp; **Space:** O(messages)
---

### 2002. Design CDN System HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2002`

**Problem:** Design CDN System HLD.

**Example Input:** serve static assets globally with low latency

**Example Output:** asset served from nearest PoP with cache hit

**Explanation:** PoP servers at edges; consistent hashing for origin pull; TTL-based invalidation; Anycast routing.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Content Delivery Network
// Components: Origin Servers | Edge PoPs (Points of Presence) | DNS (Anycast) |
//             Cache Layer (LRU+TTL) | Cache Invalidation | Analytics

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

record CdnRequest(String resourceId, String clientRegion, String acceptEncoding) {}
record CdnResponse(byte[] content, String contentType, String cacheControl, boolean cacheHit) {}

class EdgeCache {
    private final String popId; private final int capacity;
    private final LinkedHashMap<String,byte[]> lru;
    private final Map<String,Instant> expiry=new HashMap<>();
    EdgeCache(String popId,int cap){
        this.popId=popId; capacity=cap;
        lru=new LinkedHashMap<>(16,0.75f,true){
            protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<String,byte[]> e){ return size()>capacity; }
        };
    }
    synchronized Optional<byte[]> get(String key){
        Instant exp=expiry.get(key);
        if(exp!=null&&Instant.now().isAfter(exp)){lru.remove(key);expiry.remove(key);return Optional.empty();}
        return Optional.ofNullable(lru.get(key));
    }
    synchronized void put(String key,byte[] content,long ttlSeconds){ lru.put(key,content); expiry.put(key,Instant.now().plusSeconds(ttlSeconds)); }
    void invalidate(String key){ lru.remove(key); expiry.remove(key); System.out.println(popId+": invalidated "+key); }
}

class CdnService {
    private final Map<String,EdgeCache> pops=new HashMap<>();  // region->EdgeCache
    private final Map<String,byte[]> origin=new HashMap<>();   // simulated origin
    void addPop(String region,EdgeCache cache){ pops.put(region,cache); }
    void setOriginContent(String key,byte[] content){ origin.put(key,content); }
    CdnResponse serve(CdnRequest req){
        EdgeCache pop=pops.computeIfAbsent(req.clientRegion(),k->new EdgeCache(k,1000));
        Optional<byte[]> cached=pop.get(req.resourceId());
        if(cached.isPresent()) return new CdnResponse(cached.get(),"application/octet-stream","max-age=3600",true);
        byte[] content=origin.get(req.resourceId());
        if(content==null) return new CdnResponse(null,"text/plain","no-cache",false);
        pop.put(req.resourceId(),content,3600);  // cache for 1h
        return new CdnResponse(content,"application/octet-stream","max-age=3600",false);
    }
    void purge(String key){ pops.values().forEach(p->p.invalidate(key)); }
}
// Global: 200+ PoP locations; Anycast routes user to nearest PoP automatically
// Cache hit ratio target: 95%+; origin shield to reduce origin load
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(capacity)
---

### 2003. Design Stock Exchange HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2003`

**Problem:** Design Stock Exchange HLD.

**Example Input:** place buy/sell orders; match at market/limit price; real-time quotes

**Example Output:** orders matched; trade executed; balance updated

**Explanation:** Order book per stock (sorted bid/ask); matching engine; LMAX disruptor pattern for throughput.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Stock Exchange
// Components: Order Gateway | Matching Engine | Order Book | Market Data Feed |
//             Risk Engine | Settlement | Regulatory Reporting

import java.util.*;

enum OrderSide { BUY, SELL }
enum OrderType { MARKET, LIMIT }
record StockOrder(String id, String traderId, String symbol, OrderSide side, OrderType type,
                  int quantity, double limitPrice, long timestamp) {}
record Trade(String id, String buyOrderId, String sellOrderId, String symbol, int qty, double price, long ts) {}

class OrderBook {
    final String symbol;
    // Bids: highest price first; Asks: lowest price first
    private final TreeMap<Double,Deque<StockOrder>> bids=new TreeMap<>(Comparator.reverseOrder());
    private final TreeMap<Double,Deque<StockOrder>> asks=new TreeMap<>();
    private final List<Trade> trades=new ArrayList<>();
    OrderBook(String sym){ symbol=sym; }

    List<Trade> addOrder(StockOrder order){
        List<Trade> newTrades=new ArrayList<>();
        if(order.side()==OrderSide.BUY) matchBuy(order,newTrades);
        else matchSell(order,newTrades);
        trades.addAll(newTrades);
        return newTrades;
    }
    private void matchBuy(StockOrder buy,List<Trade> trades){
        while(!asks.isEmpty()&&buy.quantity()>0){
            Map.Entry<Double,Deque<StockOrder>> e=asks.firstEntry();
            if(buy.type()==OrderType.LIMIT&&e.getKey()>buy.limitPrice()) break;
            StockOrder sell=e.getValue().peek();
            int qty=Math.min(buy.quantity(),sell.quantity());
            trades.add(new Trade(UUID.randomUUID().toString(),buy.id(),sell.id(),symbol,qty,e.getKey(),System.nanoTime()));
            // update quantities (simplified - records are immutable, use mutable order in production)
            if(qty>=sell.quantity()) e.getValue().poll();
            if(e.getValue().isEmpty()) asks.remove(e.getKey());
            break;  // simplified
        }
        if(buy.type()==OrderType.LIMIT) bids.computeIfAbsent(buy.limitPrice(),k->new ArrayDeque<>()).add(buy);
    }
    private void matchSell(StockOrder sell,List<Trade> trades){
        if(!bids.isEmpty()){
            Map.Entry<Double,Deque<StockOrder>> e=bids.firstEntry();
            if(sell.type()==OrderType.MARKET||e.getKey()>=sell.limitPrice()){
                StockOrder buy=e.getValue().peek();
                int qty=Math.min(sell.quantity(),buy.quantity());
                trades.add(new Trade(UUID.randomUUID().toString(),buy.id(),sell.id(),symbol,qty,e.getKey(),System.nanoTime()));
                if(e.getValue().isEmpty()) bids.remove(e.getKey());
                return;
            }
        }
        if(sell.type()==OrderType.LIMIT) asks.computeIfAbsent(sell.limitPrice(),k->new ArrayDeque<>()).add(sell);
    }
    double getBestBid(){ return bids.isEmpty()?0:bids.firstKey(); }
    double getBestAsk(){ return asks.isEmpty()?0:asks.firstKey(); }
}
// Throughput: NYSE processes 10M+ orders/sec via LMAX Disruptor ring buffer
// Latency: co-location; kernel bypass (DPDK); custom protocols (FIX/ITCH)
```

> **Time:** O(log n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(orders)
---

### 2004. Design Healthcare System HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2004`

**Problem:** Design Healthcare System HLD.

**Example Input:** patient records, appointments, prescriptions, lab results

**Example Output:** appointment booked; records retrieved with access control

**Explanation:** EHR service; appointment scheduling; HIPAA-compliant audit log; role-based access; HL7/FHIR APIs.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Healthcare System (EHR)
// Components: Patient Service | Appointment Service | EHR Service | Lab Service |
//             Prescription Service | Audit Log | Access Control (RBAC) | FHIR API Gateway

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

enum UserRole { PATIENT, DOCTOR, NURSE, ADMIN, LAB_TECHNICIAN }
record PatientRecord(String patientId, String name, LocalDate dob, String bloodType,
                     List<String> allergies, List<String> diagnoses) {}
record Appointment(String id, String patientId, String doctorId, LocalDateTime scheduledAt, String status, String notes) {}
record AuditEntry(String who, String what, String resourceId, Instant when) {}

class AccessControl {
    static boolean canAccess(UserRole role, String action){
        return switch(action){
            case "READ_RECORD" -> role==UserRole.DOCTOR||role==UserRole.NURSE||role==UserRole.ADMIN||role==UserRole.PATIENT;
            case "WRITE_RECORD" -> role==UserRole.DOCTOR;
            case "VIEW_LAB"     -> role==UserRole.DOCTOR||role==UserRole.LAB_TECHNICIAN;
            case "ADMIN_ONLY"   -> role==UserRole.ADMIN;
            default -> false;
        };
    }
}

class AuditLogger {
    private final List<AuditEntry> log=new ArrayList<>();
    synchronized void log(String who,String what,String resourceId){
        log.add(new AuditEntry(who,what,resourceId,Instant.now()));
        System.out.printf("AUDIT: %s performed %s on %s%n",who,what,resourceId);
    }
    List<AuditEntry> getLogsFor(String resourceId){
        return log.stream().filter(e->e.resourceId().equals(resourceId)).toList();
    }
}

class EHRService {
    private final Map<String,PatientRecord> records=new HashMap<>();
    private final AuditLogger audit=new AuditLogger();
    void createRecord(PatientRecord rec,String requesterRole){
        if(!AccessControl.canAccess(UserRole.valueOf(requesterRole),"WRITE_RECORD")) throw new SecurityException("Access denied");
        records.put(rec.patientId(),rec);
        audit.log("requester","CREATE_RECORD",rec.patientId());
    }
    PatientRecord getRecord(String patientId,String requesterId,UserRole role){
        if(!AccessControl.canAccess(role,"READ_RECORD")) throw new SecurityException("Access denied");
        PatientRecord rec=records.get(patientId);
        if(rec==null) throw new NoSuchElementException("Patient not found: "+patientId);
        audit.log(requesterId,"READ_RECORD",patientId);
        return rec;
    }
}
// HIPAA: encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3); BAA with cloud providers
// FHIR R4 APIs for interoperability; HL7 v2 for lab integrations
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(records)
---

### 2005. Design Ride Sharing HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2005`

**Problem:** Design Ride Sharing HLD.

**Example Input:** real-time driver matching; dynamic pricing; live tracking

**Example Output:** driver matched in <5s; surge price shown; live ETA updated

**Explanation:** Location service (Redis Geo); Kafka for trip events; driver supply/demand for surge; WebSocket for live tracking.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Ride Sharing Platform (Lyft/Uber scale)
// Components: Rider App | Driver App | Location Service | Matching Service |
//             Pricing Engine | Trip Service | Notification Service | Analytics

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

record GeoPoint(double lat, double lon) {
    double distanceTo(GeoPoint o){ return Math.sqrt(Math.pow(lat-o.lat,2)+Math.pow(lon-o.lon,2))*111; } // km
}
record RideDriver(String id, GeoPoint loc, boolean available, String vehicleType) {}
record RideRideRequest(String id, String riderId, GeoPoint pickup, GeoPoint dropoff, String vehicleType) {}
record RideQuote(double estimatedFare, double surgeMultiplier, String eta, String currency) {}

class GeoLocationService {
    // Production: Redis GEOADD + GEOSEARCH BYRADIUS
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String,RideDriver> drivers=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    void update(RideDriver d){ drivers.put(d.id(),d); }
    List<RideDriver> findNearby(GeoPoint p, double radiusKm, String vehicleType){
        return drivers.values().stream()
            .filter(d->d.available()&&d.vehicleType().equals(vehicleType)&&d.loc().distanceTo(p)<radiusKm)
            .sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(d->d.loc().distanceTo(p))).toList();
    }
}

class DynamicPricingEngine {
    double getMultiplier(int availableDrivers, int pendingRequests){
        if(availableDrivers==0) return 3.0;
        double r=(double)pendingRequests/availableDrivers;
        return r>2?2.5:r>1.5?2.0:r>1.0?1.5:1.0;
    }
    RideQuote quote(GeoPoint from,GeoPoint to,double surge){
        double dist=from.distanceTo(to); double fare=Math.max(5.0,(2.0+dist*1.5)*surge);
        int etaMin=(int)(dist/40*60)+3;  // avg 40km/h + 3min pickup
        return new RideQuote(fare,surge,etaMin+" min","USD");
    }
}
// Matching algorithm: nearest available driver; re-dispatch if driver rejects
// Trip events: REQUESTED->MATCHED->STARTED->COMPLETED published to Kafka
// Earnings: driver dashboard via materialized view from Kafka consumer
```

> **Time:** O(drivers) &nbsp; **Space:** O(drivers)
---

### 2006. Design Hotel Booking HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2006`

**Problem:** Design Hotel Booking HLD.

**Example Input:** search hotels, view rooms, book with payment, manage reservations

**Example Output:** hotel searched by location/dates; room booked; confirmation sent

**Explanation:** Elasticsearch for hotel search; RDBMS for reservations; distributed lock prevents double-booking; Saga for payment.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Hotel Booking System (Booking.com/Expedia scale)
// Components: Search Service (Elasticsearch) | Inventory Service | Booking Service |
//             Payment Service | Notification Service | Review Service | Analytics

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

record HotelInfo(String hotelId, String name, String city, double lat, double lon, double starRating, double basePrice) {}
record RoomInventory(String hotelId, String roomType, LocalDate date, int totalRooms, int bookedRooms) {}
record HotelBooking(String id, String userId, String hotelId, String roomType, LocalDate checkIn, LocalDate checkOut, double total, String status) {}

class HotelSearchService {
    private final Map<String,HotelInfo> hotels=new HashMap<>();
    void index(HotelInfo h){ hotels.put(h.hotelId(),h); }
    List<HotelInfo> search(String city, double minStars, double maxPrice){
        return hotels.values().stream()
            .filter(h->h.city().equalsIgnoreCase(city)&&h.starRating()>=minStars&&h.basePrice()<=maxPrice)
            .sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(HotelInfo::starRating).reversed()).toList();
    }
}

class InventoryService {
    private final Map<String,Map<LocalDate,Integer>> available=new HashMap<>();  // hotelId+room->date->avail
    void setAvailability(String hotelId,String roomType,LocalDate date,int rooms){
        available.computeIfAbsent(hotelId+":"+roomType,k->new HashMap<>()).put(date,rooms);
    }
    synchronized boolean reserve(String hotelId,String roomType,LocalDate from,LocalDate to){
        String key=hotelId+":"+roomType;
        List<LocalDate> dates=from.datesUntil(to).toList();
        // Check all dates have availability
        for(LocalDate d:dates){ if(available.getOrDefault(key,Map.of()).getOrDefault(d,0)<1) return false; }
        dates.forEach(d->available.get(key).merge(d,-1,Integer::sum));
        return true;
    }
}

class HotelBookingService {
    private final InventoryService inventory;
    private final Map<String,HotelBooking> bookings=new HashMap<>();
    HotelBookingService(InventoryService inv){ inventory=inv; }
    HotelBooking book(String userId,String hotelId,String roomType,LocalDate ci,LocalDate co,double total){
        if(!inventory.reserve(hotelId,roomType,ci,co)) throw new IllegalStateException("Room not available");
        HotelBooking b=new HotelBooking(UUID.randomUUID().toString(),userId,hotelId,roomType,ci,co,total,"CONFIRMED");
        bookings.put(b.id(),b); return b;
    }
}
// Scale: 28M listed properties; 1.5M nights booked/day
// Distributed lock: Redis SETNX per (hotel+room+date) for concurrent booking prevention
```

> **Time:** O(hotels) &nbsp; **Space:** O(inventory)

### 2007. Design Dropbox HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2007`

**Problem:** Design Dropbox HLD.

**Example Input:** sync files across devices; share folders; versioning; offline access

**Example Output:** file synced to all devices; shared link generated

**Explanation:** Block-level deduplication; chunked upload to S3; metadata in DB; delta sync algorithm; WebSocket for notifications.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: File Sync & Storage (Dropbox-like)
// Components: Upload Service | Block Store (S3) | Metadata DB | Sync Service |
//             Notification Service | Sharing Service | Desktop/Mobile Clients

import java.util.*;
import java.security.*;

record FileBlock(String hash, long sizeBytes) {}  // content-addressed storage
record FileVersion(String versionId, String fileId, List<String> blockHashes, long modifiedAt, String userId) {}
record SyncFile(String fileId, String userId, String path, String latestVersionId, boolean deleted) {}
record ShareLink(String token, String fileId, String permissions, long expiresAt) {}

class BlockStore {
    // Content-addressed: same block hash => same data (deduplication)
    private final Map<String,byte[]> blocks=new HashMap<>();
    String store(byte[] data){
        String hash=sha256(data); blocks.put(hash,data); return hash;
    }
    byte[] retrieve(String hash){ return blocks.get(hash); }
    boolean exists(String hash){ return blocks.containsKey(hash); }
    private String sha256(byte[] data){
        try{ MessageDigest md=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            byte[]h=md.digest(data); StringBuilder sb=new StringBuilder();
            for(byte b:h) sb.append(String.format("%02x",b)); return sb.toString();
        }catch(Exception e){ return String.valueOf(Arrays.hashCode(data)); }
    }
}

class MetadataService {
    private final Map<String,SyncFile> files=new HashMap<>();  // fileId->SyncFile
    private final Map<String,FileVersion> versions=new HashMap<>();
    String uploadNewVersion(String userId,String path,List<String> blockHashes){
        String fileId=userId+":"+path;
        String versionId=UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        versions.put(versionId,new FileVersion(versionId,fileId,blockHashes,System.currentTimeMillis(),userId));
        files.put(fileId,new SyncFile(fileId,userId,path,versionId,false));
        return versionId;
    }
    List<String> getBlocksForSync(String userId,String path){
        SyncFile f=files.get(userId+":"+path);
        if(f==null||f.deleted()) return List.of();
        return versions.get(f.latestVersionId()).blockHashes();
    }
}
// Delta sync: client sends checksums of local blocks; server returns only changed blocks
// Chunk size: 4MB optimal for typical file sizes
// Bandwidth: upload chunked; resume on failure using Range header
```

> **Time:** O(blocks) &nbsp; **Space:** O(files*versions)
---

### 2008. Design Monitoring System HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2008`

**Problem:** Design Monitoring System HLD.

**Example Input:** collect metrics from thousands of services; alert on thresholds; dashboards

**Example Output:** metric ingested; alert fired when CPU>90% for 5min

**Explanation:** Prometheus-style pull/push; TSDB (time-series DB); alerting rules; Grafana-style dashboard; anomaly detection.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Monitoring & Alerting System (Datadog/Prometheus-like)
// Components: Metric Collectors (agents) | Ingestion Pipeline (Kafka) |
//             Time-Series DB | Alert Engine | Dashboard Service | Notification Service

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

record Metric(String name, Map<String,String> labels, double value, Instant timestamp) {}
record AlertRule(String id, String metricName, String condition, double threshold, Duration window, String notifyChannel) {}
record Alert(String ruleId, String message, Instant firedAt, Severity severity) {}
enum Severity { INFO, WARNING, CRITICAL }

class TimeSeriesDB {
    // In production: InfluxDB/VictoriaMetrics/Prometheus TSDB
    private final Map<String,Deque<Metric>> series=new HashMap<>();
    private static final int MAX_POINTS=10000;
    void insert(Metric m){
        String key=m.name()+":"+m.labels();
        Deque<Metric> q=series.computeIfAbsent(key,k->new ArrayDeque<>());
        q.addLast(m); if(q.size()>MAX_POINTS) q.pollFirst();
    }
    List<Metric> query(String name,Map<String,String> labels,Instant from,Instant to){
        String key=name+":"+labels;
        return series.getOrDefault(key,new ArrayDeque<>()).stream()
            .filter(m->!m.timestamp().isBefore(from)&&!m.timestamp().isAfter(to)).toList();
    }
    double average(String name,Map<String,String> labels,Instant from,Instant to){
        return query(name,labels,from,to).stream().mapToDouble(Metric::value).average().orElse(0);
    }
}

class AlertEngine {
    private final TimeSeriesDB tsdb; private final List<AlertRule> rules=new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<Alert> firedAlerts=new ArrayList<>();
    AlertEngine(TimeSeriesDB db){ tsdb=db; }
    void addRule(AlertRule r){ rules.add(r); }
    void evaluate(){
        Instant now=Instant.now();
        for(AlertRule rule:rules){
            double avg=tsdb.average(rule.metricName(),Map.of(),now.minus(rule.window()),now);
            boolean breach=("gt".equals(rule.condition())&&avg>rule.threshold())||
                           ("lt".equals(rule.condition())&&avg<rule.threshold());
            if(breach){
                Alert alert=new Alert(rule.id(),rule.metricName()+" breach: "+avg,now,Severity.CRITICAL);
                firedAlerts.add(alert);
                System.out.printf("ALERT [%s]: %s%n",alert.severity(),alert.message());
            }
        }
    }
    List<Alert> getAlerts(){ return List.copyOf(firedAlerts); }
}
// Scale: Datadog ingests 30T+ metrics/day; downsample old data (5s->1min->5min->1h)
// Anomaly detection: ARIMA, Holt-Winters, or ML-based seasonal decomposition
```

> **Time:** O(metrics) &nbsp; **Space:** O(series*points)
---

### 2009. Design Event Ticketing HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2009`

**Problem:** Design Event Ticketing HLD.

**Example Input:** buy tickets for concerts; prevent overselling; seat selection

**Example Output:** ticket reserved; payment processed; QR ticket issued

**Explanation:** Redis lock per seat; optimistic concurrency in DB; Kafka for async payment; QR generation post-payment.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Event Ticketing System (Ticketmaster-like)
// Components: Event Service | Inventory Service | Reservation Service |
//             Payment Service | QR Generator | Queue (virtual waiting room)

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

enum TicketStatus { AVAILABLE, RESERVED, SOLD, CANCELLED }
record EventVenue(String eventId, String name, LocalDateTime date, int totalSeats, double basePrice) {}
record TicketSeat(String seatId, String eventId, int row, int seatNum, TicketStatus status) {}
record TicketReservation(String id, String userId, List<String> seatIds, Instant reservedUntil, String status) {}

class SeatInventory {
    private final Map<String,TicketSeat> seats=new HashMap<>();
    void addSeat(TicketSeat s){ seats.put(s.seatId(),s); }
    synchronized List<String> reserveSeats(List<String> seatIds, int holdMinutes){
        List<TicketSeat> toReserve=new ArrayList<>();
        for(String id:seatIds){
            TicketSeat s=seats.get(id);
            if(s==null||s.status()!=TicketStatus.AVAILABLE) throw new IllegalStateException("Seat "+id+" not available");
            toReserve.add(s);
        }
        toReserve.forEach(s->seats.put(s.seatId(),new TicketSeat(s.seatId(),s.eventId(),s.row(),s.seatNum(),TicketStatus.RESERVED)));
        return seatIds;
    }
    synchronized void confirmSeats(List<String> seatIds){
        seatIds.forEach(id->{ TicketSeat s=seats.get(id);
            if(s!=null) seats.put(id,new TicketSeat(s.seatId(),s.eventId(),s.row(),s.seatNum(),TicketStatus.SOLD)); });
    }
    synchronized void releaseSeats(List<String> seatIds){
        seatIds.forEach(id->{ TicketSeat s=seats.get(id);
            if(s!=null) seats.put(id,new TicketSeat(s.seatId(),s.eventId(),s.row(),s.seatNum(),TicketStatus.AVAILABLE)); });
    }
    long countAvailable(String eventId){
        return seats.values().stream().filter(s->s.eventId().equals(eventId)&&s.status()==TicketStatus.AVAILABLE).count();
    }
}

class TicketingService {
    private final SeatInventory inventory;
    private final Map<String,TicketReservation> reservations=new HashMap<>();
    TicketingService(SeatInventory inv){ inventory=inv; }
    TicketReservation holdSeats(String userId,List<String> seatIds){
        inventory.reserveSeats(seatIds,15);
        TicketReservation res=new TicketReservation(UUID.randomUUID().toString(),userId,seatIds,
            Instant.now().plusSeconds(900),"HELD");
        reservations.put(res.id(),res); return res;
    }
    String confirmPurchase(String reservationId){
        TicketReservation res=reservations.get(reservationId);
        if(res==null||Instant.now().isAfter(res.reservedUntil())) throw new IllegalStateException("Reservation expired");
        inventory.confirmSeats(res.seatIds());
        String qrCode="QR:"+reservationId+":"+UUID.randomUUID().toString().substring(0,8);
        System.out.println("Ticket issued: "+qrCode); return qrCode;
    }
}
// Virtual queue: during high-demand on-sales, users enter queue; position shown; FIFO access
// Scale: Taylor Swift on-sale -> 14M concurrent; requires horizontal scaling + CDN
```

> **Time:** O(seats) &nbsp; **Space:** O(events*seats)
---

### 2010. Design Recommendation Engine HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2010`

**Problem:** Design Recommendation Engine HLD.

**Example Input:** personalized recommendations for e-commerce; real-time updates

**Example Output:** 'You may also like' section shows relevant products

**Explanation:** Collaborative filtering; content-based filtering; hybrid; offline batch (Spark ALS); online feature store.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Recommendation Engine
// Components: Feature Store | Model Training (Spark/MLflow) | Serving Layer |
//             A/B Testing | User Profile Service | Click-stream (Kafka)

import java.util.*;

// Item-Item Collaborative Filtering (simplified)
class ItemSimilarity {
    private final Map<String,Map<String,Double>> sim=new HashMap<>();  // itemA->itemB->score
    void addSimilarity(String itemA,String itemB,double score){
        sim.computeIfAbsent(itemA,k->new HashMap<>()).put(itemB,score);
        sim.computeIfAbsent(itemB,k->new HashMap<>()).put(itemA,score);
    }
    List<String> getSimilar(String itemId,int k){
        return sim.getOrDefault(itemId,Map.of()).entrySet().stream()
            .sorted(Map.Entry.<String,Double>comparingByValue().reversed())
            .limit(k).map(Map.Entry::getKey).toList();
    }
}

class UserProfileService {
    private final Map<String,List<String>> purchaseHistory=new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String,Map<String,Double>> ratings=new HashMap<>();
    void recordPurchase(String userId,String itemId){ purchaseHistory.computeIfAbsent(userId,k->new ArrayList<>()).add(itemId); }
    void recordRating(String userId,String itemId,double r){ ratings.computeIfAbsent(userId,k->new HashMap<>()).put(itemId,r); }
    List<String> getPurchaseHistory(String userId){ return purchaseHistory.getOrDefault(userId,List.of()); }
}

class RecommendationService {
    private final ItemSimilarity similarity;
    private final UserProfileService profiles;
    RecommendationService(ItemSimilarity s,UserProfileService p){ similarity=s;profiles=p; }
    List<String> recommend(String userId,int k){
        List<String> bought=profiles.getPurchaseHistory(userId);
        Set<String> seen=new HashSet<>(bought);
        Map<String,Double> candidates=new HashMap<>();
        for(String item:bought){
            similarity.getSimilar(item,20).stream()
                .filter(r->!seen.contains(r))
                .forEach(r->candidates.merge(r,1.0,Double::sum));
        }
        return candidates.entrySet().stream()
            .sorted(Map.Entry.<String,Double>comparingByValue().reversed())
            .limit(k).map(Map.Entry::getKey).toList();
    }
    // Context-aware: time of day, device, location, cart contents
    // Real-time signals: boost trending items, discounted items, in-stock items
```

> **Time:** O(items*k) &nbsp; **Space:** O(items^2)
