### 2011. Design Fraud Detection HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2011`

**Problem:** Design Fraud Detection HLD.

**Example Input:** detect fraudulent transactions in real-time; minimize false positives

**Example Output:** transaction scored <100ms; fraud flagged and blocked

**Explanation:** Rule engine for known patterns; ML model (gradient boosting) for anomaly scoring; velocity checks via Redis.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Fraud Detection System
// Components: Transaction API | Rule Engine | ML Scoring Service | Feature Store |
//             Case Management | Risk DB | Alert Service | Feedback Loop

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

record FraudTransaction(String id, String userId, String merchantId, double amount,
                         String country, String deviceId, Instant ts) {}
enum FraudDecision { APPROVE, REVIEW, DECLINE }
record FraudScore(FraudDecision decision, double score, List<String> triggeredRules) {}

class RuleEngine {
    // Rule 1: Amount > 10000 -> high risk
    // Rule 2: Foreign country + different from usual -> flag
    // Rule 3: 5+ transactions in 10 min -> velocity check
    private final Map<String,Deque<Instant>> velocityMap=new HashMap<>();

    FraudScore evaluate(FraudTransaction tx){
        List<String> triggered=new ArrayList<>();
        double score=0.0;
        if(tx.amount()>10000){ triggered.add("HIGH_AMOUNT"); score+=0.4; }
        Deque<Instant> recent=velocityMap.computeIfAbsent(tx.userId(),k->new ArrayDeque<>());
        Instant cutoff=tx.ts().minusSeconds(600);
        while(!recent.isEmpty()&&recent.peekFirst().isBefore(cutoff)) recent.pollFirst();
        if(recent.size()>=5){ triggered.add("VELOCITY_5_IN_10MIN"); score+=0.5; }
        recent.addLast(tx.ts());
        if(score>0.7) return new FraudScore(FraudDecision.DECLINE,score,triggered);
        if(score>0.4) return new FraudScore(FraudDecision.REVIEW,score,triggered);
        return new FraudScore(FraudDecision.APPROVE,score,triggered);
    }
}

class MLScoringService {
    // In production: XGBoost/LightGBM model loaded via ONNX runtime
    // Features: amount, merchant category, device fingerprint, geo-velocity, time patterns
    double score(FraudTransaction tx){
        // Simplified heuristic simulating ML output
        double s=0.0;
        if(tx.amount()>5000) s+=0.3;
        if(tx.country().equals("UNKNOWN")) s+=0.4;
        return Math.min(1.0,s);
    }
}

class FraudDetectionService {
    private final RuleEngine rules=new RuleEngine();
    private final MLScoringService ml=new MLScoringService();
    FraudScore evaluate(FraudTransaction tx){
        FraudScore ruleResult=rules.evaluate(tx);
        double mlScore=ml.score(tx);
        double combined=(ruleResult.score()+mlScore)/2;
        FraudDecision decision=combined>0.7?FraudDecision.DECLINE:combined>0.4?FraudDecision.REVIEW:FraudDecision.APPROVE;
        return new FraudScore(decision,combined,ruleResult.triggeredRules());
    }
}
// Latency target: <50ms P99 for real-time inline evaluation
// Feedback loop: analyst decisions fed back to retrain ML model weekly
```

> **Time:** O(rules) &nbsp; **Space:** O(users)
---

### 2012. Design Log Aggregation HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2012`

**Problem:** Design Log Aggregation HLD.

**Example Input:** collect logs from 1000s of services; search; alerting

**Example Output:** log ingested from all services; searchable within 10s

**Explanation:** Log agents (Filebeat) -> Kafka -> Logstash/Flink -> Elasticsearch + S3; Kibana for search/dashboards.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Log Aggregation System (ELK/Datadog Logs)
// Components: Log Agents (sidecar) | Kafka (transport) | Processing (Flink) |
//             Elasticsearch (search) | S3 (archival) | Alert Engine | Dashboard

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

enum LogSeverity { DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL }
record LogEntry(String id, String service, String host, LogSeverity severity,
                String message, Map<String,String> fields, Instant ts) {}

class LogIngestionPipeline {
    private final Map<String,Deque<LogEntry>> buffer=new HashMap<>();  // Kafka partition simulation
    void ingest(LogEntry entry){ buffer.computeIfAbsent(entry.service(),k->new ArrayDeque<>()).addLast(entry); }
    List<LogEntry> consume(String service, int batchSize){
        Deque<LogEntry> q=buffer.getOrDefault(service,new ArrayDeque<>());
        List<LogEntry> batch=new ArrayList<>();
        while(!q.isEmpty()&&batch.size()<batchSize) batch.add(q.pollFirst());
        return batch;
    }
}

class LogSearchService {
    // Simplified Elasticsearch abstraction
    private final List<LogEntry> index=new ArrayList<>();
    void index(List<LogEntry> entries){ index.addAll(entries); }
    List<LogEntry> search(String query, LogSeverity minSeverity, Instant from, Instant to){
        return index.stream()
            .filter(e->e.severity().ordinal()>=minSeverity.ordinal())
            .filter(e->!e.ts().isBefore(from)&&!e.ts().isAfter(to))
            .filter(e->e.message().contains(query)||e.fields().toString().contains(query))
            .sorted(Comparator.comparing(LogEntry::ts).reversed()).toList();
    }
    Map<String,Long> aggregateByService(Instant from,Instant to){
        Map<String,Long> counts=new HashMap<>();
        index.stream().filter(e->!e.ts().isBefore(from)&&!e.ts().isAfter(to))
            .forEach(e->counts.merge(e.service(),1L,Long::sum));
        return counts;
    }
}

class LogAlertEngine {
    private final LogSearchService search;
    private int errorThreshold=100;
    LogAlertEngine(LogSearchService s){ search=s; }
    void checkAlerts(){
        Instant now=Instant.now(), window=now.minusSeconds(300);
        long errors=search.search("",LogSeverity.ERROR,window,now).size();
        if(errors>errorThreshold) System.out.printf("ALERT: %d errors in last 5min%n",errors);
    }
}
// Scale: 10TB logs/day; hot tier (7 days) in Elasticsearch; cold tier in S3 Glacier
// Structured logging: JSON format with trace-id for distributed tracing correlation
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(logs)
---

### 2013. Design Chat System HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2013`

**Problem:** Design Chat System HLD.

**Example Input:** 1:1 and group chat; message delivery guarantee; read receipts

**Example Output:** messages delivered in order; read receipts updated

**Explanation:** WebSocket for real-time; Cassandra for message history; Redis for online status; Kafka for fan-out.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Real-Time Chat System (Slack/WhatsApp-like)
// Components: WebSocket Gateway | Chat Service | Message Store (Cassandra) |
//             Presence Service | Push Notification | Media Service | Search

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

enum ChatDeliveryStatus { SENT, DELIVERED, READ }
record ChatMessage(String id, String conversationId, String senderId, String content,
                   Instant sentAt, ChatDeliveryStatus status) {}
record Conversation(String id, String type, List<String> participantIds) {}  // type: DIRECT, GROUP

class ChatMessageStore {
    // Cassandra schema: partition by conversation_id; cluster by message_id DESC
    private final Map<String,Deque<ChatMessage>> byConversation=new HashMap<>();
    void save(ChatMessage m){ byConversation.computeIfAbsent(m.conversationId(),k->new ArrayDeque<>()).addFirst(m); }
    List<ChatMessage> fetchBefore(String convId, Instant before, int limit){
        return byConversation.getOrDefault(convId,new ArrayDeque<>()).stream()
            .filter(m->m.sentAt().isBefore(before)).limit(limit).toList();
    }
    void updateStatus(String convId, String msgId, ChatDeliveryStatus status){
        byConversation.getOrDefault(convId,new ArrayDeque<>()).stream()
            .filter(m->m.id().equals(msgId)).findFirst()
            .ifPresent(m->System.out.printf("Status updated: %s -> %s%n",msgId,status));
    }
}

class PresenceService {
    private final Map<String,Instant> lastHeartbeat=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    void heartbeat(String userId){ lastHeartbeat.put(userId,Instant.now()); }
    boolean isOnline(String userId){
        Instant last=lastHeartbeat.get(userId);
        return last!=null&&Instant.now().minusSeconds(30).isBefore(last);
    }
    Map<String,Boolean> getBulkPresence(List<String> userIds){
        Map<String,Boolean> result=new HashMap<>();
        userIds.forEach(uid->result.put(uid,isOnline(uid))); return result;
    }
}

class ChatService {
    private final ChatMessageStore store=new ChatMessageStore();
    private final PresenceService presence=new PresenceService();
    private final Map<String,Conversation> conversations=new HashMap<>();
    ChatMessage send(String senderId,String convId,String content){
        ChatMessage msg=new ChatMessage(UUID.randomUUID().toString(),convId,senderId,content,Instant.now(),ChatDeliveryStatus.SENT);
        store.save(msg);
        Conversation conv=conversations.get(convId);
        if(conv!=null) conv.participantIds().stream().filter(uid->!uid.equals(senderId)&&presence.isOnline(uid))
            .forEach(uid->System.out.println("Push to online user: "+uid));
        return msg;
    }
}
// Message ordering: logical clocks per conversation; server-assigned sequence numbers
// Group chat fan-out: async via Kafka; up to 1000 members per group
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(messages)
---

### 2014. Design Job Queue HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2014`

**Problem:** Design Job Queue HLD.

**Example Input:** async task processing; priorities; retries; dead-letter queue

**Example Output:** job submitted; worker processes; result stored

**Explanation:** Producer submits jobs; worker pool dequeues; retry with backoff; dead-letter after max retries.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Distributed Job Queue (Celery/SQS-like)
// Components: Job Submission API | Job Store (Redis/DB) | Worker Pool |
//             Scheduler | Retry Engine | Dead-Letter Queue | Monitoring Dashboard

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.time.*;

enum JobStatus { QUEUED, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED, DEAD_LETTER }
record Job(String id, String type, Map<String,Object> payload, int priority,
           int maxRetries, int attempts, JobStatus status, Instant scheduledAt) {}

class JobQueue {
    // Priority queue: higher priority = dequeued first
    private final PriorityBlockingQueue<Job> queue=new PriorityBlockingQueue<>(100,
        Comparator.comparingInt(Job::priority).reversed().thenComparing(Job::scheduledAt));
    private final Map<String,Job> allJobs=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Deque<Job> deadLetter=new ConcurrentLinkedDeque<>();

    String submit(String type,Map<String,Object> payload,int priority,int maxRetries){
        String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        Job job=new Job(id,type,payload,priority,maxRetries,0,JobStatus.QUEUED,Instant.now());
        allJobs.put(id,job); queue.offer(job); return id;
    }
    Job poll(long timeoutMs) throws InterruptedException { return queue.poll(timeoutMs,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS); }
    void markCompleted(String id){ allJobs.computeIfPresent(id,(k,j)->new Job(j.id(),j.type(),j.payload(),j.priority(),j.maxRetries(),j.attempts(),JobStatus.COMPLETED,j.scheduledAt())); }
    void retry(Job job,long delayMs){
        int attempts=job.attempts()+1;
        if(attempts>=job.maxRetries()){ Job dl=new Job(job.id(),job.type(),job.payload(),0,job.maxRetries(),attempts,JobStatus.DEAD_LETTER,Instant.now());
            deadLetter.add(dl); allJobs.put(dl.id(),dl); System.out.println("Dead letter: "+job.id()); return; }
        // Schedule retry with exponential backoff
        Job retried=new Job(job.id(),job.type(),job.payload(),job.priority(),job.maxRetries(),attempts,JobStatus.QUEUED,Instant.now().plusMillis(delayMs));
        allJobs.put(retried.id(),retried); queue.offer(retried);
        System.out.printf("Retry %d/%d for job %s in %dms%n",attempts,job.maxRetries(),job.id(),delayMs);
    }
    List<Job> getDeadLetterQueue(){ return List.copyOf(deadLetter); }
    JobStatus getStatus(String id){ Job j=allJobs.get(id); return j==null?null:j.status(); }
}

class JobWorker implements Runnable {
    private final JobQueue queue; private volatile boolean running=true;
    JobWorker(JobQueue q){ queue=q; }
    public void run(){
        while(running){ try{
            Job job=queue.poll(1000);
            if(job==null) continue;
            System.out.println("Processing: "+job.id()+" type="+job.type());
            // execute job handler...
            queue.markCompleted(job.id());
        }catch(Exception e){ System.err.println("Job failed: "+e.getMessage()); }}
    }
    void stop(){ running=false; }
}
// Scale: SQS processes millions of messages/sec; at-least-once delivery semantics
// Idempotency: workers must handle duplicate delivery gracefully
```

> **Time:** O(log n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(jobs)
---

### 2015. Design Multi-Region Replication HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2015`

**Problem:** Design Multi-Region Replication HLD.

**Example Input:** replicate data across US/EU/APAC; handle network partition; low latency reads

**Example Output:** reads served from local region; writes replicated globally

**Explanation:** Active-active with conflict resolution (LWW); CRDT for counters; Raft/Paxos per region; cross-region async replication.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Multi-Region Replication
// Components: Region Leader (Raft) | Cross-Region Replication Log | Conflict Resolver |
//             Local Read Cache | Global Metadata Store | Health Monitor

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

enum ReplicationStrategy { SYNC, ASYNC, SEMI_SYNC }
record RegionNode(String region, String endpoint, boolean isLeader) {}
record ReplicaEntry(String key, String value, Instant lastWriteTs, String originRegion) {}

class ConflictResolver {
    // Last-Write-Wins (LWW) based on wall clock timestamp
    ReplicaEntry resolve(ReplicaEntry local, ReplicaEntry remote){
        if(local==null) return remote;
        if(remote==null) return local;
        return remote.lastWriteTs().isAfter(local.lastWriteTs())?remote:local;
    }
    // For counters: use CRDT G-Counter (merge = max per node)
    Map<String,Long> mergeCrdtCounters(Map<String,Long> local,Map<String,Long> remote){
        Map<String,Long> merged=new HashMap<>(local);
        remote.forEach((k,v)->merged.merge(k,v,Math::max)); return merged;
    }
}

class RegionStore {
    private final String region;
    private final Map<String,ReplicaEntry> data=new HashMap<>();
    RegionStore(String region){ this.region=region; }
    void write(String key,String value){
        data.put(key,new ReplicaEntry(key,value,Instant.now(),region));
    }
    void applyRemote(ReplicaEntry remote,ConflictResolver resolver){
        ReplicaEntry local=data.get(remote.key());
        data.put(remote.key(),resolver.resolve(local,remote));
    }
    Optional<ReplicaEntry> read(String key){ return Optional.ofNullable(data.get(key)); }
    Collection<ReplicaEntry> getReplicationLog(){ return data.values(); }
}

class MultiRegionReplication {
    private final List<RegionStore> regions=new ArrayList<>();
    private final ConflictResolver resolver=new ConflictResolver();
    void addRegion(RegionStore r){ regions.add(r); }
    void writeToRegion(int regionIdx,String key,String value){
        RegionStore primary=regions.get(regionIdx);
        primary.write(key,value);
        // Async replicate to other regions
        ReplicaEntry entry=primary.read(key).orElseThrow();
        regions.stream().filter(r->r!=primary).forEach(r->r.applyRemote(entry,resolver));
    }
}
// RPO: 0 (sync) or seconds (async); RTO: <30s with automatic failover
// Global traffic manager: Cloudflare/Route53 latency routing; health checks per region
// Consistency models: eventual (async), strong (sync), read-your-writes per region
```

> **Time:** O(regions) &nbsp; **Space:** O(data*regions)
---

### 2016. Design API Rate Limiting HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2016`

**Problem:** Design API Rate Limiting HLD.

**Example Input:** limit API calls per user/IP; different limits per tier; distributed enforcement

**Example Output:** requests throttled at 429 after limit exceeded

**Explanation:** Token bucket or sliding window; Redis INCR with EXPIRY for distributed counters; Nginx/API gateway layer.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: API Rate Limiting System
// Components: API Gateway | Rate Limit Service | Redis (counters) | Config Service |
//             Client Identifier | Quota DB | Admin Dashboard

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

enum RateLimitTier { FREE, BASIC, PRO, ENTERPRISE }
record RateLimitConfig(RateLimitTier tier, int requestsPerMinute, int burstSize) {}
record RateLimitResult(boolean allowed, int remaining, Instant resetAt, String reason) {}

class TokenBucket {
    private final double capacity; private final double refillRate;  // tokens/sec
    private double tokens; private Instant lastRefill;
    TokenBucket(double cap,double rate){ capacity=cap;refillRate=rate;tokens=cap;lastRefill=Instant.now(); }
    synchronized RateLimitResult tryConsume(int count){
        Instant now=Instant.now();
        double elapsed=Duration.between(lastRefill,now).toMillis()/1000.0;
        tokens=Math.min(capacity,tokens+elapsed*refillRate); lastRefill=now;
        if(tokens>=count){ tokens-=count;
            return new RateLimitResult(true,(int)tokens,now.plusSeconds((long)(count/refillRate)),"OK"); }
        return new RateLimitResult(false,(int)tokens,now.plusSeconds((long)((count-tokens)/refillRate)),"RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED");
    }
}

class SlidingWindowCounter {
    // Sliding window log: store timestamps of each request
    private final Deque<Instant> log=new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final int limit; private final Duration window;
    SlidingWindowCounter(int limit,Duration window){ this.limit=limit;this.window=window; }
    synchronized RateLimitResult tryConsume(){
        Instant now=Instant.now(),cutoff=now.minus(window);
        while(!log.isEmpty()&&log.peekFirst().isBefore(cutoff)) log.pollFirst();
        if(log.size()<limit){ log.addLast(now);
            return new RateLimitResult(true,limit-log.size(),now.plus(window),"OK"); }
        return new RateLimitResult(false,0,log.peekFirst().plus(window),"RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED");
    }
}

class RateLimitService {
    private final Map<String,TokenBucket> buckets=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<RateLimitTier,RateLimitConfig> configs=Map.of(
        RateLimitTier.FREE,new RateLimitConfig(RateLimitTier.FREE,60,10),
        RateLimitTier.PRO,new RateLimitConfig(RateLimitTier.PRO,1000,100),
        RateLimitTier.ENTERPRISE,new RateLimitConfig(RateLimitTier.ENTERPRISE,10000,500));
    RateLimitResult check(String clientId,RateLimitTier tier){
        RateLimitConfig cfg=configs.getOrDefault(tier,configs.get(RateLimitTier.FREE));
        TokenBucket bucket=buckets.computeIfAbsent(clientId,k->new TokenBucket(cfg.burstSize(),cfg.requestsPerMinute()/60.0));
        return bucket.tryConsume(1);
    }
}
// Distributed: Redis Lua script for atomic INCR+EXPIRE; no race conditions
// Headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset
// Backoff: clients should exponential-backoff on 429 responses
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(clients)
---

### 2017. Design Service Mesh HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2017`

**Problem:** Design Service Mesh HLD.

**Example Input:** service-to-service communication; mutual TLS; observability; circuit breaking

**Example Output:** services communicate securely; circuit breaker trips on failures

**Explanation:** Sidecar proxy (Envoy) per service; control plane (Istio/Linkerd); mTLS auto-rotation; Prometheus metrics.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Service Mesh (Istio-like)
// Components: Data Plane (Envoy sidecars) | Control Plane | Certificate Authority |
//             Traffic Management | Observability | Policy Engine

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

record ServiceEndpoint(String serviceId, String host, int port, Map<String,String> metadata) {}
enum SidecarState { OPEN, HALF_OPEN, CLOSED }

class ServiceRegistry {
    private final Map<String,List<ServiceEndpoint>> services=new HashMap<>();
    void register(String name,ServiceEndpoint ep){ services.computeIfAbsent(name,k->new ArrayList<>()).add(ep); }
    void deregister(String name,String host){ services.getOrDefault(name,List.of()).removeIf(ep->ep.host().equals(host)); }
    List<ServiceEndpoint> discover(String name){ return services.getOrDefault(name,List.of()); }
}

class MeshCircuitBreaker {
    private final String serviceId;
    private SidecarState state=SidecarState.CLOSED;
    private int failures=0,successes=0;
    private final int failThreshold=5,successThreshold=3;
    private Instant openedAt;
    MeshCircuitBreaker(String id){ serviceId=id; }
    synchronized boolean allowRequest(){
        if(state==SidecarState.OPEN){
            if(Duration.between(openedAt,Instant.now()).getSeconds()>30){ state=SidecarState.HALF_OPEN; failures=0; return true; }
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    synchronized void recordSuccess(){ successes++;
        if(state==SidecarState.HALF_OPEN&&successes>=successThreshold){ state=SidecarState.CLOSED;failures=0;successes=0; }}
    synchronized void recordFailure(){ failures++;
        if(failures>=failThreshold){ state=SidecarState.OPEN;openedAt=Instant.now();
            System.out.println("Circuit OPEN for: "+serviceId); }}
    SidecarState getState(){ return state; }
}

class LoadBalancer {
    private int roundRobinIdx=0;
    ServiceEndpoint select(List<ServiceEndpoint> endpoints){
        if(endpoints.isEmpty()) throw new RuntimeException("No healthy endpoints");
        synchronized(this){ ServiceEndpoint ep=endpoints.get(roundRobinIdx%endpoints.size()); roundRobinIdx++; return ep; }
    }
    // Weight-based, least-connections, or consistent-hash also supported
}
// mTLS: each sidecar has auto-rotated SPIFFE/X.509 cert; control plane handles distribution
// Traffic policy: retry (3x), timeout (5s), circuit break (via Envoy outlier detection)
// Observability: Envoy emits Prometheus metrics + Zipkin/Jaeger spans per request
```

> **Time:** O(services) &nbsp; **Space:** O(services)
---

### 2018. Design Data Pipeline HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2018`

**Problem:** Design Data Pipeline HLD.

**Example Input:** ingest raw events; transform; load to warehouse; schedule batch jobs

**Example Output:** events processed within SLA; warehouse updated nightly

**Explanation:** Kafka ingest; Flink/Spark Streaming for real-time; Airflow for batch orchestration; Delta Lake for ACID.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Data Pipeline (Lambda/Kappa Architecture)
// Components: Source Systems | Kafka (ingest) | Stream Processing (Flink) |
//             Batch Processing (Spark) | Data Lake (S3/Delta) | Data Warehouse | Orchestration (Airflow)

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;
import java.util.function.Function;

record RawEvent(String id, String sourceSystem, String eventType, Map<String,Object> payload, Instant ts) {}
record TransformedRecord(String id, String eventType, Map<String,Object> data, LocalDate partitionDate) {}

class StreamProcessor {
    private final List<Function<RawEvent,TransformedRecord>> transformers=new ArrayList<>();
    void addTransformer(Function<RawEvent,TransformedRecord> t){ transformers.add(t); }
    Optional<TransformedRecord> process(RawEvent event){
        try{
            TransformedRecord rec=null;
            for(Function<RawEvent,TransformedRecord> t:transformers) rec=t.apply(event);
            return Optional.ofNullable(rec);
        }catch(Exception e){ System.err.println("Transform failed: "+e.getMessage()); return Optional.empty(); }
    }
    List<TransformedRecord> processBatch(List<RawEvent> events){
        return events.stream().map(this::process).filter(Optional::isPresent).map(Optional::get).toList();
    }
}

class DataLakeWriter {
    // Simulates writing to partitioned Parquet/Delta format
    private final Map<LocalDate,List<TransformedRecord>> partitions=new HashMap<>();
    void write(TransformedRecord rec){ partitions.computeIfAbsent(rec.partitionDate(),k->new ArrayList<>()).add(rec); }
    void writeBatch(List<TransformedRecord> recs){ recs.forEach(this::write); }
    List<TransformedRecord> readPartition(LocalDate date){ return partitions.getOrDefault(date,List.of()); }
    Set<LocalDate> listPartitions(){ return partitions.keySet(); }
}

class PipelineOrchestrator {
    private final StreamProcessor processor=new StreamProcessor();
    private final DataLakeWriter lake=new DataLakeWriter();
    void processMicrobatch(List<RawEvent> events){
        List<TransformedRecord> transformed=processor.processBatch(events);
        lake.writeBatch(transformed);
        System.out.printf("Processed %d/%d events%n",transformed.size(),events.size());
    }
    void runDailyBatchJob(LocalDate date){
        // In production: Spark job reads partition, aggregates, writes to DW
        List<TransformedRecord> partition=lake.readPartition(date);
        System.out.printf("Daily job: %d records for %s -> Data Warehouse%n",partition.size(),date);
    }
}
// Lambda: hot path (Kafka+Flink for real-time) + cold path (Spark batch for correctness)
// Kappa: single Kafka+Flink path; replay from Kafka retention for reprocessing
// Data quality: Great Expectations assertions; alerts on schema drift
```

> **Time:** O(events) &nbsp; **Space:** O(partitions)
---

### 2019. Design AB Testing HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2019`

**Problem:** Design AB Testing HLD.

**Example Input:** run experiments on user traffic; split traffic; measure metrics; statistical significance

**Example Output:** experiment results show conversion lift with confidence interval

**Explanation:** Experiment config service; traffic splitter via hashing; metrics aggregation; Bayesian/frequentist analysis.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: A/B Testing Platform
// Components: Experiment Service | Assignment Service | Event Tracker |
//             Metrics Aggregator | Statistics Engine | Dashboard | Feature Flags Integration

import java.util.*;

enum ExperimentStatus { DRAFT, RUNNING, PAUSED, CONCLUDED }
record Experiment(String id, String name, Map<String,Integer> variants, ExperimentStatus status,
                  String primaryMetric, int targetSampleSize) {}
// variants: Map<variantId, trafficPercent>

class AssignmentService {
    private final Map<String,Experiment> experiments=new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String,Map<String,String>> assignments=new HashMap<>();  // userId->experimentId->variantId
    void register(Experiment exp){ experiments.put(exp.id(),exp); }
    String assign(String userId,String experimentId){
        Experiment exp=experiments.get(experimentId);
        if(exp==null||exp.status()!=ExperimentStatus.RUNNING) return "control";
        // Deterministic hash for consistent assignment
        int hash=Math.abs((userId+":"+experimentId).hashCode())%100;
        int cumulative=0;
        for(Map.Entry<String,Integer> e:exp.variants().entrySet()){
            cumulative+=e.getValue();
            if(hash<cumulative){ assignments.computeIfAbsent(userId,k->new HashMap<>()).put(experimentId,e.getKey()); return e.getKey(); }
        }
        return "control";
    }
    String getAssignment(String userId,String experimentId){
        return assignments.getOrDefault(userId,Map.of()).getOrDefault(experimentId,assign(userId,experimentId));
    }
}

class MetricsAggregator {
    private final Map<String,Map<String,List<Double>>> variantMetrics=new HashMap<>();  // expId->variantId->values
    void record(String experimentId,String variantId,String metricName,double value){
        variantMetrics.computeIfAbsent(experimentId,k->new HashMap<>())
            .computeIfAbsent(variantId,k->new ArrayList<>()).add(value);
    }
    Map<String,Double> getAverages(String experimentId){
        Map<String,Double> result=new HashMap<>();
        variantMetrics.getOrDefault(experimentId,Map.of()).forEach((variant,values)->
            result.put(variant,values.stream().mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue).average().orElse(0)));
        return result;
    }
}

class StatisticsEngine {
    // Two-sample t-test for significance (simplified)
    boolean isSignificant(List<Double> control,List<Double> treatment,double alpha){
        if(control.isEmpty()||treatment.isEmpty()) return false;
        double meanC=control.stream().mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue).average().orElse(0);
        double meanT=treatment.stream().mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue).average().orElse(0);
        double lift=meanC==0?0:(meanT-meanC)/meanC;
        System.out.printf("Lift: %.2f%%, significant: %b%n",lift*100,Math.abs(lift)>0.05);
        return Math.abs(lift)>0.05;  // Simplified: 5% minimum detectable effect
    }
}
// Mutual exclusion: users enrolled in one experiment per layer (search, checkout, etc.)
// Guard rails: auto-stop experiment if error rate exceeds threshold
// Minimum sample: power analysis for 80% power, alpha=0.05
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(users*experiments)
---

### 2020. Design Feature Flag System HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2020`

**Problem:** Design Feature Flag System HLD.

**Example Input:** toggle features without deployment; gradual rollout; targeting rules

**Example Output:** flag returns true/false per user based on rules

**Explanation:** Flag config in DB; evaluation SDK in app process; targeting by user segment; percentage rollout; audit log.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Feature Flag System (LaunchDarkly-like)
// Components: Flag Management API | Config Store | Evaluation SDK |
//             Targeting Rules Engine | Audit Log | Analytics | SSE/WebSocket for live updates

import java.util.*;

enum FlagType { BOOLEAN, STRING, NUMBER, JSON }
record TargetingRule(String attribute, String operator, String value, String variantId) {}
record FlagConfig(String flagKey, boolean enabled, Map<String,Object> variants, List<TargetingRule> rules,
                  String defaultVariant, int rolloutPercent) {}
record EvaluationContext(String userId, String country, String deviceType, Map<String,String> customAttrs) {}

class RulesEngine {
    boolean matches(TargetingRule rule, EvaluationContext ctx){
        String attrValue=switch(rule.attribute()){
            case "country"->ctx.country(); case "deviceType"->ctx.deviceType();
            default->ctx.customAttrs().getOrDefault(rule.attribute(),"");
        };
        return switch(rule.operator()){
            case "equals"->attrValue.equals(rule.value());
            case "contains"->attrValue.contains(rule.value());
            case "startsWith"->attrValue.startsWith(rule.value());
            default->false;
        };
    }
}

class FlagEvaluator {
    private final Map<String,FlagConfig> flags=new HashMap<>();
    private final RulesEngine rules=new RulesEngine();
    void upsertFlag(FlagConfig flag){ flags.put(flag.flagKey(),flag); }
    Object evaluate(String flagKey, EvaluationContext ctx){
        FlagConfig flag=flags.get(flagKey);
        if(flag==null||!flag.enabled()) return false;
        // 1. Check targeting rules
        for(TargetingRule rule:flag.rules()){
            if(rules.matches(rule,ctx)) return flag.variants().get(rule.variantId());
        }
        // 2. Percentage rollout (consistent hash)
        int hash=Math.abs((ctx.userId()+":"+flagKey).hashCode())%100;
        if(hash<flag.rolloutPercent()) return flag.variants().get("treatment");
        return flag.variants().get(flag.defaultVariant());
    }
    boolean booleanValue(String flagKey,EvaluationContext ctx){ Object v=evaluate(flagKey,ctx); return v instanceof Boolean?((Boolean)v):Boolean.parseBoolean(String.valueOf(v)); }
}
// SDK: embedded in app process; flags cached locally; streamed updates via SSE
// Audit: every flag change recorded with who/what/when; rollback capability
// Integration: tied to A/B testing system for experimentation
```

> **Time:** O(rules) &nbsp; **Space:** O(flags)
---

### 2021. Design Distributed Tracing HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2021`

**Problem:** Design Distributed Tracing HLD.

**Example Input:** trace requests across microservices; visualize latency; find bottlenecks

**Example Output:** trace shows each service hop with duration and errors

**Explanation:** W3C trace-context propagation; Jaeger/Zipkin backend; sampling strategy; parent-child span model.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Distributed Tracing System (Jaeger/Zipkin-like)
// Components: SDK (trace propagation) | Collector | Storage (Cassandra) |
//             Query Service | UI (trace timeline) | Sampling Engine

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

record Span(String traceId, String spanId, String parentSpanId, String serviceName,
            String operationName, Instant startTime, Duration duration,
            Map<String,String> tags, List<String> logs, boolean error) {}

class TracePropagator {
    // W3C traceparent header: 00-{traceId}-{spanId}-{flags}
    String inject(String traceId,String spanId){
        return String.format("00-%s-%s-01",traceId,spanId);
    }
    Optional<String[]> extract(String header){
        if(header==null||!header.startsWith("00-")) return Optional.empty();
        String[]parts=header.split("-");
        return parts.length>=3?Optional.of(new String[]{parts[1],parts[2]}):Optional.empty();
    }
}

class SpanBuilder {
    private String traceId,spanId,parentSpanId,service,operation;
    private Instant start; private final Map<String,String> tags=new HashMap<>();
    SpanBuilder traceId(String v){traceId=v;return this;}
    SpanBuilder spanId(String v){spanId=v;return this;}
    SpanBuilder parent(String v){parentSpanId=v;return this;}
    SpanBuilder service(String v){service=v;return this;}
    SpanBuilder operation(String v){operation=v;return this;}
    SpanBuilder tag(String k,String vv){tags.put(k,vv);return this;}
    SpanBuilder start(){start=Instant.now();return this;}
    Span finish(){
        Duration dur=Duration.between(start,Instant.now());
        return new Span(traceId,spanId,parentSpanId,service,operation,start,dur,tags,List.of(),false);
    }
}

class TraceCollector {
    private final Map<String,List<Span>> traces=new HashMap<>();  // traceId->spans
    void collect(Span span){ traces.computeIfAbsent(span.traceId(),k->new ArrayList<>()).add(span); }
    List<Span> getTrace(String traceId){ return traces.getOrDefault(traceId,List.of()); }
    Duration getTotalDuration(String traceId){
        List<Span> spans=getTrace(traceId);
        if(spans.isEmpty()) return Duration.ZERO;
        return spans.stream().map(Span::duration).reduce(Duration.ZERO,Duration::plus);
    }
    Optional<Span> findSlowestSpan(String traceId){
        return getTrace(traceId).stream().max(Comparator.comparing(Span::duration));
    }
}
// Sampling: head-based (probabilistic, 1%); tail-based (keep errors/slow traces)
// Storage: Cassandra partitioned by traceId; 7-day retention; indexed by service+operation
// Latency percentiles: P50/P95/P99 via pre-aggregated histograms per operation
```

> **Time:** O(spans) &nbsp; **Space:** O(traces*spans)

### 2022. Design Configuration Management HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2022`

**Problem:** Design Configuration Management HLD.

**Example Input:** centralized config for all services; versioned; hot-reload without restart

**Example Output:** service reads updated config within 5s of change

**Explanation:** Config stored in Zookeeper/etcd/Consul; change notification via watch; client SDK with local cache.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Configuration Management System (Consul/etcd-like)
// Components: Config Store (etcd) | Change Notification (pub/sub) | Client SDK |
//             Access Control | Audit Log | Environment-Scoped Configs | Secret Management

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

record ConfigEntry(String key, String value, long version, String environment, Instant updatedAt) {}

class ConfigStore {
    private final Map<String,ConfigEntry> store=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<String,List<Consumer<ConfigEntry>>> watchers=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private long globalVersion=0;
    synchronized ConfigEntry put(String env,String key,String value){
        String fullKey=env+"/"+key;
        ConfigEntry entry=new ConfigEntry(key,value,++globalVersion,env,java.time.Instant.now());
        store.put(fullKey,entry);
        notifyWatchers(fullKey,entry); return entry;
    }
    Optional<ConfigEntry> get(String env,String key){ return Optional.ofNullable(store.get(env+"/"+key)); }
    void watch(String env,String key,Consumer<ConfigEntry> callback){
        watchers.computeIfAbsent(env+"/"+key,k->new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>()).add(callback);
    }
    private void notifyWatchers(String key,ConfigEntry entry){
        List<Consumer<ConfigEntry>> cbs=watchers.get(key);
        if(cbs!=null) cbs.forEach(cb->cb.accept(entry));
    }
    List<ConfigEntry> listByEnv(String env){
        return store.entrySet().stream().filter(e->e.getKey().startsWith(env+"/")).map(Map.Entry::getValue).toList();
    }
}

class ConfigClient {
    private final ConfigStore store; private final String environment;
    private final Map<String,String> localCache=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    ConfigClient(ConfigStore s,String env){
        store=s; environment=env;
    }
    String get(String key,String defaultVal){
        String cached=localCache.get(key);
        if(cached!=null) return cached;
        Optional<ConfigEntry> entry=store.get(environment,key);
        entry.ifPresent(e->localCache.put(key,e.value()));
        return entry.map(ConfigEntry::value).orElse(defaultVal);
    }
    void watchAndReload(String key,Consumer<String> onUpdate){
        // Register watcher for hot-reload
        store.watch(environment,key,entry->{ localCache.put(key,entry.value()); onUpdate.accept(entry.value()); });
    }
}
// etcd: Raft consensus for consistency; leader election; lease-based distributed locks
// Feature: environment promotion (dev->staging->prod) with approval workflow
// Secrets: encrypted at rest; access audit; rotation triggered via config update
```

> **Time:** O(1) &nbsp; **Space:** O(keys)

### 2023. Design Disaster Recovery HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2023`

**Problem:** Design Disaster Recovery HLD.

**Example Input:** recover system after region failure; RPO minutes; RTO hours

**Example Output:** failover to DR region; data restored to last checkpoint

**Explanation:** Hot/warm/cold standby tiers; continuous replication; automated failover runbook; chaos engineering.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Disaster Recovery System
// Components: Primary Region | DR Region | Replication Engine | Health Monitor |
//             Failover Controller | DNS Failover | Backup Service | Runbook Automation

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

enum DRTier { HOT, WARM, COLD }  // Hot: instant, Warm: minutes, Cold: hours
enum SystemStatus { HEALTHY, DEGRADED, FAILED, RECOVERING }
record HealthCheck(String serviceId, SystemStatus status, Instant checkedAt, String details) {}
record DrSnapshot(String id, Instant takenAt, long sizeBytes, String storageLocation) {}

class HealthMonitor {
    private final Map<String,HealthCheck> checks=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    void update(String serviceId,SystemStatus status,String details){
        checks.put(serviceId,new HealthCheck(serviceId,status,Instant.now(),details));
    }
    boolean isRegionHealthy(Set<String> criticalServices){
        return criticalServices.stream().allMatch(s->{
            HealthCheck c=checks.get(s);
            return c!=null&&c.status()==SystemStatus.HEALTHY;
        });
    }
    List<String> getFailedServices(){
        return checks.entrySet().stream().filter(e->e.getValue().status()==SystemStatus.FAILED)
            .map(Map.Entry::getKey).toList();
    }
}

class BackupService {
    private final List<DrSnapshot> snapshots=new ArrayList<>();
    DrSnapshot takeSnapshot(String storageLocation){
        DrSnapshot snap=new DrSnapshot(UUID.randomUUID().toString(),Instant.now(),1024*1024*1024L,storageLocation);
        snapshots.add(snap); System.out.println("Snapshot taken: "+snap.id()); return snap;
    }
    Optional<DrSnapshot> getLatestSnapshot(){
        return snapshots.stream().max(Comparator.comparing(DrSnapshot::takenAt));
    }
}

class FailoverController {
    private final HealthMonitor monitor;
    private final BackupService backup;
    private boolean failedOver=false;
    FailoverController(HealthMonitor m,BackupService b){ monitor=m;backup=b; }
    void executeFailover(Set<String> criticalServices){
        if(failedOver) return;
        if(!monitor.isRegionHealthy(criticalServices)){
            System.out.println("PRIMARY FAILURE DETECTED - initiating failover");
            List<String> failed=monitor.getFailedServices();
            System.out.println("Failed services: "+failed);
            // 1. Update DNS to DR region (Route53 health-check routing)
            System.out.println("DNS failover: pointing to DR region");
            // 2. Scale up DR region (warm -> hot)
            System.out.println("Scaling DR region");
            // 3. Restore from latest snapshot if needed
            backup.getLatestSnapshot().ifPresent(s->System.out.println("Restoring snapshot: "+s.id()));
            failedOver=true;
        }
    }
}
// RPO objectives: Hot=0, Warm=15min, Cold=24h (depends on replication lag)
// RTO objectives: Hot=minutes, Warm=1-4h, Cold=24-72h
// Chaos engineering: periodic failover drills via GameDay exercises
```

> **Time:** O(services) &nbsp; **Space:** O(snapshots)

### 2024. Design Cost Optimization HLD
**ID:** `HLD-2024`

**Problem:** Design Cost Optimization HLD.

**Example Input:** identify and reduce cloud spend; rightsize instances; autoscaling

**Example Output:** cost reduced 30% with same performance SLAs

**Explanation:** Utilization metrics from CloudWatch; rightsizing recommendations; spot/preemptible instance strategy; reserved capacity.

**Answer:**
```java
// High-Level Design: Cloud Cost Optimization System
// Components: Cost Collector (AWS Cost Explorer API) | Metrics Analyzer |
//             Recommendation Engine | Autoscaling Optimizer | Reporting Dashboard

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

enum ResourceType { EC2, RDS, S3, LAMBDA, ECS, EKS }
record ResourceUsage(String resourceId, ResourceType type, double avgCpuPercent, double avgMemPercent,
                     double monthlyCostUsd, Instant from, Instant to) {}
record CostRecommendation(String resourceId, String recommendation, double estimatedSavingsUsd, String priority) {}

class UtilizationAnalyzer {
    List<CostRecommendation> analyze(List<ResourceUsage> usages){
        List<CostRecommendation> recs=new ArrayList<>();
        for(ResourceUsage u:usages){
            // Rightsize: CPU < 10% -> downsize; CPU > 80% -> upsize
            if(u.avgCpuPercent()<10&&u.avgMemPercent()<20&&u.monthlyCostUsd()>50){
                double saving=u.monthlyCostUsd()*0.5;
                recs.add(new CostRecommendation(u.resourceId(),"Rightsize to smaller instance (CPU="+u.avgCpuPercent()+"%)","HIGH".replace("HIGH",String.valueOf(saving)),"HIGH"));
            }
            // Terminate idle resources
            if(u.avgCpuPercent()<1&&u.avgMemPercent()<5){
                recs.add(new CostRecommendation(u.resourceId(),"Terminate idle resource",u.monthlyCostUsd(),"CRITICAL"));
            }
            // Spot instances for non-critical workloads
            if(u.type()==ResourceType.EC2&&u.monthlyCostUsd()>200){
                recs.add(new CostRecommendation(u.resourceId(),"Switch to Spot instances (70% discount)",u.monthlyCostUsd()*0.7,"MEDIUM"));
            }
        }
        return recs.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(CostRecommendation::estimatedSavingsUsd).reversed()).toList();
    }
}

class AutoscalingOptimizer {
    // Predictive scaling: use historical patterns to pre-scale before traffic peaks
    Map<Integer,Integer> buildScalingSchedule(Map<Integer,Double> hourlyTrafficPattern,int baseCapacity){
        Map<Integer,Integer> schedule=new HashMap<>();
        hourlyTrafficPattern.forEach((hour,multiplier)->{
            int desired=(int)Math.ceil(baseCapacity*multiplier);
            schedule.put(hour,desired);
        });
        return schedule;
    }
    // Scheduled scaling: scale down nights/weekends for dev environments
    String recommendSchedule(String environment){
        if("dev".equals(environment)||"staging".equals(environment))
            return "Scale to 0 nights (8pm-8am) and weekends -> save 70% dev costs";
        return "No scheduled scale-down for production";
    }
}
// Reserved Instances: 1-3 year commitment for baseline load; 40-60% savings
// Savings Plans: flexible RI alternative; commitment to $/hr not specific instance type
// FinOps: tag all resources with team/product/env for cost allocation and showback
```

> **Time:** O(resources) &nbsp; **Space:** O(resources)

**ID:** `AI-2026`

**Problem:** Use AI To Refactor Code.

**Example Output:** refactored clean code with extracted methods and reduced complexity

**Answer:**

```java
// AI-Assisted Code Refactoring Workflow

// BEFORE: AI-identified issues (share this with AI for refactoring)
// Cyclomatic complexity: 12 (target <7); deep nesting; magic numbers; duplication
class LegacyOrderProcessor {
    public String process(String type,double amt,boolean express,boolean intl){
        String result="";
        if(type!=null){
            if(type.equals("STANDARD")){
                if(amt>0){
                    if(express){ if(intl){ result="INTL_EXPRESS_STD"; } else { result="EXPRESS_STD"; } }
                    else { if(intl){ result="INTL_STD"; } else { result="STD"; } }
                } else { result="INVALID_AMOUNT"; }
            } else if(type.equals("PREMIUM")){
                if(amt>0){
                    if(express){ if(intl){ result="INTL_EXPRESS_PREM"; } else { result="EXPRESS_PREM"; } }
                    else { if(intl){ result="INTL_PREM"; } else { result="PREM"; } }
                } else { result="INVALID_AMOUNT"; }
            }
        } else { result="INVALID_TYPE"; }
        return result;
    }
}

// AI Prompt: "Refactor the following method to reduce cyclomatic complexity,
//  eliminate magic strings, use early returns, and apply the Strategy pattern if appropriate."

// AFTER: AI-suggested refactoring
class RefactoredOrderProcessor {
    private static final String INVALID_AMOUNT="INVALID_AMOUNT";
    private static final String INVALID_TYPE="INVALID_TYPE";

    public String process(String type, double amount, boolean express, boolean international){
        if(type==null) return INVALID_TYPE;
        if(amount<=0) return INVALID_AMOUNT;
        return buildOrderCode(type, express, international);
    }
    private String buildOrderCode(String type, boolean express, boolean intl){
        String base=switch(type){ case "STANDARD"->"STD"; case "PREMIUM"->"PREM"; default->INVALID_TYPE; };
        if(base.equals(INVALID_TYPE)) return INVALID_TYPE;
        String modifier=(express?"EXPRESS_":"")+(intl?"INTL_":"");
        return modifier.isEmpty()?base:modifier+base;
    }
}
// AI refactoring best practices:
// 1. Always run tests before and after to verify behavior unchanged
// 2. Review AI suggestions for correctness - AI may miss domain-specific rules
// 3. Iterate: ask AI to explain each change, then accept/reject per understanding
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)

```java
// AI-Assisted SQL Optimization Workflow

// Slow query (share with AI + EXPLAIN ANALYZE output):
// SELECT o.*, u.email, p.name FROM orders o
// JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id
// JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id
// WHERE o.status = 'PENDING' AND o.created_at > '2024-01-01'
// ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 20;
// Execution time: 28.4 seconds (full table scan on 50M rows)

// AI Prompt: "Optimize this SQL query. Here is the EXPLAIN ANALYZE output: [paste output].
//  Suggest: 1) missing indexes, 2) query rewrite, 3) covering index, 4) partitioning strategy"

// AI-Suggested Optimizations:

class SqlOptimizationExamples {
    // 1. Composite index (AI recommendation)
    static final String CREATE_INDEX =
        "CREATE INDEX idx_orders_status_created ON orders(status, created_at DESC) INCLUDE (user_id, product_id);";
    // This enables index-only scan for the WHERE + ORDER BY + projected columns

    // 2. Query rewrite (AI suggestion)
    static final String OPTIMIZED_QUERY =
        "SELECT o.id, o.user_id, o.product_id, o.created_at, u.email, p.name " +
        "FROM orders o " +
        "JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id " +
        "JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id " +
        "WHERE o.status = 'PENDING' AND o.created_at > '2024-01-01' " +
        "ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 20;";
    // Avoid SELECT * (fetches unnecessary columns, prevents covering index)

    // 3. Partitioning strategy (AI recommendation)
    static final String PARTITION_DDL =
        "CREATE TABLE orders (" +
        "  id BIGINT, status VARCHAR(20), created_at TIMESTAMP, user_id BIGINT, product_id BIGINT" +
        ") PARTITION BY RANGE (created_at);";
    // Partition pruning eliminates scanning old partitions

    // 4. Application-level fix: pagination with cursor (not OFFSET)
    static final String CURSOR_PAGINATION =
        "SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status='PENDING' AND (created_at, id) < (?, ?) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 20;";

    void printOptimizationPlan(){
        System.out.println("Step 1: " + CREATE_INDEX);
        System.out.println("Step 2: Use covering index query");
        System.out.println("Step 3: Implement table partitioning");
        System.out.println("Step 4: Use cursor-based pagination");
        System.out.println("Expected: 28.4s -> <100ms");
    }
}
```

```java
        // AI fix: use parameterized queries / PreparedStatement
    }
    String safeQuery(String userId){

    }

        return orderId.toUpperCase();  // HIGH: NPE if orderId is null
    }
    String processOrderAfter(String orderId){

        return orderId.toUpperCase();
    }

    // AI fix: JOIN or batch load orders in single query

    // AI-detected: MEDIUM - Inefficient string concatenation in loop
    String concatenateBefore(java.util.List<String> items){
        String result="";
        for(String item:items) result+=item+",";  // MEDIUM: O(n^2) string copies
        return result;
    }
    String concatenateAfter(java.util.List<String> items){
        return String.join(",",items);  // MEDIUM fixed: O(n)
    }

    // AI-detected: LOW - Magic number
    boolean isExpiredBefore(long timestamp){ return System.currentTimeMillis()-timestamp>86400000; }
    // AI fix:
    static final long ONE_DAY_MS=24*60*60*1000L;
    boolean isExpiredAfter(long timestamp){ return System.currentTimeMillis()-timestamp>ONE_DAY_MS; }
}
// Best practices for AI code review:
```

```java
    int calculateDiscount(String memberType, double purchaseAmount, boolean firstPurchase){

        int base=switch(memberType.toUpperCase()){
            case "GOLD"->20; case "SILVER"->10; case "BRONZE"->5; default->0;
        };

        return Math.min(base,40);  // max 40% discount
    }
```

### 2038. AI Performance Analysis
**ID:** `AI-2038`

**Problem:** AI Performance Analysis.

**Example Input:** application profiling data showing 80% CPU in one method

**Example Output:** bottleneck identified; optimization applied; 5x throughput improvement

**Explanation:** Share profiler output + hot method with AI; AI identifies algorithm inefficiency; suggests O-complexity improvement.

**Answer:**
```java
// AI Performance Analysis Workflow

import java.util.*;

class AIPerformanceAnalysisWorkflow {
    // Hot method identified by profiler (share with AI)
    // Before: O(n^2) - 80% CPU time in findDuplicates
    List<String> findDuplicatesBefore(List<String> items){
        List<String> duplicates=new ArrayList<>();
        for(int i=0;i<items.size();i++){
            for(int j=i+1;j<items.size();j++){  // O(n^2) nested loop
                if(items.get(i).equals(items.get(j))&&!duplicates.contains(items.get(i))){
                    duplicates.add(items.get(i));
                }
            }
        }
        return duplicates;
    }

    // AI Prompt: "This method takes 45 seconds on 100K items (profiler shows 80% CPU here).
    //  Analyze the algorithm complexity and suggest an O(n) or O(n log n) improvement."

    // AI-Suggested fix: O(n) using HashSet
    List<String> findDuplicatesAfter(List<String> items){
        Set<String> seen=new HashSet<>();
        Set<String> duplicates=new LinkedHashSet<>();  // preserves order
        for(String item:items){
            if(!seen.add(item)) duplicates.add(item);  // add returns false if already present
        }
        return new ArrayList<>(duplicates);
    }

    void benchmark(){
        int n=100_000;
        List<String> data=new ArrayList<>();
        Random rng=new Random(42);
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++) data.add(String.valueOf(rng.nextInt(n/2)));  // 50% duplicates

        long start=System.currentTimeMillis();
        // findDuplicatesBefore(data);  // ~45s (O(n^2))
        long beforeMs=System.currentTimeMillis()-start;

        start=System.currentTimeMillis();
        List<String> result=findDuplicatesAfter(data);
        long afterMs=System.currentTimeMillis()-start;

        System.out.printf("Before: ~45000ms | After: %dms | Speedup: ~%dx%n",afterMs,45000/(afterMs+1));
        System.out.printf("Found %d duplicates%n",result.size());
    }

    // Additional AI performance analysis prompts:
    void additionalPrompts(){
        System.out.println("1. 'Analyze this SQL query for N+1 issues: [paste JPA code]'");
        System.out.println("2. 'My GC pause time is 2s. Here is heap dump analysis: [paste]'");
        System.out.println("3. 'This method allocates a new ArrayList on every call. How to cache?'");
        System.out.println("4. 'Suggest a cache strategy for this frequently-called method'");
        System.out.println("5. 'Compare ArrayList vs LinkedList performance for my access pattern'");
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(n) &nbsp; **Space:** O(n)

```java
// AI Security Audit Workflow

class AISecurityAuditWorkflow {
    // AI Security Audit Prompt:
    // "Perform a security code review on the following Spring Boot REST API.
    //  Check for OWASP Top 10:
    //  1. A01 Broken Access Control (IDOR, missing authorization)
    //  2. A02 Cryptographic Failures (plain text secrets, weak algorithms)
    //  3. A03 Injection (SQL, command, LDAP injection)
    //  4. A04 Insecure Design (missing rate limiting, no CSRF)
    //  5. A05 Security Misconfiguration
    //  6. A07 Authentication Failures (weak JWT, no expiry)
    //  Rate each finding: CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW"

    // Findings AI typically identifies:

    // CRITICAL: SQL Injection
    String vulnerableSqlQuery(String userId){
        return "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id='" + userId + "'";  // CRITICAL
    }
    String secureSqlQuery(){ return "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?"; }  // parameterized

    // HIGH: IDOR - no authorization check
    Object getOrderBefore(String orderId){
        return "fetch order "+orderId+" without checking if caller owns it";  // HIGH: IDOR
    }
    Object getOrderAfter(String orderId, String callerUserId){
        // Verify caller owns this order before returning
        System.out.println("Checking order "+orderId+" belongs to user "+callerUserId);
        return "authorized order data";
    }

    // HIGH: Hardcoded credentials
    // private static final String SECRET = "mysecret123";  // HIGH: hardcoded
    // Fix: read from environment variables / secrets manager

    // MEDIUM: Missing rate limiting
    void demonstrateRateLimiting(){
        System.out.println("@RateLimiter(name='loginApi', fallbackMethod='rateLimitFallback')");
        System.out.println("Limit login to 5 attempts per IP per minute");
    }

    // MEDIUM: JWT without expiry
    void jwtBestPractices(){
        System.out.println("JWT must have: exp (expiry), iat (issued at), iss (issuer)");
        System.out.println("Access token: 15min | Refresh token: 7 days");
        System.out.println("Algorithm: RS256 (asymmetric) not HS256 (symmetric) for distributed verify");
    }

    // Security automation
    void automationTools(){
        System.out.println("CI security pipeline:");
        System.out.println("1. SAST: SonarQube / Semgrep on every PR");
        System.out.println("2. Dependency scan: OWASP Dependency-Check / Snyk");
        System.out.println("3. Secret detection: GitLeaks / TruffleHog");
        System.out.println("4. DAST: OWASP ZAP against staging environment");
        System.out.println("5. Container scan: Trivy for Docker image vulnerabilities");
    }
}
```

```java
// AI Database Schema Design Workflow

class AIDatabaseSchemaDesignWorkflow {
    // AI Prompt: "Design a PostgreSQL database schema for a social media platform with:
    //  - Users: profile, bio, avatar, join date
    //  - Posts: text, images, user, timestamp, visibility
    //  - Comments: on posts, nested replies
    //  - Likes: on posts and comments
    //  - Follows: user-to-user
    //  Requirements: support 10M users, high read ratio (100:1 read:write)
    //  Include: indexes for common queries, constraints, normalization to 3NF"

    void aiGeneratedSchema(){
        System.out.println("AI-Generated DDL:");
        System.out.println("CREATE TABLE users (");
        System.out.println("  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,");
        System.out.println("  username VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,");
        System.out.println("  email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,");
        System.out.println("  bio TEXT, avatar_url VARCHAR(500),");
        System.out.println("  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()");
        System.out.println(");");
        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("CREATE TABLE posts (");
        System.out.println("  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,");
        System.out.println("  user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,");
        System.out.println("  content TEXT NOT NULL,");
        System.out.println("  visibility VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'PUBLIC' CHECK (visibility IN ('PUBLIC','FOLLOWERS','PRIVATE')),");
        System.out.println("  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()");
        System.out.println(");");
        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("CREATE TABLE likes (");
        System.out.println("  user_id BIGINT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,");
        System.out.println("  post_id BIGINT REFERENCES posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,");
        System.out.println("  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, post_id)  -- prevent duplicate likes");
        System.out.println(");");
    }

    void aiGeneratedIndexes(){
        System.out.println("AI-Recommended Indexes:");
        System.out.println("-- Feed query: posts by user ordered by time");
        System.out.println("CREATE INDEX idx_posts_user_created ON posts(user_id, created_at DESC);");
        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("-- Like count per post (partial index on likes table)");
        System.out.println("CREATE INDEX idx_likes_post ON likes(post_id);");
        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("-- Username lookup");
        System.out.println("CREATE INDEX idx_users_username ON users(username);");
    }

    void schemaReviewChecklist(){
        System.out.println("Schema review with AI:");
        System.out.println("[ ] 3NF: no transitive dependencies");
        System.out.println("[ ] FKs with ON DELETE CASCADE/RESTRICT as appropriate");
        System.out.println("[ ] Indexes support top-5 query patterns");
        System.out.println("[ ] BIGINT PKs (not INT) for large scale");
        System.out.println("[ ] TIMESTAMPTZ (not TIMESTAMP) for timezone safety");
        System.out.println("[ ] Enum values as CHECK constraints or lookup tables");
    }
}
```

```java
        System.out.println("Logs: 'HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms'");
    }

    // AI Prompt: "Help me diagnose this production incident:
    //  [paste context above]

    void aiGuidedDiagnosis(){
        System.out.println("AI Diagnosis:");
        System.out.println("Root cause candidates (most likely first):");
        System.out.println("1. New deployment introduced slow query causing connection hold");
        System.out.println("2. Connection leak in new code path (connection not closed)");
        System.out.println("3. Traffic spike exceeding connection pool size");
    }

    void immediateActions(){

        System.out.println("1. ROLLBACK: git revert v2.3.1 (deploy took 15min, rollback = 5min)");
        System.out.println("2. DIAGNOSE: SELECT * FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active' ORDER BY duration DESC;");
        System.out.println("3. MITIGATE: Increase HikariCP maxPoolSize from 100 to 200 temporarily");
        System.out.println("4. BLOCK: Kill long-running queries: SELECT pg_cancel_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE duration > interval '30s'");
    }

    void postmortemTemplate(){
        System.out.println("AI-Generated Postmortem Template:");
        System.out.println("## Incident Summary");
        System.out.println("## Timeline");
        System.out.println("## Root Cause Analysis (5 Whys)");
        System.out.println("  Why 1: 503 errors -> connection pool exhausted");
        System.out.println("  Why 2: Pool exhausted -> connections held for 30s+");
        System.out.println("  Why 3: Long holds -> new batch query not using index");
        System.out.println("  Why 4: Missing index -> no index on orders.created_at");
        System.out.println("  Why 5: Missed in review -> no EXPLAIN ANALYZE in PR process");
        System.out.println("## Action Items");
        System.out.println("  - Add EXPLAIN ANALYZE requirement to PR checklist");
        System.out.println("  - Add alert: DB connection pool >80%");
        System.out.println("  - Add index: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ...");
    }

    Instant exampleIncidentStart(){ return Instant.parse("2024-01-15T14:28:00Z"); }
    Instant exampleIncidentEnd(){ return Instant.parse("2024-01-15T15:02:00Z"); }
    Duration ttd(){ return Duration.between(exampleIncidentStart(),exampleIncidentEnd()); }
}
```

### 2043. AI Code Migration Workflow
**ID:** `AI-2043`

**Problem:** AI Code Migration Workflow.

**Example Input:** Java 8 codebase needing migration to Java 21

**Example Output:** modernized code using records, switch expressions, virtual threads

**Explanation:** Use AI to identify migration candidates; generate modern equivalents; verify behavior parity with tests.

**Answer:**
```java
// AI Code Migration Workflow: Java 8 -> Java 21

class AICodeMigrationWorkflow {
    // AI Prompt: "Migrate the following Java 8 code to Java 21.
    //  Use: records, sealed classes, switch expressions, pattern matching,
    //  text blocks, var, Stream.toList(), Optional improvements.
    //  Preserve exact behavior. Flag any semantic differences."

    // BEFORE: Java 8 patterns
    // 1. Old data class (POJO with builder)
    static class UserBefore {
        private final String id; private final String name; private final int age;
        UserBefore(String id,String name,int age){this.id=id;this.name=name;this.age=age;}
        String getId(){return id;} String getName(){return name;} int getAge(){return age;}
        public String toString(){return "User{id="+id+",name="+name+",age="+age+"}";}
    }
    // AFTER: Java 21 record
    record UserAfter(String id, String name, int age){}

    // 2. Old switch statement
    String getDiscountBefore(String tier){
        switch(tier){
            case "GOLD": return "20%";
            case "SILVER": return "10%";
            default: return "0%";
        }
    }
    // AFTER: switch expression
    String getDiscountAfter(String tier){
        return switch(tier){
            case "GOLD"->"20%"; case "SILVER"->"10%"; default->"0%";
        };
    }

    // 3. Old Optional chaining
    String getUsernameBefore(java.util.Optional<UserBefore> user){
        if(user.isPresent()&&user.get().getName()!=null) return user.get().getName().toUpperCase();
        return "UNKNOWN";
    }
    // AFTER: idiomatic Optional
    String getUsernameAfter(java.util.Optional<UserAfter> user){
        return user.map(UserAfter::name).map(String::toUpperCase).orElse("UNKNOWN");
    }

    // 4. Virtual threads (Java 21) for blocking I/O
    void virtualThreadExample(){
        // BEFORE: Thread pool (limited by OS threads)
        // ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(200);
        // AFTER: Virtual threads (millions of lightweight threads)
        System.out.println("Virtual thread executor:");
        System.out.println("ExecutorService es = Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor();");
        System.out.println("Each I/O-bound task gets its own virtual thread -> much better throughput");
    }

    // Migration validation
    void validationStrategy(){
        System.out.println("Migration validation:");
        System.out.println("1. Parallel test suite: run both Java 8 and Java 21 versions against same tests");
        System.out.println("2. Behavior parity: same inputs -> same outputs");
        System.out.println("3. Performance: virtual threads give 10x better throughput for I/O workloads");
        System.out.println("4. Gradual: migrate one module at a time; keep backward compatibility");
    }
}
```

> **Time:** O(classes) &nbsp; **Space:** O(1)
